us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentExcludingPlanIn.label: EBP, Investment, Excluding Plan Interest in Master Trust, Fair Value, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentExcludingPlanIn.definition: Indicates type of investment, excluding plan interest in master trust, at fair value, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)).

us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentLevel3Reconcili.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from realized and unrealized gain (loss).

us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentLevel3Reconcili.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) from Gain (Loss) [Abstract]
EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) from Gain (Loss), Statement of Change in Net Asset Available for Benefit [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentLevel3Reconcili.definition: Indicates line item in statement of change in net asset available for benefit that includes realized and unrealized gain (loss) from investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)).

us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentLevel3Reconcili.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Reason for Transfer into (out of) Level 3, Description
us-gaap-ebp:EbpInvestmentLevel3Reconcili.definition: Description of reason for transfer into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy of investment held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)).

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Fair value of investment, excluding plan interest in master trust, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)). Includes, but is not limited to, derivative, investment measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient, and insurance contract not meeting fully-benefit responsive investment criteria.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease from Sale
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of decrease in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from sale.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease from Transfer out of Level 3
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of decrease in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from transfer out of Level 3 of fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) from Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from gain (loss) on sale.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) from Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase from Purchase
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from purchase.

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase from Transfer into Level 3
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)) from transfer into Level 3 of fair value hierarchy .

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment, measured using unobservable input, held by employee stock purchase, saving, or similar plan (employee benefit plan (EBP)).

us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.label: EBP, Investment, Level 3 Reconciliation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap-ebp:EmployeeBenefitPlanInvestmen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AOCIAttributableToParentNetOfTax.label: AOCI Attributable to Parent, Net of Tax [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AOCIAttributableToParentNetOfTax.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AcceleratedShareRepurchaseProgra.label: Accelerated Share Repurchase Program, Adjustment
us-gaap:AcceleratedShareRepurchaseProgra.definition: The amount needed to adjust previously recorded stockholders' equity balances to the actual aggregate amounts paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableAllowanceForCr.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableAllowanceForCr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableExcludingAccru.label: Accounts Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableExcludingAccru.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of accounts receivable classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGross.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGross.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGrossCurrent.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGrossCurrent.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGrossNoncurren.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableGrossNoncurren.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNoncurrentNona.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNoncurrentNona.definition: Amount of interest income on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, on nonaccrual status.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivablePurchase.label: Accounts Receivable, Purchase
us-gaap:AccountsReceivablePurchase.definition: Amount of increase from purchase of accounts receivable.

us-gaap:AccountsReceivableSale.label: Accounts Receivable, Sale
us-gaap:AccountsReceivableSale.definition: Amount of decrease from sale of accounts receivable.

us-gaap:AccretionExpense.label: Accretion Expense
us-gaap:AccretionExpense.definition: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

us-gaap:AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRe.label: Accretion Expense, Including Asset Retirement Obligations
us-gaap:AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRe.definition: Amount of accretion expense, which includes, but is not limited to, accretion expense from asset retirement obligations, environmental remediation obligations, and other contingencies.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Charges to Expense for New Losses
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of expense for newly incurred environmental loss contingencies. Includes, but is not limited to, remediation expense and interest accretion.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Discount
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce (reconcile) the undiscounted amount of the accrual for environmental loss contingencies to the present value.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Increase (Decrease) for Acquisitions and Divestitures
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the obligation for environmental loss contingencies from business acquisitions (divestitures).

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Revision in Estimates
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies from revisions in estimates to existing obligations. Excludes changes related to business acquisitions, divestitures, or currency movement.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Payments
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Amount of cash outflow to settle environmental loss contingencies.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: Increase (decrease) in the accrual for environmental loss contingencies during the reporting period.

us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AccrualForEnvironmentalLossConti.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationDeferredF.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs
us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationDeferredF.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfCurrent.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfCurrent.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfDebtIss.label: Accumulated Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements
us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfDebtIss.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements.

us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfNoncurr.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfNoncurr.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfOtherDe.label: Accumulated Amortization of Other Deferred Costs
us-gaap:AccumulatedAmortizationOfOtherDe.definition: Accumulated amortization of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs, deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies, or deferred leasing costs for real estate operations.

us-gaap:AccumulatedCapitalizedInterestCo.label: Accumulated Capitalized Interest Costs
us-gaap:AccumulatedCapitalizedInterestCo.definition: Amount of accumulated interest costs capitalized as part of property, plant and equipment cost basis.

us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletion.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.
Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant and equipment.

us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletion.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization, Reclassification, Decrease
us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletion.definition: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization from reclassification out of property, plant, and equipment.

us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletion.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization, Disposition
us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletion.definition: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment from disposition.

us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInc.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Adjustment, after Tax
us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInc.definition: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInc.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInc.definition: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

us-gaap:AcquisitionCosts.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Acquisition Cost, Period Cost
us-gaap:AcquisitionCosts.definition: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Benefit Payment
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder related to benefit payment for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) from Cash Flow Change
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from cash flow assumption change for future cash flows. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) of Actual Variance from Expected Experience
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Derecognition
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of decrease in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from derecognition of contract. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Interest Income (Expense)
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of interest income (expense) for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Issuance
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of increase in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from contract issuance. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Net Premium Collected
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of gross premium collected from policyholder to fund expected benefit payment for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment, discounted at original rate. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption, of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment, discounted at original rate. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

Amount of increase (decrease) in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Remeasurement Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: Amount of remeasurement gain (loss) on present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from application of revised benefit ratio as of contract issue date. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationI.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital.label: Additional Paid in Capital
us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital.definition: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

us-gaap:AdditionsToContractHoldersFunds.label: Additions to Contract Holders Funds
us-gaap:AdditionsToContractHoldersFunds.definition: The cash inflow from a segregated fund account during the period.

us-gaap:AdditionsToOtherAssetsAmount.label: Additions to Other Assets, Amount
us-gaap:AdditionsToOtherAssetsAmount.definition: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

us-gaap:AdjustmentForAmortization.label: Amortization
us-gaap:AdjustmentForAmortization.definition: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

us-gaap:AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompan.label: Adjustment for Long-Term Intra-Entity Transaction, Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompan.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

us-gaap:AdjustmentOfWarrantsGrantedForSe.label: Adjustment of Warrants Granted for Services
us-gaap:AdjustmentOfWarrantsGrantedForSe.definition: Adjustment for noncash service expenses paid for by granting of warrants.

us-gaap:AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapi.label: Adjustment to Additional Paid-in Capital, Convertible Debt Instrument Issued at Substantial Premium
us-gaap:AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapi.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid-in capital (APIC) from recognition of substantial premium at which convertible debt instrument is issued.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt, Subsequent Adjustments
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: The amount of subsequent adjustments to additional paid in capital for convertible financial instruments where a component of equity and a component of debt are recognized.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition [Abstract]
APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCap.definition: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

us-gaap:AdministrativeFeesExpense.label: Administrative Fees Expense
us-gaap:AdministrativeFeesExpense.definition: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

us-gaap:AdvanceRoyalties.label: Advance Royalties
us-gaap:AdvanceRoyalties.definition: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable.

us-gaap:AdvertisingExpense.label: Advertising Expense
us-gaap:AdvertisingExpense.definition: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

us-gaap:AffiliateCosts.label: Affiliate Costs
us-gaap:AffiliateCosts.definition: Costs associated with revenues arising from an entity that is an affiliate of the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramAssessme.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Affordable Housing Program Obligation, Assessment Expense
us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramAssessme.definition: Amount of expense for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

references.source: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932
references.citation: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932 1291 10

us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramObligati.definition: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

references.source: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932
references.citation: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932 1291 10

us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramObligati.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

references.source: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932
references.citation: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932 1291 10

us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramRollForw.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Affordable Housing Program Obligation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AffordableHousingProgramRollForw.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AffordableHousingProjectInvestme.label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:AffordableHousingProjectInvestme.definition: Amount of impairment loss for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

us-gaap:AffordableHousingTaxCreditsAndOt.label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, before Amortization Expense
us-gaap:AffordableHousingTaxCreditsAndOt.definition: Amount, before amortization expense, of income tax credit and other tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

us-gaap:AircraftMaintenanceMaterialsAndR.label: Airline, Maintenance and Repair Expenses
us-gaap:AircraftMaintenanceMaterialsAndR.definition: Amount of expense for maintenance and repair of aircraft. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of inspection, repair, material, and routine maintenance of aircraft.

us-gaap:AircraftRental.label: Airline, Aircraft Rent Expense
us-gaap:AircraftRental.definition: Amount of expense for leasing aircraft from third party.

us-gaap:AircraftRentalAndLandingFees.definition: Amount of expense for leasing aircraft from third party and cost incurred at airport in which airline conducts flight operation. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid to airport authority for takeoff and landing, gate space and facility, security, fuel storage facility, and other terminal costs.

us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationE.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationE.definition: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationE.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense, after Tax
us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationE.definition: Amount, after tax, of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPrem.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPrem.definition: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, from recovery.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRece.definition: Amount of direct write-downs of accounts receivable charged against the allowance.

us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulOtherReceiva.label: Allowance for Credit Loss, Receivable, Other, Current
us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulOtherReceiva.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable, classified as other and current.

us-gaap:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRe.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
us-gaap:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRe.definition: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

us-gaap:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesWr.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery [Abstract]

us-gaap:AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceiva.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceiva.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

us-gaap:AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceiva.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceiva.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:AllowanceForUncollectibleCustome.label: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:AllowanceForUncollectibleCustome.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

us-gaap:AmortizationAndDepreciationOfDec.label: Amortization and Depreciation of Decontaminating and Decommissioning Assets
us-gaap:AmortizationAndDepreciationOfDec.definition: The current period expense charged against earnings on decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale to allocate or recognize the cost of the assets over their useful lives.

us-gaap:AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffor.label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffor.definition: Amount of amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfAcquisitionCosts.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
us-gaap:AmortizationOfAcquisitionCosts.definition: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfAdvanceRoyalty.label: Amortization of Advance Royalty
us-gaap:AmortizationOfAdvanceRoyalty.definition: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of the advance royalties. These royalties are paid in one accounting period, but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization. For example, royalties that are required to be paid in advance of production from a mineral, oil, or gas property and amortized over the period of right to produce these items.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfBelowMarketLease.label: Amortization of Below Market Lease
us-gaap:AmortizationOfBelowMarketLease.definition: Amount of amortization of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremiu.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremiu.definition: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredCharges.label: Amortization of Deferred Charges
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredCharges.definition: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredHedgeGains.label: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredHedgeGains.definition: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredLoanOrigin.label: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredLoanOrigin.definition: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredPropertyTa.label: Amortization of Deferred Property Taxes
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredPropertyTa.definition: The amount of amortization charged against earnings during the period for deferred property taxes.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredSalesCommi.label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredSalesCommi.definition: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfESOPAward.label: Amortization of ESOP Award
us-gaap:AmortizationOfESOPAward.definition: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCosts.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCosts.definition: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndD.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndD.definition: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets.definition: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfMortgageServicingR.label: Amortization of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
us-gaap:AmortizationOfMortgageServicingR.definition: The periodic amortization (in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss) of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfNuclearFuelLease.label: Amortization of Nuclear Fuel
us-gaap:AmortizationOfNuclearFuelLease.definition: Amount of amortization of nuclear fuel.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfPowerContractsEmis.label: Amortization of Power Contracts Emission Credits
us-gaap:AmortizationOfPowerContractsEmis.definition: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized costs related to purchasing power, fuel, or emission credits. These items may be purchased in one accounting period but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfRateDeferral.label: Amortization of Rate Deferral
us-gaap:AmortizationOfRateDeferral.definition: The periodic expense to reduce the value of the rate deferral asset that is created when utilities under bill customers during periods of rate increases by deferring rate increases. These customers eventually pay higher rates to repay the utility for the rate deferral.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfRegulatoryAsset.label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
us-gaap:AmortizationOfRegulatoryAsset.definition: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

us-gaap:AmortizationOfValueOfBusinessAcq.label: Amortization of Value of Business Acquired (VOBA)
us-gaap:AmortizationOfValueOfBusinessAcq.definition: The adjustment that represents the periodic charge against earnings to reduce the value of business acquired (VOBA) over the expected life of the underlying insurance contracts. VOBA reflects the estimated fair value of a life insurance business in force and represents the portion of the cost to acquire the business that is allocated to the value of the right to receive future cash flows from insurance contracts existing at the date of acquisition. Such value is the present value of the actuarially determined projected cash flows for the acquired policies. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

us-gaap:AmountRecognizedInIncomeDueToInf.label: Amount Recognized in Income Due to Inflationary Accounting
us-gaap:AmountRecognizedInIncomeDueToInf.definition: The amount that will be recognized through the income statement (as well as the impact on the other financial statements) as part of highly inflationary accounting.

us-gaap:AncillaryFeeIncomeGeneratedBySer.label: Ancillary Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
us-gaap:AncillaryFeeIncomeGeneratedBySer.definition: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset, excluding contractually specified servicing fees and late fees.

us-gaap:AociCashFlowHedgeReferenceRateRe.label: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Reference Rate Reform, Increase (Decrease), after Tax
us-gaap:AociCashFlowHedgeReferenceRateRe.definition: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for receipt (payment) of compensation for modification of interest rate related to reference rate reform for cash flow hedge.

us-gaap:AociCashFlowHedgeReferenceRateRe.label: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Reference Rate Reform, Increase (Decrease), before Tax
us-gaap:AociCashFlowHedgeReferenceRateRe.definition: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for receipt (payment) of compensation for modification of interest rate related to reference rate reform for cash flow hedge.

us-gaap:AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBene.definition: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in expected future policy benefit component of liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from increase (decrease) in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

us-gaap:AociTaxAttributableToParent.label: AOCI Tax, Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:AociTaxAttributableToParent.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

us-gaap:AssetAtFairValueChangesInFairVal.label: Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Assumptions
us-gaap:AssetAtFairValueChangesInFairVal.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the assumptions or model used to calculate the fair value of a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges.definition: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligation.definition: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccreti.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccreti.definition: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationCashPai.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationCashPai.definition: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationForeign.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationForeign.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) asset retirement obligations.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabili.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabili.definition: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabili.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabili.definition: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationPeriodI.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationPeriodI.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationRevisio.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationRevisio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationRollFor.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Roll Forward Analysis [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationRollFor.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherTha.label: Long-Lived Asset, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Gain (Loss) from Disposal
us-gaap:AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherTha.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

us-gaap:AssetsFairValueAdjustment.label: Assets, Fair Value Adjustment
us-gaap:AssetsFairValueAdjustment.definition: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

us-gaap:AssetsFairValueDisclosure.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
us-gaap:AssetsFairValueDisclosure.definition: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

us-gaap:AssumedPremiumsEarned.label: Assumed Premiums Earned
us-gaap:AssumedPremiumsEarned.definition: Amount of earned premiums assumed from other entities.

us-gaap:AssumedPremiumsWritten.label: Assumed Premiums Written
us-gaap:AssumedPremiumsWritten.definition: Amount of written premiums assumed from other entities.

us-gaap:AuctionMarketPreferredSecurities.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Shares, Issued
us-gaap:AuctionMarketPreferredSecurities.definition: Number of auction market preferred securities shares issued.
Number of auction market preferred securities shares outstanding.

us-gaap:AuctionMarketPreferredSecurities.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Shares, Redeemed
us-gaap:AuctionMarketPreferredSecurities.definition: These are the number of AMPS shares redeemed during the period.
The increase (decrease) in the number of Auction Market Preferred Securities during the period being reported.

us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost
us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAm.definition: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesGr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Gain
us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesGr.definition: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesGr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Loss
us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesGr.definition: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSe.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSe.definition: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:BankOwnedLifeInsuranceIncome.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
us-gaap:BankOwnedLifeInsuranceIncome.definition: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAccumulatedAmort.label: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAccumulatedAmort.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAcquired.label: Below Market Lease, Acquired
us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAcquired.definition: Amount of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseGross.label: Below Market Lease, Gross
us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseGross.definition: Amount before amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseNet.definition: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeasePeriodIncreaseDe.label: Below Market Lease, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:BelowMarketLeasePeriodIncreaseDe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseRollForward.label: Below Market Lease [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.label: Benefits, Losses and Expenses
us-gaap:BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.definition: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

us-gaap:BrokerageCommissionsRevenue.label: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
us-gaap:BrokerageCommissionsRevenue.definition: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRe.label: Business Combination, Acquisition-Related Cost, Expense
us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRe.definition: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and general administrative cost, including cost of maintaining internal acquisition department.

us-gaap:BusinessCombinationBargainPurcha.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
us-gaap:BusinessCombinationBargainPurcha.definition: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

us-gaap:BusinessCombinationIntegrationRe.label: Business Combination, Integration-Related Cost, Expense
us-gaap:BusinessCombinationIntegrationRe.definition: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

us-gaap:BusinessDevelopment.label: Business Development
us-gaap:BusinessDevelopment.definition: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business development involves evaluating a business and then realizing its full potential, using such tools as marketing, sales, information management and customer service.

us-gaap:BusinessExitCosts1.label: Business Exit Costs
us-gaap:BusinessExitCosts1.definition: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAccum.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAccum.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAddit.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Addition
us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAddit.definition: Amount of increase in capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAmort.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAmort.definition: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareGross.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, before Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareImpai.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareImpai.definition: Amount of impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwareNet.definition: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedComputerSoftwarePerio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAccumulat.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAccumulat.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAccumulat.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Impairment
us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAccumulat.definition: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortizat.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortizat.definition: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostGross.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Gross
us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostImpairmen.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostImpairmen.definition: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

us-gaap:CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldL.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Impairment Loss, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldL.definition: Indicates segment in which impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed is included. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldL.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldL.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsAccumulatedDepre.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Cost, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Valuation Allowance
us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsAccumulatedDepre.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance for capitalized cost in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProper.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Period Cost
us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProper.definition: Amount of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs and capitalized interest incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProper.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization
us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProper.definition: Amount of capitalized cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Includes, but is not limited to, acquisition, exploration, and development costs for development project and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostAd.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Addition Pending Determination of Proved Reserve
us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostAd.definition: Amount of addition to capitalized exploratory well cost pending determination of proved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostCh.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Charged to Expense
us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostCh.definition: Amount of expense for capitalized exploratory well costs for which proved reserves were not found at the exploratory well.

us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostPe.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized exploratory well costs.

us-gaap:CapitalizedExploratoryWellCosts.definition: The amount of capitalized exploratory well costs that is pending the determination of proved reserves. This does not include amounts that were capitalized and subsequently expensed in the same annual period.

us-gaap:CarryingCostsPropertyAndExplorat.label: Carrying Costs, Property and Exploration Rights
us-gaap:CarryingCostsPropertyAndExplorat.definition: The costs incurred to retain exploration and property rights after acquisition but before production has occurred. Costs include legal costs for title defense, ad valorem taxes on nonproducing mineral properties, shut-in royalties, and delay rentals.

us-gaap:Cash.label: Cash
us-gaap:Cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition.label: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition.definition: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.definition: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect, Including Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.definition: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect, Continuing Operation
us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.definition: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect, Continuing Operation
us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage, including effect from exchange rate change; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

us-gaap:CashDivestedFromDeconsolidation.label: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
us-gaap:CashDivestedFromDeconsolidation.definition: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

us-gaap:CashDividendsPaidToParentCompany.label: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
us-gaap:CashDividendsPaidToParentCompany.definition: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by unconsolidated subsidiaries.

us-gaap:CashProvidedByUsedInFinancingAct.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:CashProvidedByUsedInFinancingAct.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

us-gaap:CashProvidedByUsedInInvestingAct.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:CashProvidedByUsedInInvestingAct.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

us-gaap:CededPremiumsWritten.label: Ceded Premiums Written
us-gaap:CededPremiumsWritten.definition: Amount of written premiums ceded to other entities.

us-gaap:ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnFair.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments
us-gaap:ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnFair.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:ClearanceFees.label: Clearance Fees
us-gaap:ClearanceFees.definition: The amount of expense in the period for clearance fees.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesM.definition: The carrying amount of closed block liabilities in excess of the carrying amount of closed block assets at the date of demutualization (adjusted to eliminate the impact of related amounts in accumulated other comprehensive income).

us-gaap:ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesM.label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized, Other Adjustments
us-gaap:ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesM.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) for other adjustments to closed block's maximum future earnings.
Amount of increase (decrease) of closed block liabilities in excess of closed block assets at the date of demutualization.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesM.label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesM.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockDividendObligationCha.label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Change in Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:ClosedBlockDividendObligationCha.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the unrealized gain (loss) on investments allocated to the closed block.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockDividendObligationInc.label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Effect of Operating Results
us-gaap:ClosedBlockDividendObligationInc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the effect on dividends to policyholders on the net results of operations for the period of the closed block.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockDividendObligationPer.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the policyholder dividend obligation attributable to closed block liabilities.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockLiabilitiesPolicyhold.definition: The liability as of the balance sheet date for the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the cumulative expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings (each) for the period from the actuarial calculation date to the date of measurement. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block. The policyholder dividend obligation, which may not have a negative balance, recognizes that a portion of earnings in certain cases will not inure to the stockholders of the insurance entity.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsNetInvestme.label: Closed Block Operations, Net Investment Income
us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsNetInvestme.definition: Income for the period from the investments allocated to an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts (known as a closed block), net of investment expenses, which are typically reported in a table of closed block operations.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsNetResults.definition: Amount of net income (loss) from operations of the closed block.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsOtherRevenu.label: Closed Block Operations, Other Revenue
us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsOtherRevenu.definition: Amount of revenue classified as other allocated to the closed block.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsPremiums.label: Closed Block Operations, Premiums
us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsPremiums.definition: For the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block), revenue for the period from insurance policy premiums; typically included in a table of closed block operations.

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsRealizedInv.label: Closed Block Operations, Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsRealizedInv.definition: Gains and losses realized for the period from the investments allocated to an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts (known as a closed block).

us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsRevenue.label: Closed Block Operations, Revenue
us-gaap:ClosedBlockOperationsRevenue.definition: Total revenues from an insurance company's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block).

us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsShares.label: Common Stock Dividends, Shares
us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsShares.definition: Number of shares of common stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.definition: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:CommonStockValue.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
us-gaap:CommonStockValue.definition: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

us-gaap:Communication.label: Communication
us-gaap:Communication.definition: The amount of expense incurred in the period for communication, which is the exchange of information by several methods.

us-gaap:CommunicationsAndInformationTech.label: Communications and Information Technology
us-gaap:CommunicationsAndInformationTech.definition: The amount of expense in the period for communications and data processing expense.

us-gaap:CommunicationsInformationTechnol.label: Communications, Information Technology and Occupancy
us-gaap:CommunicationsInformationTechnol.definition: The aggregate amount of communications, data processing and occupancy expenses.

us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxAttri.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxAttri.definition: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxInclu.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxInclu.definition: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxInclu.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:CongressionallyMandatedFederalHo.label: Congressionally Mandated Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
