us-gaap:CongressionallyMandatedFederalHo.definition: Amount of expense for Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments, for example, but not limited to, Resolution Funding Corporation (REFCORP) assessments.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumul.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumul.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumul.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumul.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumul.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from recovery.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowan.definition: Amount of writeoff of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetCreditL.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetCreditL.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGross.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGross.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossCu.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossCu.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossNo.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossNo.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetIncreas.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Increase (Decrease) for Contract Acquired in Business Combination
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetIncreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from business combination.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetPurchas.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Purchase
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetPurchas.definition: Amount of increase from purchase of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on passage of time.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRev.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRev.definition: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableBe.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableCr.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerReceivableCr.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

us-gaap:ContractuallySpecifiedServicingF.label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fees, Amount
us-gaap:ContractuallySpecifiedServicingF.definition: All amounts that, per contract, are due to the servicer in exchange for servicing the financial asset and would no longer be received by a servicer if the beneficial owners of the serviced assets (or their trustees or agents) were to exercise their actual or potential authority under the contract to shift the servicing to another servicer. Depending on the servicing contract, those fees may include some or all of the difference between the interest rate collected on the asset being serviced and the rate to be paid to the beneficial owners of the asset.

us-gaap:ContractuallySpecifiedServicingF.label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee, Late Fee, and Ancillary Fee Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Asset
us-gaap:ContractuallySpecifiedServicingF.definition: Amount of contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and ancillary fee recognized as income for servicing asset and servicing liability.

us-gaap:ConversionGainsAndLossesOnForeig.label: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
us-gaap:ConversionGainsAndLossesOnForeig.definition: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

us-gaap:ConvertiblePreferredStockConvert.label: Convertible Preferred Stock Converted to Other Securities
us-gaap:ConvertiblePreferredStockConvert.definition: Value of convertible preferred stock that was converted to other securities.

us-gaap:CooperativeAdvertisingExpense.label: Cooperative Advertising Expense
us-gaap:CooperativeAdvertisingExpense.definition: Amount of expense under a cooperative advertising arrangement.

us-gaap:CostDepletion.label: Cost, Depletion
us-gaap:CostDepletion.definition: Cost of reduction in quantity of natural resource due to consumption directly related to good produced and service rendered.

us-gaap:CostDepreciationAmortizationAndD.label: Cost, Depreciation, Amortization and Depletion
us-gaap:CostDepreciationAmortizationAndD.definition: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives, and reduction in quantity of natural resource due to consumption directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

us-gaap:CostDirectLabor.label: Cost, Direct Labor
us-gaap:CostDirectLabor.definition: Cost of labor directly related to good produced and service rendered. Includes, but is not limited to, payroll cost and equity-based compensation.

us-gaap:CostDirectMaterial.label: Cost, Direct Material
us-gaap:CostDirectMaterial.definition: Cost of material used for good produced and service rendered.

us-gaap:CostMaintenance.label: Cost, Maintenance
us-gaap:CostMaintenance.definition: Cost of maintenance incurred and directly related to good produced and service rendered.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDe.label: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDe.definition: Cost of product sold and service rendered, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Product and Service Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.definition: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldAmorti.label: Cost, Amortization
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldAmorti.definition: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDeprec.label: Cost, Depreciation
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDeprec.definition: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDeprec.label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDeprec.definition: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldOverhe.label: Cost, Overhead
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldOverhe.definition: Indirect cost incurred related to good produced and service rendered.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsSoldDirectFinancingLe.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Direct Financing Lease
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsSoldDirectFinancingLe.definition: Cost of goods sold for direct financing lease.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsSoldSalesTypeLease.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Sales-type Lease
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsSoldSalesTypeLease.definition: Cost of goods sold for sales-type financing lease.

us-gaap:CostOfOtherPropertyOperatingExpe.label: Cost of Other Property Operating Expense
us-gaap:CostOfOtherPropertyOperatingExpe.definition: Other operating costs incurred during the reporting period and may include amounts paid to maintain the property.

us-gaap:CostOfPropertyRepairsAndMaintena.label: Cost of Property Repairs and Maintenance
us-gaap:CostOfPropertyRepairsAndMaintena.definition: The aggregate costs of keeping the property in good condition but that do not appreciably prolong the life or increase the value of the property.

us-gaap:CostOfPurchasedWater.label: Cost of Purchased Water
us-gaap:CostOfPurchasedWater.definition: Cost of water purchased, may include any water related assessment. If water is bought on a unit volume basis, would also be considered as commodity costs.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.definition: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:CostOfServicesCatering.label: Airline, Food and Beverage Expenses
us-gaap:CostOfServicesCatering.definition: Amount of expense for food and beverage served to airline passenger.

us-gaap:CostOfTrustAssetsSoldToPayExpens.label: Cost, Trust Asset Sold to Pay Expense
us-gaap:CostOfTrustAssetsSoldToPayExpens.definition: Cost of trust assets sold to pay trust expenses (includes commodities, but is not limited to, gold and silver).

us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses.label: Costs and Expenses
us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses.definition: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

us-gaap:CostsAndExpensesRelatedParty.label: Costs and Expenses, Related Party
us-gaap:CostsAndExpensesRelatedParty.definition: Costs of sales and operating expenses for the period incurred from transactions with related parties.

us-gaap:CostsOfFranchisedOutlets.label: Costs of Franchised Outlets
us-gaap:CostsOfFranchisedOutlets.definition: Costs incurred that are directly related to generating franchise revenues from franchised outlets.

us-gaap:CostsOfFranchisorOwnedOutlets.label: Costs of Franchisor Owned Outlets
us-gaap:CostsOfFranchisorOwnedOutlets.definition: Costs incurred that are directly related to generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetAddition.label: Crypto Asset, Addition
us-gaap:CryptoAssetAddition.definition: Amount of increase in crypto asset from addition. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetCustomerReceipt.label: Crypto Asset, Customer Receipt
us-gaap:CryptoAssetCustomerReceipt.definition: Amount of increase in crypto asset from customer receipt. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetDisposition.label: Crypto Asset, Disposition
us-gaap:CryptoAssetDisposition.definition: Amount of decrease in crypto asset from disposition. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetFairValue.definition: Fair value of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetMining.label: Crypto Asset, Mining
us-gaap:CryptoAssetMining.definition: Amount of increase in crypto asset from mining. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetNameExtensibleEnumera.label: Crypto Asset, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:CryptoAssetNameExtensibleEnumera.definition: Indicates name of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetPaymentForService.label: Crypto Asset, Payment for Service
us-gaap:CryptoAssetPaymentForService.definition: Amount of decrease in crypto asset from payment for service. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetPeriodIncreaseDecreas.label: Crypto Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:CryptoAssetPeriodIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetPurchase.label: Crypto Asset, Purchase
us-gaap:CryptoAssetPurchase.definition: Amount of increase in crypto asset from purchase. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Nonoperating [Abstract]
Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Nonoperating, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating [Abstract]
Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating and Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating and nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating and Nonoperating [Abstract]
Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain, Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain, Operating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Gain, Operating and Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating and nonoperating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Loss, Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.label: Crypto Asset, Realized and Unrealized Loss, Operating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealized.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetRollForward.label: Crypto Asset [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:CryptoAssetRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetSale.label: Crypto Asset, Sale
us-gaap:CryptoAssetSale.definition: Amount of decrease in crypto asset from sale. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainLossOpe.label: Crypto Asset, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Operating and Nonoperating
us-gaap:CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainLossOpe.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating and nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentN.label: Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentN.definition: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

us-gaap:CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentS.label: Cumulative Translation Adjustment Summary [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentS.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:CurrentFederalTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:CurrentFederalTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

us-gaap:CurrentForeignTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:CurrentForeignTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

us-gaap:CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

us-gaap:CurrentStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBe.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:CurrentStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBe.definition: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

us-gaap:CustodyFees.label: Custody Fees
us-gaap:CustodyFees.definition: Those fees charged for services related to holding, advising, and managing customer investment assets. These account fees usually charged annually or semi-annually, on a per security basis, for the costs of services.

us-gaap:CustomersLiabilityForAcceptances.label: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:CustomersLiabilityForAcceptances.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLoss.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLoss.definition: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedG.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedG.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesUnrealize.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesUnrealize.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount.label: Long-Term Debt, Gross
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount.definition: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleBenefic.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleBenefic.definition: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIncreaseAccruedInt.label: Debt Instrument, Increase, Accrued Interest
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIncreaseAccruedInt.definition: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the debt instrument for the period.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseOt.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseOt.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal.label: Debt Instrument, Issued, Principal
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal.definition: Amount of principal of debt issued.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentSinkingFundPayment.label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Payment
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentSinkingFundPayment.definition: Amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscoun.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscoun.definition: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

us-gaap:DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArr.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Gross
us-gaap:DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArr.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

us-gaap:DebtRelatedCommitmentFeesAndDebt.label: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
us-gaap:DebtRelatedCommitmentFeesAndDebt.definition: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not Previously Recorded
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of expense for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), for which no credit loss was previously recorded.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not to Sell before Recovery, Credit Loss, Previously Recorded, Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis, with previously recorded allowance.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Increase
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and beneficial interest, purchased with credit deterioration.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), from recovery.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Securities Sold
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from sale.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Sell before Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from intent to sell or more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAl.definition: Amount of writeoff of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAm.definition: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleCh.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleCh.definition: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not Previously Recorded
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with no credit loss previously recorded.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not to Sell before Recovery, Credit Loss, Previously Recorded, Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with previously recorded allowance and not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from recovery.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Sold
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from sale.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Sell before Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from intent to sell or more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from writeoff.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) purchased with credit deterioration.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer in, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred into held-to-maturity out of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer out, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleEx.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred out of available-for-sale into investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleGa.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleGa.definition: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Realized Gain
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.definition: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Realized Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRe.definition: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer in, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.definition: Amount of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred into held-to-maturity out of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer out, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.definition: Amount of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred out of available-for-sale into investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Trading, Gain
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.definition: Amount of unrealized gain recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Trading, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Trading, Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTr.definition: Amount of unrealized loss recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUn.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUn.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesGainLoss.label: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesGainLoss.definition: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.
Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Increase
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and beneficial interest, purchased with credit deterioration.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from recovery.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllo.definition: Amount of writeoff of investment in debt security, measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChan.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChan.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in methodology.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChan.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChan.definition: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityCred.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityCred.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from recovery.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from writeoff.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from change in methodology.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) purchased with credit deterioration.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Sale
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from sale.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer in, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred into available-for-sale out of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer out, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcl.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred out of held-to-maturity into investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityNona.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityNona.definition: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), on nonaccrual status.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPurc.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Purchase
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPurc.definition: Amount of increase from purchase of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturitySale.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Sale
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturitySale.definition: Amount of decrease from sale of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturitySold.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Sold, Derivative Hedge, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturitySold.definition: Amount of gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), sold.

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer, Derivative Hedge, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.definition: Amount of gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), transferred to investment in debt security measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer in, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.definition: Amount of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred into available-for-sale out of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer out, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityTran.definition: Amount of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred out of held-to-maturity into investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingGainLoss.definition: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedGai.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedGai.definition: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedGai.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedGai.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedLos.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingRealizedLos.definition: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedG.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedG.definition: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedG.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedG.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedL.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Loss
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingUnrealizedL.definition: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLos.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Asset Sales, Net
us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLos.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on asset sales, reported as a reorganization item.

us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLos.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Settlement of Other Claims, Net
us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLos.definition: Amount of net gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsImpairm.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsImpairm.definition: Amount of reorganization items related to impairment loss.

us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsInteres.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Interest Income on Accumulated Cash
us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsInteres.definition: Amount of interest income on accumulated cash, reported as a reorganization item.

us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsNetGain.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Net Gain (Loss) on Rejection of Leases and Other Executory Contracts
us-gaap:DebtorReorganizationItemsNetGain.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on rejection of leases and other executory contracts, reported as a reorganization item.

us-gaap:DeconsolidationGainOrLossAmount.label: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
us-gaap:DeconsolidationGainOrLossAmount.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

us-gaap:DeconsolidationRevaluationOfReta.label: Deconsolidation, Revaluation of Retained Investment, Gain (Loss), Amount
us-gaap:DeconsolidationRevaluationOfReta.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement to fair value of retained investment in former subsidiary and group of assets constituting business or nonprofit activity deconsolidated and derecognized, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of product or service in contract with customer.

us-gaap:DeferredCompensationArrangementW.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense
us-gaap:DeferredCompensationArrangementW.definition: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. Excludes amount related to plans that cover generally all employees (for example, but not limited to, qualified pension plans).

us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingAccumulatedA.label: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingAccumulatedA.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingGross.label: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, before Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

us-gaap:DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseB.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseB.definition: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsCurrentGross.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross, Current
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsCurrentGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsGross.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentGr.label: Debt Issuance Cost, Gross, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentGr.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnShareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnShareLend.definition: Amount of expense for amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: The cumulative amount of amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement which has been periodically charged to earnings, generally as a component of interest expense, during the term of the arrangement.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization Adjustment
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with a share-lending arrangement.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Adjustment
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: The amount of any adjustment recognized to the balance of unamortized issuance costs associated with a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, due, for example, to default by the share borrower.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accumulated amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement.

us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Gross
us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLend.definition: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, before deduction of accumulated amortization or effects of subsequent adjustments.

us-gaap:DeferredForeignIncomeTaxExpenseB.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:DeferredForeignIncomeTaxExpenseB.definition: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

us-gaap:DeferredIncome.definition: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeAddition.label: Deferred Income, Addition
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeAddition.definition: Amount of increase in deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeCustomerExtensible.label: Deferred Income, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeCustomerExtensible.definition: Indicates customer for deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeGeographicalExtens.label: Deferred Income, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeGeographicalExtens.definition: Indicates geographical component for deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomePeriodIncreaseDecr.label: Deferred Income, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DeferredIncomePeriodIncreaseDecr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeProductAndServiceE.label: Deferred Income, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeProductAndServiceE.definition: Indicates product and service for deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeRevenueRecognized.label: Deferred Income, Revenue Recognized
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeRevenueRecognized.definition: Amount of revenue recognized previously reported as deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeRollForward.label: Deferred Income [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DeferredIncomeSegmentExtensibleE.label: Deferred Income, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredIncomeSegmentExtensibleE.definition: Indicates segment that includes deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:DeferredOtherTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:DeferredOtherTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmo.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmo.definition: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Experience Adjustment
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.definition: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized amount in deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future profit from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.definition: Indicates geographical component for deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.definition: Indicates customer for deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.definition: Indicates product and service for deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAnd.definition: Indicates segment that includes deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostCus.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostCus.definition: Indicates customer for deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostExp.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Experience Adjustment
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostExp.definition: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostFor.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment and Other
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostFor.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost due to the effect of foreign currency translation gain (loss) and increase (decrease) classified as other.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostFor.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostFor.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) deferred policy acquisition costs.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostGeo.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostGeo.definition: Indicates geographical component for deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostPro.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostPro.definition: Indicates product and service for deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostSeg.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostSeg.definition: Indicates segment that includes deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts.definition: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAd.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Capitalization
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAd.definition: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Disposition
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.definition: Amount of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination, disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Addition
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.definition: Amount of addition in deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAn.definition: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.
Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.
Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDi.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Disposition
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDi.definition: Amount of deferred policy acquisition costs disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPe.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostCustom.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostCustom.definition: Indicates customer for deferred sale inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostExperi.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Experience Adjustment
us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostExperi.definition: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized deferred sale inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostGeogra.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostGeogra.definition: Indicates geographical component for deferred sale inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostProduc.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostProduc.definition: Indicates product and service for deferred sale inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostSegmen.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DeferredSaleInducementCostSegmen.definition: Indicates segment that includes deferred sale inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementCostDispo.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Disposition
us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementCostDispo.definition: Amount of deferred sales inducement cost disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementCostForei.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementCostForei.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) deferred sales inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAddition.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Capitalization
us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAddition.definition: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustme.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Other Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustme.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred sales inducement cost, classified as other.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAmortiza.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsAmortiza.definition: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred sales inducement cost.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsNet.definition: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

us-gaap:DeferredSalesInducementsPeriodIn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in unamortized deferred sales inducement costs.

us-gaap:DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxEx.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxEx.definition: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.
