us-gaap:DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveD.label: Deferred Storm and Property Reserve Deficiency, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveD.definition: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized storm costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsGross.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsGross.definition: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowa.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowa.definition: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBen.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBen.definition: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBen.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBen.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated benefit obligation from change in existing term of defined benefit plan or initiation of new defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOth.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOth.definition: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Sold
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets sold.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Still Held
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOn.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets still held.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialGainL.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialGainL.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAdministration.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Administration Expense
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAdministration.definition: Amount of administration expense of defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. Excludes plan administration expense paid by employer.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTransfer.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTransfer.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Benefits Paid
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Contributions by Plan Participant
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increase benefit obligation.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Remeasurement due to Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from remeasurement due to settlement. Excludes decrease to benefit obligation for settlement payment.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Payment for Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of payment, which decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract. Excludes decreases to benefit obligation for remeasurement due to settlement.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligat.definition: Amount, before benefit payment, of receipt from prescription drug subsidy which increases benefit obligation of defined benefit postretirement plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombin.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Business Combination
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombin.definition: Amount of increase in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from business combination.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombin.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Business Combination
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombin.definition: Amount of increase in plan assets of defined benefit plan from business combination.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInBenefi.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Benefit Obligation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInBenefi.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Fair Value of Plan Assets, Level 3 Reconciliation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Fair Value of Plan Assets [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairVa.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsB.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsB.definition: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanCurtailments.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Curtailment
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanCurtailments.definition: Amount of (increase) decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresBe.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Divestiture
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresBe.definition: Amount of decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresPl.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Divestiture
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresPl.definition: Amount of decrease in plan assets of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPla.definition: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPla.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPla.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanForeignCurrenc.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanForeignCurrenc.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanInterestCost.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanInterestCost.definition: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanOtherChanges.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanOtherChanges.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change, classified as other.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAmendments.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAmendments.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsBene.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsBene.definition: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsCont.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Plan Participant
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsCont.definition: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increases plan assets.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsFair.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Fair Value by Hierarchy and NAV [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsFair.definition: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient, of defined benefit plan asset.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsFore.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsFore.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease for Sale
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of decrease in plan asset of defined benefit plan from sale.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease for Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of decrease in plan asset of defined benefit plan from settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase for Purchase
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsLeve.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsPres.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsPres.definition: Amount of receipt from prescription drug subsidy which increases plan assets of defined benefit postretirement plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPurchasesSales.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanPurchasesSales.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase (decrease) in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase, sale and settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetG.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetG.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanServiceCost.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanServiceCost.definition: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsBen.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsBen.definition: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Includes, but is not limited to, lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for right to receive specified benefits, purchase of nonparticipating annuity contract and change from remeasurement.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsPla.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Payment for Settlement
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsPla.definition: Amount of payment, which decreases plan assets of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSpecialTermina.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanSpecialTermina.definition: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanTransfersBetwe.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanTransfersBetwe.definition: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

us-gaap:DemutualizationCostAndExpense.label: Demutualization Cost and Expense
us-gaap:DemutualizationCostAndExpense.definition: The costs and expenses incurred pertaining to the reorganization process to convert a mutual entity to a stock company.

us-gaap:Depletion.label: Depletion
us-gaap:Depletion.definition: The noncash expense charged against earnings to recognize the consumption of natural resources.

us-gaap:DepletionOfOilAndGasProperties.label: Depletion of Oil and Gas Properties
us-gaap:DepletionOfOilAndGasProperties.definition: The noncash expense charged against earnings to recognize the consumption of oil and gas reserves that are part of an entities' assets.

us-gaap:Depreciation.label: Depreciation
us-gaap:Depreciation.definition: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccre.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccre.definition: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization.definition: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortizationDisco.label: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortizationDisco.definition: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortiza.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortiza.definition: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

us-gaap:DepreciationExcludingLessorAsset.label: Depreciation, Excluding Lessor Asset under Operating Lease
us-gaap:DepreciationExcludingLessorAsset.definition: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of depreciation expense.

us-gaap:DepreciationExpenseOnReclassifie.label: Long-Lived Asset, Change to Plan of Sale, Reclassification from Held-for-Sale to Held-and-Used, Depreciation Expense
us-gaap:DepreciationExpenseOnReclassifie.definition: Amount of depreciation expense for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

us-gaap:DepreciationNonproduction.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
us-gaap:DepreciationNonproduction.definition: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

us-gaap:DerivativeExcludedComponentGainL.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
us-gaap:DerivativeExcludedComponentGainL.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

us-gaap:DerivativeExcludedComponentGainR.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain, Recognized in Earnings
us-gaap:DerivativeExcludedComponentGainR.definition: Amount of gain from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueHedgeIncluded.label: Derivative, Fair Value Hedge, Included in Effectiveness, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueHedgeIncluded.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as fair value hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNe.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:DerivativeGainOnDerivative.label: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
us-gaap:DerivativeGainOnDerivative.definition: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignat.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignat.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:DerivativeLossOnDerivative.label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
us-gaap:DerivativeLossOnDerivative.definition: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHe.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
us-gaap:DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHe.definition: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings from the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHe.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHe.definition: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from transactions on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:DevelopmentCosts.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Development Cost, Period Cost
us-gaap:DevelopmentCosts.definition: Amount of capitalized development cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:DevelopmentCostsCumulative.definition: Amount of capitalized development cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:DevelopmentProfitsNonoperating.label: Development Profits, Nonoperating
us-gaap:DevelopmentProfitsNonoperating.definition: Income recognized during the period from participation in unconsolidated joint ventures engaged in real estate development (such as the building upon or otherwise improving property).

us-gaap:DirectCommunicationsAndUtilities.definition: The aggregate costs of direct communications and utilities incurred during the reporting period.

us-gaap:DirectCostsOfLeasedAndRentedProp.label: Direct Costs of Leased and Rented Property or Equipment
us-gaap:DirectCostsOfLeasedAndRentedProp.definition: Amount of expense incurred and directly related to generating revenue by lessor from operating lease of rented property and equipment.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseImpairmentLo.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseImpairmentLo.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseInterestInco.label: Direct Financing Lease, Interest Income
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseInterestInco.definition: Amount of interest income from net investment in direct financing lease.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseLeaseIncome.label: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Income
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseLeaseIncome.definition: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income on direct financing lease and after offset of loss recognized at commencement.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.
Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease, classified as noncurrent.
Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease, from recovery.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.
Amount of writeoff of net investment in direct financing lease, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on net investment in direct financing lease, from change in methodology.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmen.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseRevenue.label: Direct Financing Lease, Revenue
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseRevenue.definition: Amount of direct financing lease revenue.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseSellingLoss.label: Direct Financing Lease, Selling Loss
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseSellingLoss.definition: Amount of loss recognized at commencement from direct financing lease.

us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseVariableLeas.label: Direct Financing Lease, Variable Lease Income
us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseVariableLeas.definition: Amount of direct financing lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

us-gaap:DirectOperatingCommunicationsCos.label: Direct Operating Communications Costs
us-gaap:DirectOperatingCommunicationsCos.definition: Communications costs incurred and are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:DirectOperatingCosts.label: Direct Operating Costs
us-gaap:DirectOperatingCosts.definition: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

us-gaap:DirectOperatingMaintenanceSuppli.label: Direct Operating Maintenance Supplies Costs
us-gaap:DirectOperatingMaintenanceSuppli.definition: Costs of maintenance supplies used that are directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

us-gaap:DirectPremiumsEarned.label: Direct Premiums Earned
us-gaap:DirectPremiumsEarned.definition: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

us-gaap:DirectPremiumsWritten.label: Direct Premiums Written
us-gaap:DirectPremiumsWritten.definition: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

us-gaap:DirectTaxesAndLicensesCosts.label: Cost, Direct Tax and License
us-gaap:DirectTaxesAndLicensesCosts.definition: Amount of tax incurred and cost of license directly related to good produced or service rendered.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedApplicationOfSpecial.label: Discontinued Application of Specialized Accounting for Regulated Operations
us-gaap:DiscontinuedApplicationOfSpecial.definition: Net effect of discontinued application of the specialized accounting to all or part of its operations; the entity eliminates from its statement of financial position prepared for general-purpose external financial reporting the effects of any actions of regulators that had been recognized as assets and liabilities pursuant to that specialized accounting but would not have been recognized as assets and liabilities by entities in general except for carrying amounts of plant, equipment, and inventory measured and reported pursuant to that specialized accounting unless those assets are impaired, in which case the carrying amounts of those assets is reduced to reflect that impairment. This element is gross of the related tax effect.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationAmountOfAdj.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal, before Income Tax
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationAmountOfAdj.definition: Amount before tax of an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.
Amount after tax of an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossFro.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossFro.definition: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnD.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnD.definition: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationProvisionFo.label: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationProvisionFo.definition: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationProvisionFo.label: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, Net of Tax
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationProvisionFo.definition: Amount after tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOf.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxExpenseB.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax (Expense) Benefit from Provision for (Gain) Loss on Disposal
us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxExpenseB.definition: Amount of tax (expense) benefit on (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Costs of Goods Sold
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of costs of goods sold attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of depreciation and amortization expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Foreign Currency Translation Gains (Losses)
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) in the disposal group, including discontinued operation, recognized in the statement of income as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of general and administrative expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Expense
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of interest expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Income
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of interest income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Expense
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of other expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Income
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of other income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Rental Income
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of rental income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinu.definition: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOper.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOper.definition: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOper.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOper.definition: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

us-gaap:DistributionMadeToLimitedLiabili.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid
us-gaap:DistributionMadeToLimitedLiabili.definition: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

us-gaap:DistributionMadeToLimitedPartner.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
us-gaap:DistributionMadeToLimitedPartner.definition: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

us-gaap:DistributionsOnMandatorilyRedeem.label: Payment for Distribution on Mandatorily Redeemable Financial Instrument, Liability Classified
us-gaap:DistributionsOnMandatorilyRedeem.definition: Amount of distribution on mandatorily redeemable financial instrument issued in form of share classified as liability.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeEquitySecuritiesOp.label: Dividend Income, Equity Securities, Operating
us-gaap:DividendIncomeEquitySecuritiesOp.definition: Amount of dividend income on investment in equity security, classified as operating.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating.label: Dividend Income, Operating
us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating.definition: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInCas.label: Dividend Income, Operating, Paid in Cash
us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInCas.definition: Amount of dividend income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInKin.label: Dividend Income, Operating, Paid in Kind
us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInKin.definition: Amount of dividend income from investment paid in kind, classified as operating.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Advantaged
us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.definition: Amount of operating dividend income on securities subject to tax benefits. Excludes operating dividend income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.definition: Amount of operating dividend income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
us-gaap:DividendIncomeSecuritiesOperatin.definition: Amount of operating dividend income on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:Dividends.label: Dividends
us-gaap:Dividends.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

us-gaap:DividendsCash.label: Dividends, Cash
us-gaap:DividendsCash.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

us-gaap:DividendsCommonStock.label: Dividends, Common Stock
us-gaap:DividendsCommonStock.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockCash.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockCash.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockPaidinkind.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Paid-in-kind
us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockPaidinkind.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockStock.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockStock.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

us-gaap:DividendsPaidinkind.label: Dividends, Paid-in-kind
us-gaap:DividendsPaidinkind.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends (PIK) declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStock.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStock.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockCash.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockCash.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockPaidinkin.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Paid-in-kind
us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockPaidinkin.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockStock.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockStock.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

us-gaap:DividendsShareBasedCompensation.label: Dividend, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
us-gaap:DividendsShareBasedCompensation.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:DividendsShareBasedCompensationC.label: Dividend, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Cash
us-gaap:DividendsShareBasedCompensationC.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:DividendsSharebasedCompensationP.label: Dividend, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Paid-in-Kind
us-gaap:DividendsSharebasedCompensationP.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:DividendsSharebasedCompensationS.label: Dividend, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Shares
us-gaap:DividendsSharebasedCompensationS.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:DividendsStock.label: Dividends, Stock
us-gaap:DividendsStock.definition: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

us-gaap:EarlyRepaymentOfSeniorDebt.label: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
us-gaap:EarlyRepaymentOfSeniorDebt.definition: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

us-gaap:EarlyRepaymentOfSubordinatedDebt.label: Early Repayment of Subordinated Debt
us-gaap:EarlyRepaymentOfSubordinatedDebt.definition: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets before its maturity.

us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbe.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbe.definition: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeGainOnEmbedded.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain on Embedded Derivative
us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeGainOnEmbedded.definition: Increase in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeLossOnEmbedded.label: Embedded Derivative, Loss on Embedded Derivative
us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeLossOnEmbedded.definition: Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCom.label: Employee Benefits and Share-Based Compensation
us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCom.definition: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCom.label: Employee Benefit and Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCom.definition: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompens.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompens.definition: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EntertainmentLicenseAgreementFor.label: Entertainment, License Agreement for Program Material, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:EntertainmentLicenseAgreementFor.definition: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for right acquired by broadcaster under license agreement for program material.

us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapi.label: Environmental Costs Recognized, Capitalized
us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapi.definition: Amount of costs recognized in the balance sheet for known or estimated future costs arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites.

us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapi.label: Environmental Costs Recognized, Capitalized in Period
us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapi.definition: Amount of environmental remediation costs capitalized. These expenditures may relate to long-lived improvements in operating facilities.

us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedReco.label: Environmental Remediation Expense, Recovery
us-gaap:EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedReco.definition: Amount of expense recovery for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

us-gaap:EnvironmentalLossContingencyStat.label: Environmental Loss Contingency, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:EnvironmentalLossContingencyStat.definition: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrual for environmental loss contingency.

us-gaap:EnvironmentalRemediationExpense.label: Environmental Remediation Expense, before Recovery
us-gaap:EnvironmentalRemediationExpense.definition: Amount, before recovery, of expense for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

us-gaap:EquipmentExpense.label: Equipment Expense
us-gaap:EquipmentExpense.definition: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Debt Modification, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as debt extinguishment or troubled debt restructuring related to debt modification. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Debt Origination, Increase in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.definition: Amount of increase in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as debt discount or debt issuance cost related to debt origination. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount
us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.definition: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for modification of freestanding written call option classified as equity. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Dividend, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as dividend. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Equity Issuance, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as equity issuance cost. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanT.label: Equity Method Investment, Other-than-Temporary Impairment
us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanT.definition: Amount of other-than-temporary decline in value that has been recognized against investment accounted for under equity method of accounting.

us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGa.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGa.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNo.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNo.definition: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss.definition: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGain.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGain.definition: Amount of realized gain from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGain.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGain.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Loss
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedLoss.definition: Amount of realized loss from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGa.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGa.definition: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGa.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGa.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedLo.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Loss
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedLo.definition: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDe.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Downward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDe.definition: Amount of loss from downward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDe.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Annual Amount
us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDe.definition: Amount of impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

us-gaap:EscrowDeposit.label: Escrow Deposit
us-gaap:EscrowDeposit.definition: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

us-gaap:EscrowDepositsRelatedToPropertyS.label: Escrow Deposits Related to Property Sales
us-gaap:EscrowDepositsRelatedToPropertyS.definition: Escrow deposits related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

us-gaap:ExchangeFees.label: Exchange Fees
us-gaap:ExchangeFees.definition: The amount of expense in the period for fees charged by securities exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on that exchange. Some fees vary with the related volume, while others are fixed.

us-gaap:ExciseAndSalesTaxes.label: Excise and Sales Taxes
us-gaap:ExciseAndSalesTaxes.definition: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

us-gaap:ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrSe.label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
us-gaap:ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrSe.definition: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

us-gaap:ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairm.label: Impairment, Oil and Gas, Property with Unproved Reserve
us-gaap:ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairm.definition: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

us-gaap:ExplorationCosts.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Exploration Cost, Period Cost
us-gaap:ExplorationCosts.definition: Amount of capitalized exploration cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:ExplorationCostsCumulative.definition: Amount of capitalized exploration cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

us-gaap:ExplorationExpense.label: Exploration Expense
us-gaap:ExplorationExpense.definition: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrual.definition: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate extended product warranty liability. Does not include the ending balance for the standard product warranty liability.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualAd.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualAd.definition: Amount of increase in liability for extended product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for standard warranty acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualFo.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualFo.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the extended product warranty accrual. Excludes standard product warranties.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPa.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPa.definition: Amount of decrease in the extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the extended product warranty. Excludes standard product warranties.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty liability. Excludes standard product warranties.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPr.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes standard product warranties.

us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualWa.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
us-gaap:ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualWa.definition: Amount of increase in the extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes standard product warranties.

us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossNetO.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossNetO.definition: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAsset.definition: Carrying amount of receivable assets originating from the indemnification agreement with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), in which the FDIC is to partially cover losses.

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAccretio.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Accretion of Discount
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAccretio.definition: Increases to the indemnification asset due to accretion of the loan discount relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAcquisit.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Acquisitions
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAcquisit.definition: Amount of increases to the indemnification asset due to acquisitions of assets relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAddition.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Additional Estimated Losses
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetAddition.definition: Amount of increases to the indemnification asset due to additional estimated losses assumed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), relating to loss sharing agreements with the FDIC.

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetCashPaym.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Cash Payments Received
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetCashPaym.definition: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to cash payments received relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetDisposal.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Disposals
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetDisposal.definition: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to disposals relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetNetWrite.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Writeoff, Net
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetNetWrite.definition: Amount, after recovery, of decrease to indemnification asset from writeoff of loan in loss sharing agreement with Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetPeriodIn.definition: Change in carrying amount of the indemnification asset relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). The change includes for example, but is not limited to, acquisitions, additional estimated losses, disposals, cash payments, accretion of discount and write-offs, net of recoveries.

us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetRollForw.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetRollForw.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants.label: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants.definition: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

us-gaap:FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurring.label: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurring.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurring.label: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
us-gaap:FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurring.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStil.label: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
us-gaap:FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStil.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMea.label: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
us-gaap:FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMea.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueAssetsMeasuredOnRecurri.label: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueAssetsMeasuredOnRecurri.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueAssetsMeasuredOnRecurri.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Calculation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FairValueAssetsMeasuredOnRecurri.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRe.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRe.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRe.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Calculation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRe.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasis.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
us-gaap:FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasis.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers Into Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers out of Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Issuances
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements) [Abstract]
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Sales
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of sale of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Settlements
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of settlement of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Transfers Into Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net [Abstract]
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers out of Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as an asset out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.
Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Issuances
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements) [Abstract]
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Sales
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Transfers, Net
us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Transfers, Net [Abstract]

us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobserv.definition: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.
