us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Issues
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases, Sales, Issues, Settlements
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases, Sales, Issues, Settlements [Abstract]
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Sales
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Settlements
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability, measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers into Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net [Abstract]
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers out of Level 3
us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabi.definition: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

Fair value of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) from asset measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Asset, Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes gain (loss) from asset measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) from liability measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Liability, Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes gain (loss) from liability measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:FairValueRecurringBasisUnobserva.definition: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes gain (loss) from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3).

us-gaap:FederalDepositInsuranceCorporati.label: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense
us-gaap:FederalDepositInsuranceCorporati.definition: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.

us-gaap:FederalHomeLoanBankAssessments.definition: Amount of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments and Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments.

us-gaap:FeeIncome.label: Fee Income
us-gaap:FeeIncome.definition: Amount of fee income including, but not limited to, managerial assistance, servicing of investment, and origination and commitment fees.

us-gaap:FeeIncomeOnAcceptancesExecuted.label: Fee Income on Acceptances Executed
us-gaap:FeeIncomeOnAcceptancesExecuted.definition: Amount of amortization to income from discounts on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances).

us-gaap:FeesAndCommissionsMortgageBankin.label: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking and Servicing
us-gaap:FeesAndCommissionsMortgageBankin.definition: Income from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions) and servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others net of any related impairment of capitalized service costs. Also includes any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans.

us-gaap:FilmMonetizedInFilmGroupAmortiza.label: Film, Monetized in Film Group, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:FilmMonetizedInFilmGroupAmortiza.definition: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized with other films and license agreements.

us-gaap:FilmMonetizedOnItsOwnAmortizatio.label: Film, Monetized on Its Own, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:FilmMonetizedOnItsOwnAmortizatio.definition: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized on its own.

us-gaap:FilmMonetizedOnItsOwnAndFilmGrou.label: Film, Monetized on Its Own, and Film Group, Impairment
us-gaap:FilmMonetizedOnItsOwnAndFilmGrou.definition: Amount of impairment loss on capitalized cost for film predominantly monetized on its own and film group.

us-gaap:FilmMonetizedOnItsOwnAndFilmMone.definition: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized on its own and film predominantly monetized with other films and license agreements.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseImpairmentLoss.label: Finance Lease, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseImpairmentLoss.definition: Amount of impairment loss from right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestExpense.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestExpense.definition: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLia.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLia.definition: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

us-gaap:FinanceLeasePrincipalPayments.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
us-gaap:FinanceLeasePrincipalPayments.definition: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset.definition: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAccum.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAccum.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmort.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmort.definition: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetBefor.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetBefor.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of the premium receivable for financial guarantee insurance contracts reported in the statement of financial position. This element primarily would consist of those financial guarantee insurance contracts which premiums are to be collected over the contract period, but may, on occasion, include premiums which are to be collected in full at inception, but which straddle a financial reporting period.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts Premium Receivable New Business Written
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of new business written on financial guarantee insurance contracts.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premium Receivable, Proceeds from Premiums Received
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of cash inflow from premiums received for premium receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premium Receivable [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment, Accretion of Discount on Premium Receivable
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of accretion of the discount for premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustments due to changes in the period of the contract, accretion of the discount on the premiums receivable, and adjustments classified as other. Excludes new business written and proceeds from premiums.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment [Abstract]
Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Increase (Decrease), Change in Period of Contract
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the premium receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts from changes in the period of the contract.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment, Change in Period of Contract, Explanation
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: This element represents an explanation of the reasons for the adjustment to the premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts arising from a change in assumptions affecting the contract period.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Increase (Decrease), Other Adjustments
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts from adjustments classified as other.

us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment, Other Adjustments, Explanation
us-gaap:FinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContr.definition: This element represents an explanation of other significant or recurring adjustments made during the period to premiums receivable related to financial guarantee insurance contracts.
Amount of increase (decrease) in the premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts.

us-gaap:FinancingInterestExpense.label: Financing Interest Expense
us-gaap:FinancingInterestExpense.definition: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Foreign Currency Translation
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Other Purchased Loan
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased loan classified as other. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, purchased seasoned loan, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Loan Sold
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased Seasoned Loan
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased seasoned loan.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.
Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForC.definition: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableChangeInMetho.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableChangeInMetho.definition: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable from change in methodology. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableChangeInPrese.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableChangeInPrese.definition: Amount of interest income on financing receivable from change in present value of expected cash flows attributable to passage of time. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableCoveredAllowa.label: Financing Receivable, Covered, Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableCoveredAllowa.definition: Amount of allowance for finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableCoveredBefore.label: Financing Receivable, Covered, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableCoveredBefore.definition: Amount, before allowance, of finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Loan Purchased
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from purchase of loan. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Loan Sold
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff (Recovery)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease (increase) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff (recovery). Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff (Recovery) [Abstract]
Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable from change in methodology. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified, Accumulated
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Accumulated amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified, Increase (Decrease) from Modification
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified in Period, Amount
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer in, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred into held-for-investment out of held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Transfer out, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccr.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred out of held-for-investment into held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableNonaccrualInt.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableNonaccrualInt.definition: Amount of interest income on financing receivable on nonaccrual status.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSale.label: Financing Receivable, Sale
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSale.definition: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSignificantPu.label: Financing Receivable, Purchase
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSignificantPu.definition: Amount of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSignificantSa.label: Financing Receivable, Sale and Reclassification to Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableSignificantSa.definition: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableTransferToHel.label: Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Investment, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableTransferToHel.definition: Amount of expense for allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-investment classification.

us-gaap:FinancingReceivableTransferToHel.label: Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
us-gaap:FinancingReceivableTransferToHel.definition: Amount of expense reversal of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccum.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccum.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsCostI.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Cost Incurred to Renew or Extend
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsCostI.definition: Amount of cost incurred and capitalized to renew or extend term of recognized finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForei.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForei.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.definition: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPerio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPurch.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Measurement Period Adjustment
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPurch.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollF.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollF.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTrans.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTrans.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTrans.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments [Abstract]

us-gaap:FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcqui.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Acquired
us-gaap:FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcqui.definition: Amount of increase in finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:FlightEquipmentAccumulatedDeprec.label: Airline, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Flight Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:FlightEquipmentAccumulatedDeprec.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FlightEquipmentGross.label: Airline, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Flight Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:FlightEquipmentGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:FloorBrokerage.label: Floor Brokerage
us-gaap:FloorBrokerage.definition: Broker-dealers often use other brokers to execute trades on their behalf. The trading broker-dealer becomes a customer of the executing broker-dealer and pays a floor brokerage fee. Such fees are paid periodically either directly to the executing broker-dealer or through a clearing house.

us-gaap:FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearan.label: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
us-gaap:FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearan.definition: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

us-gaap:ForInformationOnUsingExtensibleE.label: For information on using Extensible Enumeration elements, see guide at link in tin-part URI [Guidance]

us-gaap:ForeclosedRealEstateExpense.label: Foreclosed Real Estate Expense
us-gaap:ForeclosedRealEstateExpense.definition: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainBe.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainBe.definition: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized gain recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax [Abstract]
Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, after Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, Excluding Investment Price Change, before Tax
us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLo.definition: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction excluding unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsCl.label: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Claims Recognized as Income
us-gaap:ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsCl.definition: Amounts for insured risks on policies that have been ceded to entities outside the United States and for which claims income is paid or due and owing to the ceding entity.

us-gaap:FranchisorCosts.definition: Aggregate costs incurred that are directly related to activities, including but not limited to, generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets and franchised outlets.

us-gaap:FuelCosts.label: Fuel Costs
us-gaap:FuelCosts.definition: Fuel costs incurred that are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
us-gaap:GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.definition: The gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
us-gaap:GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.definition: Gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:GainFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQ.label: Gain from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
us-gaap:GainFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQ.definition: Amount of gain recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

us-gaap:GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFr.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness, Net
us-gaap:GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFr.definition: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFr.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net
us-gaap:GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFr.definition: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitment.label: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Net
us-gaap:GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitment.definition: Amount of net gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

us-gaap:GainLossFromPriceRiskManagementA.label: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
us-gaap:GainLossFromPriceRiskManagementA.definition: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

us-gaap:GainLossOnCondemnation.label: Gain (Loss) on Condemnation
us-gaap:GainLossOnCondemnation.definition: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

us-gaap:GainLossOnContractTermination.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
us-gaap:GainLossOnContractTermination.definition: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsH.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsH.definition: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsN.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsN.definition: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashF.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
us-gaap:GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashF.definition: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfIntangibl.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfIntangibl.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherFina.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherFina.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstat.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Real Estate, Discontinued Operations
us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstat.definition: Amount of difference between the carrying amount and the sales price of real estate properties sold as part of discontinued operations.

us-gaap:GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecogni.label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings
us-gaap:GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecogni.definition: Total amount of gain (loss) derived from fair value hedges recognized in earnings in the period.

us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivat.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivat.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivat.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives Recorded in Earnings, Net
us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivat.definition: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. Includes impact of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness and the ineffectiveness of fair value hedging derivatives and full change in fair value of the foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairVal.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
us-gaap:GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairVal.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

us-gaap:GainLossOnInterestRateDerivative.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
us-gaap:GainLossOnInterestRateDerivative.definition: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeIns.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
us-gaap:GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeIns.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativesNe.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
us-gaap:GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativesNe.definition: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

us-gaap:GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstru.label: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
us-gaap:GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstru.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfAccountsReceivab.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfAccountsReceivab.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfCommodityContrac.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Commodity Contracts
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfCommodityContrac.definition: The difference between the book value and the sale price of agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives.definition: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInsuranceBlock.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Insurance Block
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInsuranceBlock.definition: Excess (deficiency) of net proceeds received over the net carrying value of a certain, bundled grouping of insurance policies.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjec.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjec.definition: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetO.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetO.definition: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.definition: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.definition: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasPropert.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasPropert.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.definition: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLea.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLea.definition: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissu.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissu.definition: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperties.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperties.definition: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperty.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperty.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEqu.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEqu.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProvedProperty.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Proved Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProvedProperty.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property with proven oil and gas reserves.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiar.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiar.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfTimberProperty.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Timber Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfTimberProperty.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property used for growing and harvesting trees.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPay.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPay.definition: Gain (loss) related to the sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfUnprovedProperty.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Unproved Property
us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfUnprovedProperty.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property without proven oil and gas reserves.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetI.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetI.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfConsumerLoans.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfConsumerLoans.definition: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.definition: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedS.definition: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

us-gaap:GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinanc.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
us-gaap:GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinanc.definition: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

us-gaap:GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
us-gaap:GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

us-gaap:GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransf.label: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account
us-gaap:GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransf.definition: Amount of net gains or losses recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

us-gaap:GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettl.label: Gain (Loss) from Litigation Settlement
us-gaap:GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettl.definition: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

us-gaap:GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsura.label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
us-gaap:GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsura.definition: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

us-gaap:GainOnDerivativeInstrumentsPreta.label: Gain on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
us-gaap:GainOnDerivativeInstrumentsPreta.definition: Aggregate gain on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

us-gaap:GainOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowH.label: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
us-gaap:GainOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowH.definition: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnis.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Equity Investee
us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnis.definition: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnis.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary
us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnis.definition: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidi.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
us-gaap:GainOrLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidi.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

us-gaap:GainRecognizedOnAssetsTransferre.label: Gain Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
us-gaap:GainRecognizedOnAssetsTransferre.definition: Amount of gain recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDeb.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDeb.definition: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDeb.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Debt Issuance Cost Writeoff
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDeb.definition: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnRestructuringOfDebt.label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnRestructuringOfDebt.definition: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfCreditCardPo.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfCreditCardPo.definition: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRe.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRe.definition: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEst.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEst.definition: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

us-gaap:GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.label: General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.definition: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

us-gaap:GeneralInsuranceExpense.label: General Insurance Expense
us-gaap:GeneralInsuranceExpense.definition: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

us-gaap:GeneralPartnerDistributions.label: General Partner Distributions
us-gaap:GeneralPartnerDistributions.definition: Distributions from earnings to the general partner of a partnership included in the consolidated financial statements.

us-gaap:GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDis.label: General Partners' Capital Account, Period Distribution Amount
us-gaap:GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDis.definition: The total amount of distributions to the general partner during the period.

us-gaap:Goodwill.definition: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
us-gaap:GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod.definition: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

us-gaap:GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpair.label: Intangible Asset, Including Goodwill, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpair.definition: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:GoodwillForeignCurrencyTranslati.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:GoodwillForeignCurrencyTranslati.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillGross.label: Goodwill, Gross
us-gaap:GoodwillGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized. Includes amount, before amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill for private company.

us-gaap:GoodwillImpairedAccumulatedImpai.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
us-gaap:GoodwillImpairedAccumulatedImpai.definition: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss.definition: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLossNetOfTax.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Net of Tax
us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLossNetOfTax.definition: Amount, after tax, of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillOtherIncreaseDecrease.label: Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:GoodwillOtherIncreaseDecrease.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, classified as other.

us-gaap:GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease.label: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillPurchaseAccountingAdjust.label: Goodwill, Measurement Period Adjustment
us-gaap:GoodwillPurchaseAccountingAdjust.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from measurement period adjustment of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillRollForward.label: Goodwill [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:GoodwillRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:GoodwillSubsequentRecognitionOfD.label: Goodwill, Subsequent Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset
us-gaap:GoodwillSubsequentRecognitionOfD.definition: Amount of (increase) decrease from subsequent recognition of deferred tax asset for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillTransfers.label: Goodwill, Transfers
us-gaap:GoodwillTransfers.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from transfer into (out of) asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillTranslationAndPurchaseAc.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
us-gaap:GoodwillTranslationAndPurchaseAc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

us-gaap:GoodwillTranslationAndPurchaseAc.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments [Abstract]

us-gaap:GoodwillWrittenOffRelatedToSaleO.label: Goodwill, Divestiture
us-gaap:GoodwillWrittenOffRelatedToSaleO.definition: Amount of decrease in goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, from divestiture.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmount.label: Government Assistance, Income, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmount.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.label: Government Assistance, Asset
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.definition: Amount of asset from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.definition: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumula.definition: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Decrease
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.definition: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Decrease, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.definition: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Decrease, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreas.definition: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Increase
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.definition: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Increase, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.definition: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.label: Government Assistance, Asset, Increase, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreas.definition: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceExpense.label: Government Assistance, Expense, Decrease (Increase)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceExpense.definition: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiability.label: Government Assistance, Liability
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiability.definition: Amount of liability from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityCur.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityCur.definition: Amount of liability from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Decrease
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.definition: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Decrease, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.definition: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Decrease, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDec.definition: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Increase
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.definition: Amount of increase in liability from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Increase, Current
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.definition: Amount of increase in liability from government assistance, classified as current.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Increase, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityInc.definition: Amount of increase in liability from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityNon.label: Government Assistance, Liability, Noncurrent
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityNon.definition: Amount of liability from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceNonoperating.label: Government Assistance, Nonoperating Expense, Decrease (Increase)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceNonoperating.definition: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance, classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceNonoperating.label: Government Assistance, Nonoperating Income, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceNonoperating.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceOperatingExp.label: Government Assistance, Operating Expense, Decrease (Increase)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceOperatingExp.definition: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance, classified as operating.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceOperatingInc.label: Government Assistance, Operating Income, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceOperatingInc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as operating.

us-gaap:GrossInvestmentIncomeOperating.label: Gross Investment Income, Operating
us-gaap:GrossInvestmentIncomeOperating.definition: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationContractAc.label: Health Care Organization, Contract Acquisition Expense
us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationContractAc.definition: Costs associated with marketing of subscriber contracts and member enrollments. For example, commissions paid to agents or brokers and incentive compensation based on new enrollments. Includes also salaries of the marketing director and staff, general marketing brochures, and general advertising and promotion expenses.

us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationExpensesNe.label: Health Care Organization, Expenses, Net
us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationExpensesNe.definition: Total costs of health care costs, net of recoveries of stop-loss insurance. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationHealthCare.label: Health Care Organization, Expenses, Gross
us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationHealthCare.definition: Total expenses of a HCO before stop-loss insurance recoveries. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationStopLossIn.label: Health Care Organization, Stop Loss Insurance Premium Expense
us-gaap:HealthCareOrganizationStopLossIn.definition: Stop-loss insurance premiums recognized as expense. In stop-loss insurance, prepaid health care providers or associated entities transfer portions of their financial risks to other companies. A provider typically contracts to recover health care costs in excess of stated amounts during the contract periods.

us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecurities.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecurities.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
