us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesNoncurre.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesNoncurre.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesTransfer.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesTransfer.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:HeldtomaturitySecuritiesSoldSecu.label: Debt Security, Held-to-Maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:HeldtomaturitySecuritiesSoldSecu.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

us-gaap:HeldtomaturitySecuritiesTransfer.label: Debt Security, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:HeldtomaturitySecuritiesTransfer.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:HostingArrangementServiceContrac.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:HostingArrangementServiceContrac.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

us-gaap:HostingArrangementServiceContrac.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, before Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:HostingArrangementServiceContrac.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

us-gaap:ImpairmentChargeOnReclassifiedAs.label: Long-Lived Asset, Change to Plan of Sale, Reclassification from Held-for-Sale to Held-and-Used, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:ImpairmentChargeOnReclassifiedAs.definition: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

us-gaap:ImpairmentExcludingLessorAssetUn.label: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Excluding Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:ImpairmentExcludingLessorAssetUn.definition: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used.

us-gaap:ImpairmentIntangibleAssetFiniteL.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Impairment Loss, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ImpairmentIntangibleAssetFiniteL.definition: Indicates segment that includes impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:ImpairmentIntangibleAssetIndefin.label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ImpairmentIntangibleAssetIndefin.definition: Indicates segment that includes impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:ImpairmentLessorAssetUnderOperat.label: Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:ImpairmentLessorAssetUnderOperat.definition: Amount of impairment loss for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

us-gaap:ImpairmentLossesRelatedToRealEst.label: Impairment Losses Related to Real Estate Partnerships
us-gaap:ImpairmentLossesRelatedToRealEst.definition: Impairment losses measured as the amount by which the carrying amount of the business or real estate partnerships exceeds the fair value of the business or partnership.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetFinit.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetFinit.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetIndef.label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetIndef.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcl.definition: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsFini.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsFini.definition: Amount of impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsInde.label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsInde.definition: Amount of impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLeasehold.label: Impairment of Leasehold
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLeasehold.definition: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldF.definition: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeD.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeD.definition: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties.label: Impairment, Oil and Gas, Property with Unproved and Proved Reserves
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties.definition: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOngoingProject.label: Impairment of Ongoing Project
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOngoingProject.definition: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

us-gaap:ImpairmentOfRealEstate.label: Impairment of Real Estate
us-gaap:ImpairmentOfRealEstate.definition: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

us-gaap:IncentiveDistributionDistributio.label: Incentive Distribution, Distribution
us-gaap:IncentiveDistributionDistributio.definition: Amount of incentive obligation paid in cash or stock during the period to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner.

us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpense.label: Incentive Fee Expense
us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpense.definition: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpenseCapitalGainBa.label: Incentive Fee Expense, Capital-Gain-Based
us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpenseCapitalGainBa.definition: Amount of expense for capital-gain-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpenseIncomeBased.label: Incentive Fee Expense, Income-Based
us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpenseIncomeBased.definition: Amount of expense for income-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

us-gaap:IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingP.label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Equity Method Investment, Income (Loss) from Tax Credit Investment
us-gaap:IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingP.definition: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvest.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvest.definition: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationInterestExpe.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Expense
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationInterestExpe.definition: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAnd.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAnd.definition: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesExp.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Expense
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesExp.definition: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.definition: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.definition: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.label: Income Tax (Expense) Benefit, Continuing Operations, Government Grants
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuin.definition: Amount of tax (expense) benefit from continuing operations attributable to government grants to the extent recognized as a reduction of income tax expense.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitIntraperi.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitIntraperi.definition: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundR.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundR.definition: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefund.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, before Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefund.definition: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignAfterRefundR.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignAfterRefundR.definition: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefund.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, before Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefund.definition: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterR.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterR.definition: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalBefore.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, before Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalBefore.definition: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid.label: Income Tax Paid, before Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid.definition: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet.label: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received
us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet.definition: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFr.label: Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFr.definition: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInBookOverdrafts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Book Overdrafts
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInBookOverdrafts.definition: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInCapitalizedExp.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInCapitalizedExp.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateral.label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateral.definition: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits.label: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPu.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPu.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSo.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Sold
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSo.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPartnersCapita.label: Increase (Decrease) in Partners' Capital [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPartnersCapita.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInStockholdersEq.label: Increase (Decrease) in Stockholders' Equity [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInStockholdersEq.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInTemporaryEquit.label: Increase (Decrease) in Temporary Equity [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInTemporaryEquit.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiu.label: (Increase) Decrease in Unearned Premiums, Net
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiu.definition: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseToSubordinatedLi.label: Increase (Decrease) to Subordinated Liabilities [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseToSubordinatedLi.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeem.label: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
us-gaap:IncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeem.definition: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsE.definition: Amount of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsF.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsF.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsP.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsP.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Measurement Period Adjustment
us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsP.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsR.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsR.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsT.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsT.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsT.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments [Abstract]

us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsW.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Divestiture
us-gaap:IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsW.definition: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsA.label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Acquired
us-gaap:IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsA.definition: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:InducedConversionOfConvertibleDe.label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
us-gaap:InducedConversionOfConvertibleDe.definition: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

us-gaap:InformationTechnologyAndDataProc.label: Information Technology and Data Processing
us-gaap:InformationTechnologyAndDataProc.definition: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

us-gaap:InsuranceAgencyManagementFee.label: Insurance Agency Management Fee
us-gaap:InsuranceAgencyManagementFee.definition: Fees earned during the period for providing management services.

us-gaap:InsuranceCommissions.label: Insurance Commissions
us-gaap:InsuranceCommissions.definition: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

us-gaap:InsuranceCommissionsAndFees.label: Insurance Commissions and Fees
us-gaap:InsuranceCommissionsAndFees.definition: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

us-gaap:InsuranceInvestmentIncome.label: Insurance Investment Income
us-gaap:InsuranceInvestmentIncome.definition: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

us-gaap:InsuranceRecoveries.label: Insurance Recoveries
us-gaap:InsuranceRecoveries.definition: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

us-gaap:InsuranceServicesRevenue.label: Insurance Services Revenue
us-gaap:InsuranceServicesRevenue.definition: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

us-gaap:InsuranceTax.label: Insurance Tax
us-gaap:InsuranceTax.definition: Represents total insurance tax expense reflected in the income statement for each period presented.

us-gaap:InsuredEventGainLoss.label: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:InsuredEventGainLoss.definition: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

us-gaap:IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCap.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, and Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCap.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCap.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, and Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, before Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCap.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense.label: Interest and Debt Expense
us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense.definition: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.definition: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating, Paid in Cash
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.definition: Amount of interest and dividend income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating, Paid in Kind
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.definition: Amount of interest and dividend income from investment paid in kind, classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.definition: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.definition: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeas.definition: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.
The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

Interest and fee income generated by loans the Entity intends and has the ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (1) industrial and agricultural; (2) real estate; and (3) real estate construction loans; (4) trade financing; (5) lease financing; (6) home equity lines-of-credit; (7) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (8) credit card and other revolving-type loans. Also includes interest income for leases held by the Entity.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.definition: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial and Residential, Real Estate
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.definition: Interest and fee income from commercial and residential real estate loans.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Industrial, and Agricultural Loans
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.definition: Interest and fee income generated from all commercial, industrial, and agricultural loans.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Real Estate
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommerc.definition: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by commercial properties. Examples of properties commonly securing commercial real estate loans may include office buildings, apartment buildings, shopping centers, industrial property, and hotels.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.definition: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Home Equity
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.definition: Interest and fee income from home equity lines-of-credit extended to individuals (borrowers). Such loans are generally secured by the borrower's equity in her or his home.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Automobiles, Marine, and Other Vehicles
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.definition: Interest and fee income generated by automobile, marine, and other vehicle loans made to individuals.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Credit Card
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.definition: Interest and fee income from credit card balances due from individuals. Such loans are considered revolving credit arrangements.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Real Estate
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsume.definition: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by one- to four-family residential properties. This item excludes home equity lines-of-credit.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansForeign.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Foreign
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansForeign.definition: Interest and fee income generated by commercial and consumer loans, made by foreign branches of the reporting entity, which may include loans to foreign governments, foreign banks and other financial institutions, commercial and industrial entities, and citizens of not domiciled in the same country as the reporting entity.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansHeldFor.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loan, Held-for-Sale, Mortgage
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansHeldFor.definition: Interest and fee income from mortgage loans considered to be held-for-sale.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansLeaseFi.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Lease Financing
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansLeaseFi.definition: Interest and fee income generated by direct lease financing which consists of an institution owning and leasing personal property for the use of its customers at the customers' specific request.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansOtherCo.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Other Consumer
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansOtherCo.definition: Interest and fee income from other loans extended to individual consumers.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansRealEst.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Real Estate Construction
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansRealEst.definition: Interest and fee income from loans used for real estate development and construction costs. Such loans are referred to as "Construction" loans or mortgages.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansTradeFi.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Trade Financing
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansTradeFi.definition: Interest and fee income generated by trade financing. Trade financing is a specialized area of commercial lending frequently used by businesses that engage in international activities. Such financing includes open account financing, sales on consignment, documentary collections, advances against collections, letters of credit, bankers' acceptances, factoring, and forfeiting.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeNonmortgageL.label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Nonmortgage
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeNonmortgageL.definition: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoans.label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoans.definition: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.

us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoansHe.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loan, Held-for-Sale, Other
us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoansHe.definition: Amount of interest and fee income from loans held-for-sale and classified as other.

us-gaap:InterestAndOtherIncome.label: Interest and Other Income
us-gaap:InterestAndOtherIncome.definition: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized.definition: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalizedAdjustme.label: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalizedAdjustme.definition: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized.label: Capitalized Interest Costs, Including Allowance for Funds Used During Construction
us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized.definition: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

us-gaap:InterestCreditedToPolicyOwnerAcc.label: Interest Credited to Policy Owner Account
us-gaap:InterestCreditedToPolicyOwnerAcc.definition: Amount of expense for unpaid portion of interest credited to policy owner account.

us-gaap:InterestCreditedToPolicyholdersA.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Interest Expense
us-gaap:InterestCreditedToPolicyholdersA.definition: Amount of interest expense for allocation to policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:InterestExpense.label: Interest Expense, Operating and Nonoperating
us-gaap:InterestExpense.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseBeneficialInteres.label: Interest Expense, Beneficial Interests Issued by Consolidated Variable Interest Entities
us-gaap:InterestExpenseBeneficialInteres.definition: Interest expense on beneficial interests issued by consolidated variable interest entities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseBorrowings.label: Interest Expense, Borrowings
us-gaap:InterestExpenseBorrowings.definition: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseCapitalSecurities.label: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
us-gaap:InterestExpenseCapitalSecurities.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseCommercialPaper.label: Interest Expense, Commercial Paper
us-gaap:InterestExpenseCommercialPaper.definition: Amount of interest expense on commercial paper.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseCustomerDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Customer Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseCustomerDeposits.definition: The interest expense recognized during the period on customer deposits or security deposits held in interest bearing accounts.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt.label: Interest Expense, Debt
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt.definition: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebtExcludingAmor.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebtExcludingAmor.definition: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDemandDepositAcco.label: Interest Expense, Demand Deposit Accounts
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDemandDepositAcco.definition: Interest expense incurred on demand deposit accounts that represent borrowings rather than outstanding drafts.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDeposits.definition: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDepositsFromOther.label: Interest Expense, Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDepositsFromOther.definition: Amount of interest expense on interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Aggregate amount of all interest expense on domestic deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Brokered
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic brokered deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Certificates of Deposit
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Checking
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic checking deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Demand
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic demand deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Money Market
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Notice of Withdrawal
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Other Time Deposit
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Retail
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic retail deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Savings
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on domestic savings deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Time Deposit
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on time deposit liabilities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Domestic Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseDomesticDeposits.definition: The aggregate interest expense incurred on all domestic deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurch.label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurch.definition: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurch.label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurch.definition: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalHomeLoanBa.label: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Long-Term
us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalHomeLoanBa.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on long-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalHomeLoanBa.label: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Short-Term
us-gaap:InterestExpenseFederalHomeLoanBa.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on short-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseForeignDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Foreign Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseForeignDeposits.definition: Interest expense on all foreign deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseInterestBearingLi.label: Interest Expense, Interest-Bearing Liability
us-gaap:InterestExpenseInterestBearingLi.definition: Amount of interest expense on interest-bearing liability.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseJuniorSubordinate.label: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
us-gaap:InterestExpenseJuniorSubordinate.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseLoansFromOtherFed.label: Interest Expense, Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:InterestExpenseLoansFromOtherFed.definition: Amount of interest expense on loans received from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

us-gaap:InterestExpenseLongTermDebt.label: Interest Expense, Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:InterestExpenseLongTermDebt.definition: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseLongTermDebtAndCa.definition: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseMediumTermNotes.label: Interest Expense, Medium-Term Note
us-gaap:InterestExpenseMediumTermNotes.definition: Amount of interest expense incurred on medium-term note.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseMoneyMarketDeposi.label: Interest Expense, Money Market Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseMoneyMarketDeposi.definition: Interest expense incurred on all money market deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseNOWAccountsMoneyM.label: Interest Expense, NOW Accounts, Money Market Accounts, and Savings Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseNOWAccountsMoneyM.definition: The aggregate interest expense incurred on the following for deposits in domestic offices: (1) transaction accounts (NOW, and telephone and preauthorized transfer accounts), (2) money market deposits and (3) savings deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseNegotiableOrderOf.label: Interest Expense, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseNegotiableOrderOf.definition: Interest expense incurred on the amount of Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW). Interest-bearing transaction account that combines the payable on demand feature of checks and investment feature of savings accounts. A NOW account is functionally an interest paying checking account.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOnPrepetitionLiab.label: Interest Expense on Prepetition Liabilities Recognized in Statement of Operations
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOnPrepetitionLiab.definition: The amount of interest expense on prepetition obligations included in the statement of operations.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOperating.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOther.label: Interest Expense, Other
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOther.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherDomesticDepo.label: Interest Expense, Other Domestic Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherDomesticDepo.definition: Interest expense incurred on other deposits in domestic offices.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherLongTermDebt.label: Interest Expense, Other Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherLongTermDebt.definition: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherShortTermBor.label: Interest Expense, Other Short-Term Borrowings
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOtherShortTermBor.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on other short-term borrowings.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseSavingsDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseSavingsDeposits.definition: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseSecuritiesSoldUnd.label: Interest Expense, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
us-gaap:InterestExpenseSecuritiesSoldUnd.definition: Gross expenses on securities sold coupled with an agreement to repurchase the same from the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price within a fixed or variable time period.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseShortTermBorrowin.label: Interest Expense, Short-Term Borrowings
us-gaap:InterestExpenseShortTermBorrowin.definition: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseShortTermBorrowin.label: Interest Expense, Short-Term Borrowings Excluding Federal Funds and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
us-gaap:InterestExpenseShortTermBorrowin.definition: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances and other short term borrowings.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseSubordinatedNotes.label: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
us-gaap:InterestExpenseSubordinatedNotes.definition: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDeposits.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDeposits.definition: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDeposits10000.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDeposits10000.definition: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, of $100,000 or more in domestic offices.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDepositsLessT.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
us-gaap:InterestExpenseTimeDepositsLessT.definition: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, less than $100,000 in domestic offices.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseTradingLiabilitie.label: Interest Expense, Trading Liabilities
us-gaap:InterestExpenseTradingLiabilitie.definition: Interest expense incurred on short positions arising from sales of securities and other assets, which the entity does not own, to other parties. Trading liabilities includes the fair value of derivative contracts held for trading that are in loss positions.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseTrustPreferredSec.label: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
us-gaap:InterestExpenseTrustPreferredSec.definition: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeAndFeesBankersAcce.label: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
us-gaap:InterestIncomeAndFeesBankersAcce.definition: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesAvai.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesAvai.definition: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale); classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesOper.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesOper.definition: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesTrad.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDebtSecuritiesTrad.definition: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDepositsWithFinanc.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDepositsWithFinanc.definition: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDepositsWithOtherF.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDepositsWithOtherF.definition: Amount of interest income from interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

us-gaap:InterestIncomeDomesticDeposits.label: Interest Income, Domestic Deposits
us-gaap:InterestIncomeDomesticDeposits.definition: Interest earned on deposits in United States money market accounts and other United States interest earning accounts.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvis.label: Interest Income (Expense), after Provision for Loan Loss
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvis.definition: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.definition: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalFundsSold.label: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold
us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalFundsSold.definition: Interest income on federal funds sold. Federal funds sold represent the excess federal funds held by one commercial bank which it lends to another commercial bank, usually at an agreed-upon (federal funds) rate of interest. Such loans generally are of short-duration (overnight).

us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalFundsSoldAn.label: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalFundsSoldAn.definition: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalHomeLoanBan.label: Interest Income, Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
us-gaap:InterestIncomeFederalHomeLoanBan.definition: Amount of interest income from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeFinancingReceivabl.label: Interest Income, Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:InterestIncomeFinancingReceivabl.definition: Amount of interest income from financing receivable before allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeForeignDeposits.label: Interest Income, Foreign Deposits
us-gaap:InterestIncomeForeignDeposits.definition: Interest income generated from amounts on deposit with foreign entities located outside the United States of America.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeHedgeBasisAdjustme.label: Interest Income, Hedge Basis Adjustment, Portfolio Layer Method, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:InterestIncomeHedgeBasisAdjustme.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest income for hedge basis adjustment from hedged layer exceeding outstanding amount of closed portfolio of financial asset or beneficial interest secured by financial instrument.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeInterestEarningAss.label: Interest Income, Interest-Earning Asset
us-gaap:InterestIncomeInterestEarningAss.definition: Amount of interest income from interest-earning asset.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeLoansToOtherFedera.label: Interest Income, Loans to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:InterestIncomeLoansToOtherFedera.definition: Amount of interest income from loans to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

us-gaap:InterestIncomeMoneyMarketDeposit.label: Interest Income, Money Market Deposits
us-gaap:InterestIncomeMoneyMarketDeposit.definition: Interest earned on funds deposited in US domestic money market accounts.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating.label: Interest Income, Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonope.label: Interest Income, Operating and Nonoperating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonope.definition: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInCas.label: Interest Income, Operating, Paid in Cash
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInCas.definition: Amount of interest income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInKin.label: Interest Income, Operating, Paid in Kind
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInKin.definition: Amount of interest income from investment paid in kind, classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOther.label: Interest Income, Other
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOther.definition: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOtherDomesticDepos.label: Interest Income, Other Domestic Deposits
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOtherDomesticDepos.definition: Amount of interest earned on US domestic deposits classified as other. Excludes money market accounts.

us-gaap:InterestIncomePurchasedReceivabl.label: Interest Income, Purchased Receivables
us-gaap:InterestIncomePurchasedReceivabl.definition: Interest earned from receivables purchased; for instance, receivables purchased through a factoring arrangement.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesCorporat.label: Interest Income, Securities, Corporate Debt, Operating
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesCorporat.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on corporate debt securities.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesMortgage.label: Interest Income, Securities, Mortgage-Backed
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesMortgage.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securitized, pass-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesOtherUSG.label: Interest Income, Securities, Other US Government
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesOtherUSG.definition: Interest income on securities issued by US government agencies not including US Treasury Securities.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesPurchase.label: Interest Income, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesPurchase.definition: Interest income derived from securities purchased under agreements to resell. The difference in the price at which the institution buys the securities and resells the securities represents interest for the use of the funds by the other party. Most repurchase and sale agreements involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances and negotiable certificates of deposits are sometimes used in such transactions.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesStateAnd.label: Interest Income, Securities, State and Municipal
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesStateAnd.definition: Interest income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, derived from debt securities issued by municipal governments, local taxing districts and US state government agencies.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxAdvan.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Advantaged
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxAdvan.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to tax benefits. Excludes operating interest income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxExemp.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxExemp.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxable.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesTaxable.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesUSTreasu.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesUSTreasu.definition: Interest income on US treasury securities. US treasury securities are negotiable debt obligations of the US government, secured by its full faith and credit and issued at various schedules and maturities. The income from treasury securities is exempt from state and local, but not federal, taxes. There are three types of securities issued by the US treasury (bonds, bills, and notes), which are distinguished by the amount of time from the initial sale of the bond to maturity.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesUSTreasu.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury and Other US Government
us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesUSTreasu.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on U.S. Treasury securities and other U.S. government securities.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeShortTermInvestmen.label: Interest Income, Short-Term Investment, Other
us-gaap:InterestIncomeShortTermInvestmen.definition: Amount of interest income from short-term investment classified as other.

us-gaap:InterestPaidNet.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
us-gaap:InterestPaidNet.definition: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

us-gaap:InventoryAdjustments.label: Inventory Adjustments
us-gaap:InventoryAdjustments.definition: Amount of inventory reserves for last-in first-out (LIFO) and other inventory valuation methods.

us-gaap:InventoryFirmPurchaseCommitmentL.label: Inventory, Firm Purchase Commitment, Loss
us-gaap:InventoryFirmPurchaseCommitmentL.definition: Amount of loss recognized on firm purchase commitment for inventory.

us-gaap:InventoryGross.label: Inventory, Gross
us-gaap:InventoryGross.definition: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReserve.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve
us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReserve.definition: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReserveEffectOnInco.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Effect on Income, Net
us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReserveEffectOnInco.definition: The difference between the change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods and any LIFO decrement which have been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReservePeriodCharge.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Period Charge
us-gaap:InventoryLIFOReservePeriodCharge.definition: The change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods, which change has been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

us-gaap:InventoryNet.label: Inventory, Net
us-gaap:InventoryNet.definition: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:InventoryRecallExpense.label: Inventory Recall Expense
us-gaap:InventoryRecallExpense.definition: Reflects the amount charged against earnings comprised of the costs to announce and effect a recall of defective merchandise.

us-gaap:InventoryValuationReserves.label: Inventory Valuation Reserves
us-gaap:InventoryValuationReserves.definition: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

us-gaap:InventoryWriteDown.label: Inventory Write-down
us-gaap:InventoryWriteDown.definition: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

us-gaap:InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokera.label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
us-gaap:InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokera.definition: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

us-gaap:InvestmentBankingRevenue.label: Investment Banking Revenue
us-gaap:InvestmentBankingRevenue.definition: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyCapitalShareTra.label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transaction, Increase (Decrease) [Abstract]
Investment Company, Capital Share Transactions, Stock Issued [Abstract]
Investment Company, Capital Share Transactions, Stock Repurchased [Abstract]

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionLon.label: Investment Company, Distribution, Long-Term Capital Gain
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionLon.definition: Amount of dividend distribution by investment company from long-term capital gain.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionOrd.label: Investment Company, Distribution, Ordinary Income
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionOrd.definition: Amount of dividend distribution by investment company from ordinary income.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionToS.label: Investment Company, Distribution to Shareholders, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDistributionToS.definition: Per share or unit amount of distribution to shareholders. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDividendDistrib.label: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyDividendDistrib.definition: Amount of dividend distribution from ordinary income and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyExciseTaxExpens.label: Investment Company, Excise Tax Expense
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyExciseTaxExpens.definition: Amount of excise tax expense on excess of required distribution over distributed amount for regulated investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighli.label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighli.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInKin.label: Investment Company, Gain (Loss) on in-kind Redemption
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInKin.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on redemption of investment company shares or units by payment in portfolio securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInves.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on investment not meeting guidelines of fund.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInves.label: Investment Company, Gain (Loss) on Investment, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInves.definition: Per share or unit amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInves.label: Investment Company, Gain (Loss) on Investment, Per Share [Abstract]

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainOnInvestmen.label: Investment Company, Gain on Investment in Violation
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGainOnInvestmen.definition: Amount of gain on investment not meeting investment guideline of fund.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGeneralPartnerA.label: Investment Company, General Partner, Advisory Service Allocation
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyGeneralPartnerA.definition: Amount of allocation for advisory service from general partner.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyIncreaseDecreas.label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transaction, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity from change in number of shares or units by investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncom.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) from Operations, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncom.definition: Per share or unit amount of investment income (loss) and realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncom.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) from Operations, Per Share [Abstract]
Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncom.definition: Per-basic-share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss) from investment held by investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyIssuanceOfShare.label: Investment Company, Share Issuance, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyIssuanceOfShare.definition: Per share amount of share issuance by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyNetAssetValuePe.definition: Per-share or unit amount of increase (decrease) in net asset value.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyNetAssetsRollFo.label: Investment Company, Net Assets [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyNetAssetsRollFo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyPaymentByAffili.label: Investment Company, Payment by Affiliate, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyPaymentByAffili.definition: Per share or unit amount of payment by affiliate of fund to offset fund loss.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyPurchasePremium.label: Investment Company, Purchase Premium, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyPurchasePremium.definition: Per share amount of premium paid by investor to purchase shares of investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRealizedGainLos.label: Investment Company, Realized Gain (Loss) on Investment, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRealizedGainLos.definition: Per-share or unit amount of realized gain (loss) on investment held by investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRedemptionFeePe.label: Investment Company, Redemption Fee, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRedemptionFeePe.definition: Per share or unit amount of fee charged to investor for redemption of shares before permitted period.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRepurchaseOfSha.label: Investment Company, Share Repurchase, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyRepurchaseOfSha.definition: Per share amount of share repurchase by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReclassifica.label: Investment Company, Tax Reclassification, Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReclassifica.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from reclassification to paid-in capital of permanent difference for distribution to ownership interest holder by investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReturnOfCapi.label: Investment Company, Tax Return of Capital Distribution
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReturnOfCapi.definition: Amount of distribution in excess of tax-basis earnings and profit of investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReturnOfCapi.label: Investment Company, Tax Return of Capital Distribution, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyTaxReturnOfCapi.definition: Per share or unit amount of capital distribution in excess of tax basis earnings.

us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyUnrealizedGainL.label: Investment Company, Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investment, Per Share
us-gaap:InvestmentCompanyUnrealizedGainL.definition: Per-share or unit amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment held by investment company.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfDi.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfDi.definition: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfPr.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfPr.definition: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeDividend.label: Investment Income, Dividend
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeDividend.definition: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest.label: Investment Income, Interest
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest.definition: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDivid.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDivid.definition: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInvestmentExpens.label: Investment Income, Investment Expense
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInvestmentExpens.definition: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet.label: Investment Income, Net
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet.definition: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationO.label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationO.definition: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNonoperating.label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNonoperating.definition: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterEx.label: Investment Income, Operating, after Expense and Tax
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterEx.definition: Amount, after expense and tax, of investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpe.label: Investment Income, Operating, Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpe.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue.definition: Fair value of investment in security owned.

us-gaap:Investments.label: Investments
us-gaap:Investments.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Gross Additions
us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.definition: Gross additions to the investment in and advance to the affiliate.

us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Gross Reductions
us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.definition: Gross reductions to the investment in and advance to the affiliate.

us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the investments in and advances to affiliates.

us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffili.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantGrossOwn.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Gross Ownership Amount of Plant in Service
us-gaap:JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantGrossOwn.definition: The period end amount owned by the reporting utility of a jointly owned utility plant in service.

us-gaap:JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantOwnershi.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Ownership Amount of Plant Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantOwnershi.definition: The period end amount of accumulated depreciation in a jointly owned electricity generation plant.

us-gaap:LaborAndRelatedExpense.label: Labor and Related Expense
us-gaap:LaborAndRelatedExpense.definition: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

us-gaap:LandingFeesAndOtherRentals.label: Airline, Landing Fee and Other Rent Expenses
us-gaap:LandingFeesAndOtherRentals.definition: Amount of expense for cost incurred at airport in which airline conducts flight operation. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid to airport authority for takeoff and landing, gate space and facility, security, fuel storage facility, and other terminal costs. Excludes expense for leasing aircraft from third party.

us-gaap:LateFeeIncomeGeneratedByServicin.label: Late Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
us-gaap:LateFeeIncomeGeneratedByServicin.definition: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset as a result of the debt holder not meeting the monthly payment terms.

us-gaap:LeaseIncome.label: Lease Income
us-gaap:LeaseIncome.definition: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

us-gaap:LeaseholdImprovementUnderlyingAs.label: Leasehold Improvement, Underlying Asset under Common Control, Increase (Decrease) in Equity
us-gaap:LeaseholdImprovementUnderlyingAs.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for leasehold improvement on lease under common control when lessee no longer controls underlying asset.

us-gaap:LeasingCommissionsExpense.label: Leasing Commissions Expense
us-gaap:LeasingCommissionsExpense.definition: Amount of commissions expense incurred because the lessor of real estate obtained a lessee for a rental property through a real estate agent.

us-gaap:LegalFees.label: Legal Fees
us-gaap:LegalFees.definition: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income from Leveraged Leases
us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.definition: Pretax lease income allocated in proportionate amounts from unearned income.

us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income Tax Expense on Leveraged Leases
us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.definition: The tax effect from the current year income from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.
