us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Investment Tax Credit Recognized on Leveraged Leases
us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementIn.definition: Amount of investment tax credit recognized as income.

us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementNe.label: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
us-gaap:LeveragedLeasesIncomeStatementNe.definition: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromise.definition: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromiseEx.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Expense (Reversal of Expense) for Liabilities
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromiseEx.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) related to liabilities subject to compromise since the bankruptcy filing date.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromiseIn.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Increase (Decrease) under Bankruptcy Court Order, Reclassifications
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromiseIn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to the bankruptcy court orders from reclassifications of liabilities.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Freight and Distribution Costs
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.definition: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for freight and distribution costs.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Other Liabilities
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.definition: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for liabilities classified as other.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Resolutions of Contingencies Subject to Chapter 11
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.definition: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for prepetition contingencies.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Trade Accounts Payable
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePa.definition: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for trade accounts payable.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePe.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in liabilities subject to compromise.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePe.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePe.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of reserves for the costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims, before estimated recoveries from reinsurers.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Gross, Incurred Loss
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: Amount, before effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Gross, Payment for Claims
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: Amount of cash outflow to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in asbestos and environmental claims reserve, before estimated recoveries from reinsurers.

Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of reserves for the costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims, net of estimated reinsurance recoveries.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Incurred Loss
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Payment for Claims
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.
The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in asbestos and environmental claims reserve, net of reinsurance recoveries.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironme.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitA.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Adverse Development, Expense
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitA.definition: Amount of expense for adverse development on liability of future policy benefit from net premium exceeding gross premium.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance, after Discount Rate Change [Abstract]

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected future benefit and expense component for liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance, after Discount Rate Change
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption and discount rate change, of expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) from Cash Flow Change
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability of future policy benefit from cash flow assumption change for future cash flows.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) of Actual Variance from Expected Experience
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability of future policy benefit from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Derecognition
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of decrease in expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit from derecognition of contract.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability for future policy benefit from change, classified as other.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Foreign Currency Translation
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability for future policy benefit from foreign currency translation.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Interest Expense
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of interest expense for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Issuance
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase in expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit from contract issuance.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.
Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption and discount rate change, of expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, before Reinsurance, after Discount Rate Change [Abstract]
Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) from Cash Flow Change
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from cash flow assumption change for future cash flows.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) of Actual Variance from Expected Experience
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability of future policy benefit from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Derecognition
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of decrease in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from derecognition of contract.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability for future policy benefit from change, classified as other.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Increase (Decrease) from Foreign Currency Translation
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability for future policy benefit from foreign currency translation.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Interest Income
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of interest income for expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Issuance
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from contract issuance.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Net Premium Collected
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of premium collected from policyholder to fund expected benefit payment for expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.
Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected net premium component for liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitE.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefits.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Benefit Payment
us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefits.definition: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder from benefit payment for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

us-gaap:LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaim.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Business Combination
us-gaap:LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaim.definition: Amount, after deduction of reinsurance recovery, of increase (decrease) in cost of settling unpaid claim acquired in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, claim incurred but not reported.

Liability as of the balance sheet date for amounts representing estimated cost of settling unpaid claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies, less estimated reinsurance recoveries on such claims. This includes an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported. Claim adjustment expenses represent the costs estimated to be incurred in the settlement of unpaid claims.
Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of increase (decrease) in the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

us-gaap:LifeSettlementContractsFairValue.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:LifeSettlementContractsFairValue.definition: This item represents the gains or losses recognized and realized during the period on investments in life settlement contracts sold during the period.

us-gaap:LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountDis.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Amount
us-gaap:LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountDis.definition: The total amount of distributions to limited partners.

us-gaap:LineOfCredit.label: Long-Term Line of Credit
us-gaap:LineOfCredit.definition: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityDecreaseForg.label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Forgiveness
us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityDecreaseForg.definition: Amount of decrease in line of credit facility from forgiveness by the holder of the line of credit.

us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAccr.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAccr.definition: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecr.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecr.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of the credit facility.

us-gaap:LiquidationBasisOfAccountingReme.label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Asset, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:LiquidationBasisOfAccountingReme.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of asset for change in carrying value under liquidation basis of accounting.

us-gaap:LitigationSettlementExpense.label: Litigation Settlement, Fee Expense
us-gaap:LitigationSettlementExpense.definition: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

us-gaap:LitigationSettlementGain.label: Litigation Settlement, Gain
us-gaap:LitigationSettlementGain.definition: Amount of gain from litigation settlement for amount awarded from other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

us-gaap:LitigationSettlementInterest.label: Litigation Settlement Interest
us-gaap:LitigationSettlementInterest.definition: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

us-gaap:LitigationSettlementLoss.label: Litigation Settlement, Loss
us-gaap:LitigationSettlementLoss.definition: Amount of loss from litigation settlement for amount awarded to other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

us-gaap:LoanPortfolioExpense.label: Loan Portfolio Expense
us-gaap:LoanPortfolioExpense.definition: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

us-gaap:LoanProcessingFee.label: Loan Processing Fee
us-gaap:LoanProcessingFee.definition: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Addition from New Loan
us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.definition: Amount of increase in financing receivable from new loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.
Amount of increase (decrease) in financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Proceeds for Loan Repayment
us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.definition: Amount of increase in financing receivable from proceeds for repayment of loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedP.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNot.definition: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetRec.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance, Reconciliation to Cash Flow [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetRec.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Addition to Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Deduction from Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of deduction to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconc.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualCarryingVa.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualCarryingVa.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in loss contingency liability.

us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualPayments.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments
us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualPayments.definition: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualProductLia.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Discount
us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualProductLia.definition: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce (reconcile) the estimated aggregate undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) to the present value recognized on the balance sheet (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualProductLia.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Gross
us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualProductLia.definition: Undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product or process.

us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualRollForwar.label: Loss Contingency Accrual [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualRollForwar.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:LossContingencyDamagesPaidValue.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Paid, Value
us-gaap:LossContingencyDamagesPaidValue.definition: Amount of damages paid to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Loss (Reversal of Loss)
us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod.definition: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

us-gaap:LossContingencyReceivable.definition: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

us-gaap:LossContingencyReceivableProceed.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Proceeds
us-gaap:LossContingencyReceivableProceed.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables related to a loss contingency.

us-gaap:LossContingencyRelatedReceivable.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Additions
us-gaap:LossContingencyRelatedReceivable.definition: Amount of additions to receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

us-gaap:LossContingencyRelatedReceivable.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:LossContingencyRelatedReceivable.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) of receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

us-gaap:LossFromCatastrophes.label: Loss from Catastrophes
us-gaap:LossFromCatastrophes.definition: The charge against earnings in the period for the uninsured portion of a loss from a fire, explosion, or natural disaster (hurricane, earthquake).

us-gaap:LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.label: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
us-gaap:LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.definition: The loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.label: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
us-gaap:LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAs.definition: Loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

us-gaap:LossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQ.label: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
us-gaap:LossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQ.definition: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

us-gaap:LossOnContractTermination.label: Loss on Contract Termination
us-gaap:LossOnContractTermination.definition: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

us-gaap:LossOnContractTerminationForDefa.label: Loss on Contract Termination for Default
us-gaap:LossOnContractTerminationForDefa.definition: The amount of the loss on termination of a contract for default.

us-gaap:LossOnContracts.label: Loss on Contracts
us-gaap:LossOnContracts.definition: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

us-gaap:LossOnDerivativeInstrumentsPreta.label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
us-gaap:LossOnDerivativeInstrumentsPreta.definition: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.

us-gaap:LossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowH.label: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
us-gaap:LossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowH.definition: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

us-gaap:LossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferre.label: Loss Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
us-gaap:LossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferre.definition: Amount of loss recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrua.definition: Amount of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability) at the end of the accounting period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Period
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.definition: Amount of loss recognized for asserted and unasserted malpractice claims.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Prior Periods
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.definition: Amount of increase in asserted and unasserted malpractice claims that were originally recognized in a prior period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred, Net
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyClaims.definition: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims and insurance premiums incurred during an accounting period, less insurance recoveries and returns of previously paid premiums.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyInsura.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Insurance Recoveries
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyInsura.definition: Amount of insurance recoveries recognized from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims recognized during an accounting period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriod.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Cost
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriod.definition: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims, including costs associated with litigating and settling claims, incurred during an accounting period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriod.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriod.definition: The increase (decrease) in the accrued liability for malpractice claims during an accounting period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPremiu.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Premium Costs
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyPremiu.definition: Amount of costs incurred that are associated with obtaining malpractice insurance and other risk transferring arrangements during an accounting period.

us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyReturn.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Return of Premiums
us-gaap:MalpracticeLossContingencyReturn.definition: Amount received during the period representing a return of premiums previously paid, generally under a retrospectively rated policy.

us-gaap:ManagementAndIncentiveFeesExpens.definition: Amount of expense for management and incentive fees for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

us-gaap:ManagementFeeExpense.label: Management Fee Expense
us-gaap:ManagementFeeExpense.definition: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

us-gaap:ManufacturingCosts.label: Manufacturing Costs
us-gaap:ManufacturingCosts.definition: The aggregate costs incurred in the production of goods for sale.

us-gaap:MarketDataRevenue.label: Market Data Revenue
us-gaap:MarketDataRevenue.definition: Amount of revenue from market data services, including, but not limited to, information about current quotes and most recent prices for a specific security.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitAttributedFeeCo.label: Market Risk Benefit, Attributed Fee Collected
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitAttributedFeeCo.definition: Amount of cash inflow to contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from attributed fee collected.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitBeforeReinsuran.definition: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and cumulative increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, of contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitBenefitPayment.label: Market Risk Benefit, Benefit Payment
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitBenefitPayment.definition: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder from benefit payment for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitChangeInFairVal.label: Market Risk Benefit, Change in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitChangeInFairVal.definition: Amount of gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in fair value of contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk. Excludes change attributable to instrument-specific credit risk.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Actual Policyholder Behavior Different from Expected
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change associated with actual policyholder behavior different from expected.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Equity Market Change
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change in equity market assumption.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Future Expected Policyholder Behavior Assumption
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change in future expected policyholder behavior assumption.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Interest Rate Change
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change in interest rate.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Other Assumption
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change in assumption, classified as other.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.label: Market Risk Benefit, Increase (Decrease) from Volatility
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIncreaseDecreas.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from change in market volatility assumption.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitInterestExpense.label: Market Risk Benefit, Interest Expense
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitInterestExpense.definition: Amount of interest expense for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIssuance.label: Market Risk Benefit, Issuance
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitIssuance.definition: Amount of increase in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk from contract issuance.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitPeriodIncreaseD.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitRollForward.label: Market Risk Benefit [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.label: Marketing and Advertising Expense
us-gaap:MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.definition: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

us-gaap:MarketingExpense.label: Marketing Expense
us-gaap:MarketingExpense.definition: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

us-gaap:MaturitiesOfSeniorDebt.label: Maturities of Senior Debt
us-gaap:MaturitiesOfSeniorDebt.definition: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

us-gaap:MaturitiesOfSubordinatedDebt.label: Maturities of Subordinated Debt
us-gaap:MaturitiesOfSubordinatedDebt.definition: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

us-gaap:MerchantMarineOperatingDifferent.label: Merchant Marine, Operating-differential Subsidy
us-gaap:MerchantMarineOperatingDifferent.definition: Amount of operating-differential subsidy received pursuant to Merchant Marine Act of 1936.

us-gaap:MineReclamationAndClosingLiabili.label: Mine Reclamation and Closing Liability, Noncurrent
us-gaap:MineReclamationAndClosingLiabili.definition: Amount of a reclamation and mine closing liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of a mine including the removal of buildings, equipment, machinery and other physical remnants of mining, closure of tailings impoundments, leach pads and other mine features, and contouring, covering and revegetation of waste rock piles and other disturbed areas.

us-gaap:MineralPropertiesAccumulatedDepl.label: Mineral Properties, Accumulated Depletion
us-gaap:MineralPropertiesAccumulatedDepl.definition: The accumulated decrease in the carrying value of the mineral properties as a result of mine or mineral production.

us-gaap:MineralPropertiesAccumulatedImpa.label: Mineral Properties, Accumulated Impairment
us-gaap:MineralPropertiesAccumulatedImpa.definition: The accumulated decrease in the carrying value of the mineral properties as a result of adjustments in estimates of future income generating potential of the mineral property.

us-gaap:MineralPropertiesGross.label: Mineral Properties, Gross
us-gaap:MineralPropertiesGross.definition: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral properties, gross of adjustments.

us-gaap:MinorityInterest.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

us-gaap:MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDist.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
us-gaap:MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDist.definition: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

us-gaap:MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRede.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
us-gaap:MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRede.definition: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

us-gaap:MinorityInterestInNetIncomeLossO.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:MinorityInterestPeriodIncreaseDe.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:MinorityInterestPeriodIncreaseDe.definition: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstate.definition: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateAmortiz.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Amortization of Premium
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateAmortiz.definition: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from amortization of premium.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCostOfM.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Cost of Mortgage Sold
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCostOfM.definition: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from sale.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateForeclo.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Foreclosure
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateForeclo.definition: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from foreclosure.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateNewMort.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, New Mortgage Loan
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateNewMort.definition: Amount of increase in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from new investment.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherAd.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Other Addition
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherAd.definition: Amount of addition to investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, classified as other.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherDe.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Other Deduction
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherDe.definition: Amount of reduction in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, classified as other.

us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstatePeriodI.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstatePeriodI.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

us-gaap:MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpair.label: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)
us-gaap:MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpair.definition: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

us-gaap:MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicy.label: Movement Analysis of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Profits [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicy.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicy.label: Movement Analysis of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicy.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInAccumulatedDepreciatio.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInAuctionMarketPreferred.label: Movement in Auction Market Preferred Securities, Shares Outstanding [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInAuctionMarketPreferred.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInCapitalizedComputerSof.label: Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, after Accumulated Amortization [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInCapitalizedComputerSof.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInClosedBlockDividendObl.label: Movement in Closed Block Dividend Obligation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInClosedBlockDividendObl.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInDeferredSalesInducemen.label: Movement in Deferred Sales Inducements [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInDeferredSalesInducemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInExtendedProductWarrant.label: Movement in Extended Product Warranty Accrual [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInExtendedProductWarrant.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInLossContingencyRelated.label: Movement in Loss Contingency Receivable, Increase (Decrease) [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInLossContingencyRelated.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInMalpracticeLossConting.label: Movement in Malpractice Loss Contingency [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInMalpracticeLossConting.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInMinorityInterestRollFo.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInMinorityInterestRollFo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInMortgageLoansOnRealEst.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Movement in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInMortgageLoansOnRealEst.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInPresentValueOfFutureIn.label: Movement in Present Value of Future Insurance Profits [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInPresentValueOfFutureIn.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInPropertyPlantAndEquipm.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInPropertyPlantAndEquipm.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInStandardAndExtendedPro.label: Movement in Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInStandardAndExtendedPro.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInStandardProductWarrant.label: Movement in Standard Product Warranty Accrual [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInStandardProductWarrant.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MovementInValuationAllowancesAnd.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Movement in Valuation Allowances and Reserves [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:MovementInValuationAllowancesAnd.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionInsignif.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Insignificant, Plan Asset
us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionInsignif.definition: Amount of asset available for benefits to participants in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually insignificant.

us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionInsignif.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Insignificant, Plan Contribution
us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionInsignif.definition: Amount of contribution received by multiemployer pension plan from all employers participating in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually insignificant.

us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionSignific.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Plan Asset
us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionSignific.definition: Amount of asset available for benefits to participants in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant.

us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionSignific.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Plan Contribution
us-gaap:MultiemployerPlanPensionSignific.definition: Amount of contribution received by multiemployer pension plan from all employers participating in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant.

us-gaap:NetAssetValuePerShare.definition: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontin.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontin.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancing.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancing.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancing.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Continuing Operation
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancing.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to continuing operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvesting.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvesting.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvesting.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvesting.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonco.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonco.definition: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonre.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonre.definition: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonre.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedee.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedee.definition: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedee.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToRepor.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAtt.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAtt.definition: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAtt.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLease.label: Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLease.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from recovery.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceFor.definition: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInMeth.label: Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInMeth.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from change in methodology.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInPres.label: Net Investment in Lease, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInPres.definition: Amount of interest income on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseCreditLossEx.label: Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseCreditLossEx.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.label: Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.label: Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.label: Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAcc.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseNonaccrualIn.label: Net Investment in Lease, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseNonaccrualIn.definition: Amount of interest income on nonaccrual net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseNoncurrent.label: Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeaseNoncurrent.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeasePurchase.label: Net Investment in Lease, Purchase
us-gaap:NetInvestmentInLeasePurchase.definition: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome.label: Net Investment Income
us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome.definition: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

us-gaap:NetPeriodicDefinedBenefitsExpens.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
us-gaap:NetPeriodicDefinedBenefitsExpens.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionI.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Inventory Acquired
us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionI.definition: The amount of inventory that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionI.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionI.definition: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionO.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired
us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionO.definition: Amount of assets, classified as other, acquired in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestDecreaseFr.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestDecreaseFr.definition: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Nonredeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Redeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Nonredeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Redeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Nonredeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Nonredeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other nonredeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Redeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other redeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncom.definition: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.definition: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.definition: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFr.definition: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

us-gaap:NoncurrentAssets.label: Long-Lived Asset, Excluding Financial Instrument, Customer Relationship, Mortgage Servicing Right, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, and Deferred Tax Asset, Amount
us-gaap:NoncurrentAssets.definition: Amount of long-lived asset, excluding financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

us-gaap:NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetG.label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
us-gaap:NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetG.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpense.definition: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpe.label: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpe.definition: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFees.label: Director Fee
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFees.definition: Amount of expense for service provided by entity's director.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvi.label: Investment Advisory Fee
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvi.definition: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseOfferingCost.label: Offering Cost, Expense
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseOfferingCost.definition: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpensePrintingAndFul.label: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment
us-gaap:NoninterestExpensePrintingAndFul.definition: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerfo.label: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerfo.definition: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentA.label: Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentA.definition: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.

us-gaap:NoninterestIncome.label: Noninterest Income
us-gaap:NoninterestIncome.definition: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

us-gaap:NoninterestIncomeOther.label: Noninterest Income, Other
us-gaap:NoninterestIncomeOther.definition: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

us-gaap:NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingI.label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
us-gaap:NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingI.definition: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

us-gaap:NonmonetaryTransactionGainLossRe.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer
us-gaap:NonmonetaryTransactionGainLossRe.definition: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).

us-gaap:NonmonetaryTransactionGrossOpera.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gross Operating Revenue Recognized
us-gaap:NonmonetaryTransactionGrossOpera.definition: The amount of gross operating revenue recognized in a nonmonetary transaction.

us-gaap:NonoperatingGainsLosses.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
us-gaap:NonoperatingGainsLosses.definition: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

us-gaap:NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossCurr.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossCurr.definition: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossNonc.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossNonc.definition: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

us-gaap:NotesIssued1.label: Notes Issued
us-gaap:NotesIssued1.definition: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

us-gaap:NotesPayable.label: Notes Payable
us-gaap:NotesPayable.definition: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:NotesReceivableGross.definition: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

us-gaap:NotesReduction.label: Notes Reduction
us-gaap:NotesReduction.definition: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

us-gaap:ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLia.label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Expense
us-gaap:ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLia.definition: Amount of expense in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

us-gaap:OccupancyNet.label: Occupancy, Net
us-gaap:OccupancyNet.definition: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

us-gaap:OciBeforeReclassificationsNetOfT.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OciBeforeReclassificationsNetOfT.definition: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabili.definition: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabili.label: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabili.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabili.label: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabili.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAs.label: Office of Finance, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
us-gaap:OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAs.definition: Amount of a Federal Home Loan Bank's (FHLBank) proportionate share of the costs of operating the Office of Finance.

us-gaap:OfficersCompensation.label: Salary and Wage, Officer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
us-gaap:OfficersCompensation.definition: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by officer. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodD.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Property and Equipment, Accumulated Depletion
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodD.definition: Amount of accumulated depletion of oil and gas properties accounted for under full cost method.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodG.label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Property and Equipment, before Accumulated Depletion
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodG.definition: Amount, before accumulated depletion, of oil and gas properties subject to amortization accounted for under full cost method.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Accumulated Impairment, Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment of oil and gas property carried under the successful effort method.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of oil and gas property accounted for under successful efforts method.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Accumulated Impairment
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.definition: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for oil and gas property accounted for under successful efforts method.

us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment
us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffor.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties accounted for under successful efforts method.
