us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses.label: Operating Costs and Expenses
us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses.definition: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

us-gaap:OperatingExpenses.label: Operating Expenses
us-gaap:OperatingExpenses.definition: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

us-gaap:OperatingInsuranceAndClaimsCosts.label: Operating Insurance and Claims Costs, Production
us-gaap:OperatingInsuranceAndClaimsCosts.definition: Insurance and claims costs directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense.label: Operating Lease, Expense
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense.definition: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseImpairmentLoss.label: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseImpairmentLoss.definition: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseInitialDirectCostE.label: Operating Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, over Term
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseInitialDirectCostE.definition: Amount of operating lease initial direct cost recognized as expense over lease term.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome.definition: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments.label: Operating Lease, Payments
us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments.definition: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

us-gaap:OperatingLeasePaymentsUse.label: Operating Lease, Payments, Use
us-gaap:OperatingLeasePaymentsUse.definition: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.definition: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmo.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Periodic Reduction
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmo.definition: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseVariableLeaseIncom.label: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseVariableLeaseIncom.definition: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

us-gaap:OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementDe.label: Depreciation, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease
us-gaap:OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementDe.definition: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

us-gaap:OrderFlowFees.label: Order Flow Fees
us-gaap:OrderFlowFees.definition: The amount of expense in the period for the cost of other broker-dealers' executions of orders.

us-gaap:OrganizationalAndOfferingCostsEx.definition: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company and for formation and organizational costs incurred to establish entity to do business.

us-gaap:OrganizationalCostExpense.label: Organizational Cost, Expense
us-gaap:OrganizationalCostExpense.definition: Amount of expense for formation and organizational costs incurred to establish entity to do business.

us-gaap:OriginationOfLoanToPurchaseCommo.label: Origination of Loan to Purchase Common Stock
us-gaap:OriginationOfLoanToPurchaseCommo.definition: Cash outflow for origination of loan for purchasing common stock.

us-gaap:OriginationOfLoansToEmployeeStoc.label: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
us-gaap:OriginationOfLoansToEmployeeStoc.definition: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

us-gaap:OriginationOfNotesReceivableFrom.label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
us-gaap:OriginationOfNotesReceivableFrom.definition: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

us-gaap:OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharg.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
us-gaap:OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharg.definition: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

us-gaap:OtherAssetImpairmentCharges.label: Other Asset Impairment Charges
us-gaap:OtherAssetImpairmentCharges.definition: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

us-gaap:OtherAssets.label: Other Assets
us-gaap:OtherAssets.definition: Amount of assets classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.definition: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.definition: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.definition: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailabl.definition: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeBeforeTa.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.definition: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.definition: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedB.definition: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.definition: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.definition: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.label: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignC.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmor.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmor.definition: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBefo.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBefo.definition: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBefo.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBefo.definition: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCash.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCash.definition: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCash.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCash.definition: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDeri.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax, Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDeri.definition: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.definition: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.definition: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFina.definition: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFore.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFore.definition: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.definition: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.definition: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.definition: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetO.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxP.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxP.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxP.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxP.definition: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTax.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeTaxPorti.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

us-gaap:OtherCostAndExpenseOperating.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
us-gaap:OtherCostAndExpenseOperating.definition: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

us-gaap:OtherCostOfOperatingRevenue.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
us-gaap:OtherCostOfOperatingRevenue.definition: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:OtherDeferredCostsGross.label: Other Deferred Costs, Gross
us-gaap:OtherDeferredCostsGross.definition: Gross amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization.definition: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherExpenseFromRealEstatePartne.label: Other Expense from Real Estate Partnership Operations
us-gaap:OtherExpenseFromRealEstatePartne.definition: Amount of selling, general, and administrative expenses, and other expenses, related to investments in real estate partnerships.

us-gaap:OtherExpenses.label: Other Expenses
us-gaap:OtherExpenses.definition: Amount of expense classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExp.label: Other General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExp.definition: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherGeneralExpense.label: Other General Expense
us-gaap:OtherGeneralExpense.definition: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

us-gaap:OtherIncome.label: Other Income
us-gaap:OtherIncome.definition: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitCont.label: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
us-gaap:OtherIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitCont.definition: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

us-gaap:OtherInterestAndDividendIncome.label: Other Interest and Dividend Income
us-gaap:OtherInterestAndDividendIncome.definition: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherLaborRelatedExpenses.label: Other Labor-related Expenses
us-gaap:OtherLaborRelatedExpenses.definition: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNoninterestExpense.label: Other Noninterest Expense
us-gaap:OtherNoninterestExpense.definition: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingAssetRelatedInc.label: Other Nonoperating-Asset Related Income
us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingAssetRelatedInc.definition: Amount of income related to nonoperating assets, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Expense
us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingExpense.definition: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingGainsLosses.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingGainsLosses.definition: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncome.label: Other Nonoperating Income
us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncome.definition: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.definition: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringExpense.label: Other Nonrecurring Expense
us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringExpense.definition: Amount of other expense that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringGain.label: Other Nonrecurring Gain
us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringGain.definition: Amount of gain that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringIncome.label: Other Nonrecurring Income
us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringIncome.definition: Amount of other income that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
us-gaap:OtherNonrecurringIncomeExpense.definition: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncome.label: Other Operating Income
us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncome.definition: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.definition: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

us-gaap:OtherPaymentsToAcquireBusinesses.label: Other Payments to Acquire Businesses
us-gaap:OtherPaymentsToAcquireBusinesses.definition: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

us-gaap:OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayme.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
us-gaap:OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayme.definition: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

us-gaap:OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndA.label: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
us-gaap:OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndA.definition: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstate.definition: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateAdditions.label: Other Real Estate, Additions
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateAdditions.definition: Additions of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCovered.definition: Carrying amount of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredAdditions.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Additions
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredAdditions.definition: Additions of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredDisposals.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Disposals
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredDisposals.definition: Disposals of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredImprovemen.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Improvements
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredImprovemen.definition: Improvements made to other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredPeriodIncr.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredPeriodIncr.definition: Change in carrying amount of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredRollForwar.label: Other Real Estate, Covered [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredRollForwar.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredValuationA.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Valuation Adjustments
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateCoveredValuationA.definition: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateDisposals.label: Other Real Estate, Disposals
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateDisposals.definition: Disposals of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateImprovements.label: Other Real Estate, Improvements
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateImprovements.definition: Improvements to other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCovered.definition: Carrying amount of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredAdditio.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Additions
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredAdditio.definition: Additions of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredDisposa.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Disposals
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredDisposa.definition: Disposals of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredImprove.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Improvements
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredImprove.definition: Improvements made to other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredPeriodI.definition: Change in carrying amount of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredRollFor.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredRollFor.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredValuati.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Valuation Adjustments
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateNonCoveredValuati.definition: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstatePeriodIncreaseDec.label: Other Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:OtherRealEstatePeriodIncreaseDec.definition: Change in carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateRollForward.label: Other Real Estate [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:OtherRealEstateValuationAdjustme.label: Other Real Estate, Valuation Adjustments
us-gaap:OtherRealEstateValuationAdjustme.definition: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

us-gaap:OtherReceivableAllowanceForCredi.label: Other Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:OtherReceivableAllowanceForCredi.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable classified as other and noncurrent.

us-gaap:OtherReceivableBeforeAllowanceFo.label: Other Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:OtherReceivableBeforeAllowanceFo.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of receivable classified as other and noncurrent.

us-gaap:OtherReceivablesGrossCurrent.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
us-gaap:OtherReceivablesGrossCurrent.definition: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:OtherRecurringIncome.label: Other Recurring Income
us-gaap:OtherRecurringIncome.definition: Amount of recurring income classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherResearchAndDevelopmentExpen.label: Other Research and Development Expense
us-gaap:OtherResearchAndDevelopmentExpen.definition: Amount of other research and development expense.

us-gaap:OtherRestructuringCosts.label: Other Restructuring Costs
us-gaap:OtherRestructuringCosts.definition: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:OtherSellingAndMarketingExpense.label: Other Selling and Marketing Expense
us-gaap:OtherSellingAndMarketingExpense.definition: Amount of selling and marketing expense classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministra.label: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministra.definition: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

us-gaap:OtherTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:OtherTaxExpenseBenefit.definition: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

us-gaap:OtherUnderwritingExpense.label: Other Underwriting Expense
us-gaap:OtherUnderwritingExpense.definition: Costs incurred during the period, such as those relating to general administration and policy maintenance that do not vary with and are not primarily related to the acquisition or renewal of insurance contracts.

us-gaap:PartnersCapital.definition: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountAcquisitio.label: Partners' Capital Account, Acquisitions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountAcquisitio.definition: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountContributi.label: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountContributi.definition: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountDeferredCo.label: Partners' Capital Account, Deferred Compensation
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountDeferredCo.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to deferred compensation. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountDistributi.label: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountDistributi.definition: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesA.label: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesA.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountOptionExer.label: Partners' Capital Account, Option Exercise
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountOptionExer.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to option exercise. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPeriodIncr.label: Increase (Decrease) in Partners' Capital
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPeriodIncr.definition: Changes in the ownership interest during the period of each class of partners. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPrivatePla.label: Partners' Capital Account, Private Placement of Units
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPrivatePla.definition: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a private placement.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSale.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSale.definition: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountRedemption.label: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountRedemption.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCa.label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCa.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnit.label: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnit.definition: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnit.label: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units [Abstract]

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUn.label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUn.definition: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUn.label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Reissued
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUn.definition: Value of units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the monetary value of these units which were reissued during the period.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedC.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedC.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnits.definition: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAcqui.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAcqui.definition: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsContr.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Contributed
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsContr.definition: Units contributed by each class of partners during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConve.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Converted
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConve.definition: The number of units converted into shares of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsPerio.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsPerio.definition: Total net change in the units of each class of partners' capital accounts during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedee.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedee.definition: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSaleO.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSaleO.definition: Total units issued during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSaleO.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units [Abstract]

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldI.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldI.definition: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldI.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldI.definition: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreas.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreas.definition: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreas.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Reissued
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreas.definition: Units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the number of these units which were reissued during the period.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsUnitb.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Number of Units
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsUnitb.definition: Number of units issued for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalOther.label: Partners' Capital, Other
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalOther.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset.label: Payment for Acquisition, Crypto Asset
us-gaap:PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:PaymentForAdministrativeFees.label: Payment for Administrative Fees
us-gaap:PaymentForAdministrativeFees.definition: Amount paid to managing member or general partner, affiliate of managing member or general partner, or affiliate of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) for administrative services provided to the LLC or LP, for example, but not limited to, salaries, rent, or overhead costs.

us-gaap:PaymentForAdvanceForConstruction.label: Payment for Advance for Construction, Financing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentForAdvanceForConstruction.definition: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as financing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.definition: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.definition: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
us-gaap:PaymentForContingentConsideratio.definition: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

us-gaap:PaymentForIncentiveFee.label: Payment for Incentive Fee
us-gaap:PaymentForIncentiveFee.definition: Amount paid for incentive rights held by the managing member or general partner, of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

us-gaap:PaymentForManagementFee.label: Payment for Management Fee
us-gaap:PaymentForManagementFee.definition: Amount paid to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

us-gaap:PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuan.label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
us-gaap:PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuan.definition: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

us-gaap:PaymentToAcquireLifeInsurancePol.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Operating Activities
us-gaap:PaymentToAcquireLifeInsurancePol.definition: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as operating activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

us-gaap:PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
us-gaap:PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate.definition: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

us-gaap:PaymentsForAffordableHousingProg.label: Payment for Affordable Housing Program Obligation by Federal Home Loan Bank
us-gaap:PaymentsForAffordableHousingProg.definition: Amount of cash outflow for payment made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

references.source: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932
references.citation: Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932 1291 10

us-gaap:PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOth.label: Payments for Bonds Transferred to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOth.definition: Amount of cash outflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability of consolidated obligations to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

us-gaap:PaymentsForBrokerageFees.label: Payments for Brokerage Fees
us-gaap:PaymentsForBrokerageFees.definition: The amount of cash paid for brokerage fees during the current period. This element is intended to represent the brokerage fees paid by and between financial industry participants.

us-gaap:PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.label: Payments for Capital Improvements
us-gaap:PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

us-gaap:PaymentsForCommissions.label: Payments for Commissions
us-gaap:PaymentsForCommissions.definition: The amount of cash paid for commissions during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForCongressionallyMandat.label: Payments for Congressionally Mandated Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
us-gaap:PaymentsForCongressionallyMandat.definition: Amount of cash outflow for payments made by the Federal Home Loan Banks for Congressionally mandated assessments.

us-gaap:PaymentsForConstructionInProcess.label: Payments for Construction in Process
us-gaap:PaymentsForConstructionInProcess.definition: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDelayedTaxExemptExcha.label: Payments for Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
us-gaap:PaymentsForDelayedTaxExemptExcha.definition: Cash outflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDeposits.label: Payments for Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForDeposits.definition: The amount of cash paid for deposits on goods and services during the period; excludes time deposits and deposits with other institutions, which pertain to financial service entities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebt.label: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebt.definition: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateA.label: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateA.definition: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsWithOtherInst.label: Payments for Deposits with Other Institutions
us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsWithOtherInst.definition: Cash paid to make deposits at other institutions during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentF.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentF.definition: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentI.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentI.definition: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:PaymentsForEnvironmentalLiabilit.label: Payments for Environmental Liabilities
us-gaap:PaymentsForEnvironmentalLiabilit.definition: Cash outflows made during the period for environmental remediation activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAd.label: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAd.definition: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForFees.label: Payments for Other Fees
us-gaap:PaymentsForFees.definition: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForFilmCosts.label: Payments for Film Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsForFilmCosts.definition: Cash payments related to direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

us-gaap:PaymentsForFlightEquipment.label: Payments for Flight Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsForFlightEquipment.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

us-gaap:PaymentsForHedgeFinancingActivit.label: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForHedgeFinancingActivit.definition: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

us-gaap:PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivit.label: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivit.definition: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

us-gaap:PaymentsForInvestmentInRestricte.label: Payments for Investment in Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
us-gaap:PaymentsForInvestmentInRestricte.definition: The cash outflow for investments in restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLeaseCommissions.label: Payment for Lease Commission, Investing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForLeaseCommissions.definition: Amount of cash outflow for lease commission incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLeasingCosts.label: Payment for Initial Direct Cost, Lease, Investing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForLeasingCosts.definition: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissio.label: Payment for Initial Direct Cost and Leasehold Improvement for Lease, Investing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissio.definition: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost and cost for leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLegalSettlements.label: Payments for Legal Settlements
us-gaap:PaymentsForLegalSettlements.definition: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLoans.label: Payments for Loans
us-gaap:PaymentsForLoans.definition: Cash payments for and related to principal collection on loans related to operating activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForLossesAndLossAdjustme.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
us-gaap:PaymentsForLossesAndLossAdjustme.definition: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

us-gaap:PaymentsForMergerRelatedCosts.label: Payments for Merger Related Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsForMergerRelatedCosts.definition: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

us-gaap:PaymentsForMortgageDeposits.label: Payments for Mortgage Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForMortgageDeposits.definition: Amount of cash outflow for advance payment to show intention to complete mortgage financing.

us-gaap:PaymentsForNuclearFuel.label: Payments for Nuclear Fuel
us-gaap:PaymentsForNuclearFuel.definition: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOperatingActivities.label: Payments for Operating Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForOperatingActivities.definition: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchas.label: Payment for Origination and Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchas.definition: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgage.label: Payment for Origination, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgage.definition: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherDeposits.label: Payments for Other Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherDeposits.definition: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherOperatingActivit.label: Payment for Other Operating Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherOperatingActivit.definition: Amount of cash outflow for operating activity, classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherTaxes.label: Payments for Other Taxes
us-gaap:PaymentsForOtherTaxes.definition: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForParticipationLiabilit.label: Payments for Participation Liabilities
us-gaap:PaymentsForParticipationLiabilit.definition: Cash payments related to participation costs.

us-gaap:PaymentsForPostemploymentBenefit.label: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
us-gaap:PaymentsForPostemploymentBenefit.definition: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

us-gaap:PaymentsForPreviousAcquisition.label: Payments for Previous Acquisition
us-gaap:PaymentsForPreviousAcquisition.definition: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromAvailable.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-Sale Securities, Short-Term
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromAvailable.definition: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinesse.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinesse.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDelayedTa.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDelayedTa.definition: Net cash outflow or inflow from a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as tax deferred exempt exchange.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositOn.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositOn.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsO.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsO.definition: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativ.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativ.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHo.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHo.definition: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalRe.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalRe.definition: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition or sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFina.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFina.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInve.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInve.definition: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHeldtomat.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Held-to-Maturity Securities, Short-Term
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHeldtomat.definition: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestmen.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestmen.definition: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsur.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsur.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPa.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Limited Partnership
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPa.definition: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndL.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndL.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansRece.definition: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLongtermI.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-Term Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLongtermI.definition: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageD.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageD.definition: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageS.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageS.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFu.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherDepo.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherDepo.definition: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInte.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInte.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInve.label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInve.definition: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoan.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoan.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherReal.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherReal.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoa.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Policy Loans
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoa.definition: Net amount paid or received by the entity associated with issuance or collection of loans made to policy holders, principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiv.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiv.definition: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstat.label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstat.definition: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstat.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstat.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCo.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCo.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTerm.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-Term Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTerm.definition: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromTenantAll.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromTenantAll.definition: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

us-gaap:PaymentsForPurchaseOfOtherAssets.label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsForPurchaseOfOtherAssets.definition: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsForPurchaseOfSecuritiesO.label: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsForPurchaseOfSecuritiesO.definition: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

us-gaap:PaymentsForReinsurance.label: Payments for Reinsurance
us-gaap:PaymentsForReinsurance.definition: Cash payments made for reinsurance during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRemovalCosts.label: Payments for Removal Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsForRemovalCosts.definition: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRent.label: Payments for Rent
us-gaap:PaymentsForRent.definition: Cash payments to lessor's for use of assets under operating leases.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonSto.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonSto.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfConvertib.label: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfConvertib.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfInitialPu.label: Payments for Repurchase of Initial Public Offering
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfInitialPu.definition: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEqui.label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEqui.definition: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPreferred.label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPreferred.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPrivatePl.label: Payments for Repurchase of Private Placement
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPrivatePl.definition: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.definition: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemabl.definition: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfTrustPref.label: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfTrustPref.definition: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfWarrants.label: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfWarrants.definition: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRestructuring.label: Payments for Restructuring
us-gaap:PaymentsForRestructuring.definition: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:PaymentsForRoyalties.label: Payments for Royalties
us-gaap:PaymentsForRoyalties.definition: The amount of cash paid for royalties during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUn.label: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUn.definition: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

us-gaap:PaymentsForSoftware.label: Payments for Software
us-gaap:PaymentsForSoftware.definition: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

us-gaap:PaymentsForTenantImprovements.label: Payment for Leasehold Improvement, Lessor, Investing Activity
us-gaap:PaymentsForTenantImprovements.definition: Amount of cash outflow for cost of leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsForTimeDeposits.label: Payments for Time Deposits
us-gaap:PaymentsForTimeDeposits.definition: Cash paid to customers who withdraw money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

us-gaap:PaymentsForUnderwritingExpense.label: Payments for Underwriting Expense
us-gaap:PaymentsForUnderwritingExpense.definition: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution.label: Payments of Capital Distribution
us-gaap:PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution.definition: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCost.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCost.definition: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.definition: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts.label: Payments of Debt Restructuring Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts.definition: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDerivativeIssuanceCost.label: Payments of Derivative Issuance Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDerivativeIssuanceCost.definition: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of a derivative security.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffilia.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffilia.definition: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends.label: Payments of Dividends
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends.definition: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.definition: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.
