us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInter.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInter.definition: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStoc.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStoc.definition: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.label: Payments of Financing Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.definition: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfLoanCosts.label: Payments of Loan Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfLoanCosts.definition: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfMergerRelatedCostsFina.label: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsOfMergerRelatedCostsFina.definition: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends.definition: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts.label: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts.definition: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

us-gaap:PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingF.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
us-gaap:PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingF.definition: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInter.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInter.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealE.label: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealE.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvesting.label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvesting.definition: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSal.label: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSal.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBuildings.label: Payments to Acquire Buildings
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBuildings.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessThreeNe.label: Payments to Acquire Business Three, Net of Cash Acquired
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessThreeNe.definition: The cash outflow associated with a third acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessTwoNetO.label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessTwoNetO.definition: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndIn.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndIn.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOf.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOf.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealE.label: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealE.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquipmentOnLeas.label: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquipmentOnLeas.definition: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInv.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInv.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritie.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Securities, FV-NI
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritie.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFederalHomeLoan.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFederalHomeLoan.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveS.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveS.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivab.label: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivab.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFurnitureAndFix.label: Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFurnitureAndFix.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireHeldForSaleReal.label: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireHeldForSaleReal.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturityS.label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-Maturity Securities
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturityS.definition: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResear.label: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResear.definition: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAsset.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAsset.definition: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJoint.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJoint.definition: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsi.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsi.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLand.label: Payments to Acquire Land
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLand.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLandHeldForUse.label: Payment for Acquisition, Land, Held-for-Use
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLandHeldForUse.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLeaseReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLeaseReceivable.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForIn.label: Payment for Acquisition, Lease, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForIn.definition: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePo.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePo.definition: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartners.label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartners.definition: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesH.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesH.definition: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesH.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment, Credit Card Securitization
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesH.definition: The cash outflow from the purchase of securitized credit card receivables which are held for investment purposes. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInv.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInv.definition: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestm.label: Payments to Acquire Long-Term Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestm.definition: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEqu.label: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEqu.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireManagementContr.label: Payments to Acquire Management Contract Rights
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireManagementContr.definition: The cash outflow from amounts paid for the rights to manage the property.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecur.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecur.definition: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMineralRights.label: Payments to Acquire Mineral Rights
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMineralRights.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Mining Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets.definition: The cash outflow from the purchase of mining and mining related assets during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedS.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedS.definition: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedS.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-Maturity
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedS.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesRe.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesRe.definition: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServici.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServici.definition: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.definition: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipm.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipm.definition: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProper.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProper.definition: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProper.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProper.definition: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestment.label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestment.definition: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherLoansAndLe.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherLoansAndLe.definition: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductive.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductive.definition: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPl.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPl.definition: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Other Receivables
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherReceivable.definition: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePartnersInteres.label: Payments to Acquire Partners Interest in Real Estate Partnership, Net of Cash Acquired
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePartnersInteres.definition: The cash outflow from the purchase of ownership in a partnership, the purpose of which is to construct, sell, hold or invest in real estate.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.definition: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProjects.label: Payments to Acquire Projects
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProjects.definition: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRe.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRe.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldF.label: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldF.definition: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireReceivables.label: Payments to Acquire Receivables
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireReceivables.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireResidentialReal.label: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireResidentialReal.definition: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCerti.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCerti.definition: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInves.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInves.definition: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInteres.label: Payments to Acquire Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInteres.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRoyaltyInterest.label: Payments to Acquire Royalty Interests in Mining Properties
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRoyaltyInterest.definition: The cash outflow from the purchase of royalty interests in mining properties is the amount of cash the mineral producer pays the owner of the mine or mineral resource.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvest.label: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvest.definition: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireSoftware.label: Payments to Acquire Software
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireSoftware.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTimberlands.label: Payments to Acquire Timberlands
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTimberlands.definition: The cash outflow for acquisition of timber and timberlands during the period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTradingSecuriti.label: Payment for Acquisition, Trading Security, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTradingSecuriti.definition: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTrustPreferredI.label: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireTrustPreferredI.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWasteWaterSyste.label: Payments to Acquire Waste Water Systems
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWasteWaterSyste.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWa.label: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWa.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities; and waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWaterSystems.label: Payments to Acquire Water Systems
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireWaterSystems.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAsset.label: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAsset.definition: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToDevelopSoftware.label: Payments to Develop Software
us-gaap:PaymentsToDevelopSoftware.definition: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

us-gaap:PaymentsToEmployees.label: Payments to Employees
us-gaap:PaymentsToEmployees.definition: Payments of cash to employees, including wages and salaries, during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAn.label: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties
us-gaap:PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAn.definition: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).

us-gaap:PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRel.label: Payments to Fund Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
us-gaap:PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRel.definition: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

us-gaap:PaymentsToFundPolicyLoans.label: Payments to Fund Policy Loans
us-gaap:PaymentsToFundPolicyLoans.definition: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

us-gaap:PaymentsToInvestInDecommissionin.label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
us-gaap:PaymentsToInvestInDecommissionin.definition: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders.definition: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSa.definition: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseMortgageLoansH.label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseMortgageLoansH.definition: The cash outflow used to purchase loans that are secured with real estate mortgage and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeld.label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeld.definition: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:PaymentsToSuppliers.label: Payments to Suppliers
us-gaap:PaymentsToSuppliers.definition: Payments of cash to suppliers for goods and services during the current period.

us-gaap:PaymentsToSuppliersAndEmployees.definition: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementBen.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementBen.definition: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

us-gaap:PensionContributions.label: Payment for Pension Benefits
us-gaap:PensionContributions.definition: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

us-gaap:PhaseInPlanAmountOfCapitalizedCo.label: Phase-in Plan, Amount of Capitalized Costs Recovered
us-gaap:PhaseInPlanAmountOfCapitalizedCo.definition: The sum total amount of allowable costs capitalized in the period pertaining to a phase-in plan and previously capitalized costs that were recovered (recognized in earnings) during the period through rates.

us-gaap:PhaseInPlanAmountOfCostsDeferred.label: Phase-in Plan, Amount of Costs Deferred for Rate-making Purposes
us-gaap:PhaseInPlanAmountOfCostsDeferred.definition: The total amount of allowable costs capitalized during the period by the entity pertaining to Phase-In plans which were deferred on the expectation of future recovery.

us-gaap:PhaseInPlanNetChangeInAmountOfCo.label: Phase-in Plan, Net Change in Amount of Costs Deferred for Rate-making Purposes
us-gaap:PhaseInPlanNetChangeInAmountOfCo.definition: The increase (decrease) during the period in the costs deferred for rate-making purposes.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceBenefi.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Benefit Payment
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceBenefi.definition: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder account balance from benefit payment.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceCustom.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceCustom.definition: Indicates customer for policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceGeogra.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceGeogra.definition: Indicates geographical component for policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceIncrea.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Increase (Decrease) from Other Change
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceIncrea.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability for policyholder account balance from change, classified as other.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceIssuan.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Issuance
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceIssuan.definition: Amount of increase in liability for policyholder account balance from contract issuance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePeriod.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePeriod.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability for policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePolicy.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Policy Charge
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePolicy.definition: Amount of decrease in liability for policyholder account balance from policy charge.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePremiu.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Premium Received
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalancePremiu.definition: Amount of cash inflow to policyholder account balance from premium received.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceProduc.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceProduc.definition: Indicates product and service for policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceRollFo.label: Policyholder Account Balance [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceRollFo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceSegmen.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceSegmen.definition: Indicates segment that includes policyholder account balance.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceSurren.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Surrender
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceSurren.definition: Amount of decrease in liability for policyholder account balance from contract redemption.
Amount of decrease in liability for policyholder account balance from contract redemption and withdrawal of funds.

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceSurren.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Surrender and Withdrawal [Abstract]

us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceWithdr.label: Policyholder Account Balance, Withdrawal
us-gaap:PolicyholderAccountBalanceWithdr.definition: Amount of decrease in liability for policyholder account balance from withdrawal of funds.

us-gaap:PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsInc.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Direct
us-gaap:PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsInc.definition: Amount, before effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

us-gaap:PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsInc.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net
us-gaap:PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsInc.definition: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

us-gaap:PolicyholderDividends.label: Policyholder Dividends, Expense
us-gaap:PolicyholderDividends.definition: Amount of expense for dividends to policyholders.

us-gaap:PolicyholderFunds.definition: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

us-gaap:PostageExpense.label: Postage Expense
us-gaap:PostageExpense.definition: Amount of expense associated with postage.

us-gaap:PreOpeningCosts.label: Pre-Opening Costs
us-gaap:PreOpeningCosts.definition: Expenditures associated with opening new locations which are noncapital in nature and expensed as incurred.

us-gaap:PreferredStockAccretionOfRedempt.label: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
us-gaap:PreferredStockAccretionOfRedempt.definition: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.

us-gaap:PreferredStockConversionsInducem.label: Preferred Stock Conversions, Inducements
us-gaap:PreferredStockConversionsInducem.definition: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleDownRou.label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Down Round Feature, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount
us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleDownRou.definition: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for convertible preferred stock.

us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleDownRou.label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Down Round Feature, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleDownRou.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for convertible preferred stock.

us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherA.label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherA.definition: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsIncomeSta.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsIncomeSta.definition: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsShares.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Shares
us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsShares.definition: Number of shares of preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionDiscount.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount
us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionDiscount.definition: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.

us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionPremium.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionPremium.definition: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesOutstanding.definition: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

us-gaap:PremiumDeficiencyTestingExpenseL.label: Premium Deficiency Testing Expense, Long-Duration Contract, Amount
us-gaap:PremiumDeficiencyTestingExpenseL.definition: Amount of expense for premium deficiency and loss recognition testing on long-duration contract issued by insurance entity. Excludes closed block.

us-gaap:PremiumReceivableCreditLossExpen.label: Premium Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:PremiumReceivableCreditLossExpen.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on premium receivable.

us-gaap:PremiumsEarnedNet.label: Premiums Earned, Net
us-gaap:PremiumsEarnedNet.definition: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.definition: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable from recovery.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDo.definition: Amount of writeoff of premium receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableGainLossOnSale.label: Premiums Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sale of Receivables
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableGainLossOnSale.definition: The aggregate amount of gains or losses on transfers of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableGross.label: Premiums Receivable, Gross
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableGross.definition: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, before deducting the allowance for doubtful accounts.

us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableProceedsFromSa.label: Premiums Receivable, Proceeds from Sale of Receivables
us-gaap:PremiumsReceivableProceedsFromSa.definition: The amount of proceeds from the transfer of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

us-gaap:PremiumsWrittenGross.label: Premiums Written, Gross
us-gaap:PremiumsWrittenGross.definition: Amount of direct and assumed premiums written.

us-gaap:PremiumsWrittenNet.label: Premiums Written, Net
us-gaap:PremiumsWrittenNet.definition: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

us-gaap:PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet.label: Prepayment Fees on Advances, Net
us-gaap:PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet.definition: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Indicates customer for present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Experience Adjustment
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Indicates geographical component for present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Indicates product and service for present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Indicates segment that includes present value of future insurance profit.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Accumulated Amortization
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of accumulated amortization of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Addition from Acquisition
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of addition for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Disposition
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination, disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Gross
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:PresentValueOfFutureInsurancePro.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset representing the present value of future profits.

us-gaap:PrincipalInvestmentGainsLosses.label: Principal Investment Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:PrincipalInvestmentGainsLosses.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

us-gaap:PrincipalTransactionsRevenue.label: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
us-gaap:PrincipalTransactionsRevenue.definition: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

us-gaap:ProceedsAccountsReceivablePrevio.label: Proceeds, Accounts Receivable, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsAccountsReceivablePrevio.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of accounts receivable previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsContractWithCustomerAsse.label: Proceeds, Contract with Customer, Asset, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsContractWithCustomerAsse.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsDebtSecuritiesAvailableF.label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsDebtSecuritiesAvailableF.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMatu.label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMatu.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsDirectFinancingLeaseNetI.label: Proceeds, Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsDirectFinancingLeaseNetI.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in direct financing lease, previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSe.label: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
us-gaap:ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSe.definition: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContrib.label: Proceeds from Advance for and Contribution in Aid of Construction, Financing Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContrib.definition: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromAdvancesForConstruct.label: Proceeds from Advance for Construction, Investing Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromAdvancesForConstruct.definition: Amount of cash inflow from advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, borrowing from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestme.label: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates
us-gaap:ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestme.definition: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromBankDebt.label: Proceeds from Bank Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromBankDebt.definition: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFrom.label: Proceeds from Bonds Transferred from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
us-gaap:ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFrom.definition: Amount of cash inflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability for consolidated obligations of another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollaborators.label: Proceeds from Collaborators
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollaborators.definition: Cash received from collaborators during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceT.label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceT.definition: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfFinanceR.label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfFinanceR.definition: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLeaseRec.label: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLeaseRec.definition: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansHel.label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansHel.definition: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansRec.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansRec.definition: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongterm.label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongterm.definition: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfMortgage.label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfMortgage.definition: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesRec.label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesRec.definition: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherLoa.label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherLoa.definition: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes loans that are not mortgages.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherRec.label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherRec.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLo.label: Proceeds from Collection of Policy Loans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLo.definition: The cash inflow associated with the collection of policy loans receivable.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.definition: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.definition: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Held-to-Maturity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetained.definition: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at amortized cost.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCommissionsReceived.label: Proceeds from Commissions Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCommissionsReceived.definition: Cash received for commissions during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromConstructionLoansPay.label: Proceeds from Construction Loans Payable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromConstructionLoansPay.definition: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributedCapital.label: Proceeds from Contributed Capital
us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributedCapital.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfC.label: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction, Investing Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfC.definition: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromAff.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromAff.definition: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromPar.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromPar.definition: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt.label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCustomers.label: Proceeds from Customers
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCustomers.definition: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromCustomersForProgress.label: Proceeds from Customers for Progress Payments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromCustomersForProgress.definition: Cash received from customers as progress payments on projects that have been partially completed.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtMaturingInMoreTh.label: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtMaturingInMoreTh.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCos.label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCos.definition: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExch.label: Proceeds from Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExch.definition: Cash inflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsAppliedToDeb.label: Proceeds from Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsAppliedToDeb.definition: Cash inflow received during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed to the entity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsFromCustomer.label: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsFromCustomer.definition: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstate.label: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstate.definition: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsWithOtherIns.label: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDepositsWithOtherIns.definition: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrument.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrument.definition: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrument.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrument.definition: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset.label: Proceeds from Disposal, Crypto Asset
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset.definition: Amount of cash inflow from disposal of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDistributionOfRestri.label: Proceeds from Distribution of Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDistributionOfRestri.definition: The cash inflow from amounts received from distributions of restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDistributionsReceive.label: Proceeds from Distributions Received from Real Estate Partnerships
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDistributionsReceive.definition: The cash inflow from earnings received from real estate partnerships.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusines.definition: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.definition: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInteres.definition: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfRealEst.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Real Estate Partnership
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfRealEst.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of interest in partnership during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromDividendsReceived.label: Proceeds from Dividends Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromDividendsReceived.definition: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestme.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
us-gaap:ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestme.definition: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankA.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankA.definition: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankB.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankB.definition: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromFeesReceived.label: Proceeds from Fees Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromFeesReceived.definition: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromGrantors.label: Proceeds from Grantors
us-gaap:ProceedsFromGrantors.definition: Cash received from grantors during the current period related to operating activities. This element represents receipts from a guarantor for the amount of guarantee provided.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivi.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivi.definition: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivi.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivi.definition: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundFeder.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, Federal
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundFeder.definition: Amount of cash received from federal tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income. Includes, but is not limited to, national tax received for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundForei.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, Foreign
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundForei.definition: Amount of cash received from foreign tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundState.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, State and Local
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundState.definition: Amount of cash received from state and local tax jurisdictions for refund of tax on income.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds.definition: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCol.label: Proceeds from Insurance Premiums Collected
us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCol.definition: Cash received as payments for insurance premiums during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementI.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementI.definition: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementO.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementO.definition: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromInterestAndDividends.label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromInterestAndDividends.definition: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromInterestReceived.label: Proceeds from Interest Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromInterestReceived.definition: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPubli.label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPubli.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercial.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercial.definition: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonLimi.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonLimi.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStoc.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStoc.definition: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStoc.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStoc.definition: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertibl.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertibl.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt.definition: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFinancialS.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFinancialS.definition: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFirstMortg.label: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFirstMortg.definition: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDe.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDe.definition: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDe.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDe.definition: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMandatoryR.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMandatoryR.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTerm.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-Term Note
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTerm.definition: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongT.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongT.definition: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredL.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredL.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredS.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredS.definition: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredS.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredS.definition: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePla.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePla.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemable.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemable.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemable.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemable.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDeb.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDeb.definition: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredTax.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Tax Exempt Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredTax.definition: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term tax exempt debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLong.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLong.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnde.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnde.definition: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnde.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnde.definition: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSubordinat.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSubordinat.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfTrustPrefe.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfTrustPrefe.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredD.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredD.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredT.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Tax Exempt Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredT.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term tax exempt debt that is not secured by collateral.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEqui.label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEqui.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasePaymentSalesTyp.label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Investing Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasePaymentSalesTyp.definition: Amount of cash inflow from principal payment received from sales-type and direct financing leases classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasePayments.label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Operating Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasePayments.definition: Amount of cash inflow from lease payment, classified as operating activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestm.label: Proceeds from Sale, Lease, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestm.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLegalSettlements.label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLegalSettlements.definition: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived.label: Proceeds from License Fees Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived.definition: Cash received from licensees for license fees during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicie.label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicie.definition: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipIn.label: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipIn.definition: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit.definition: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.
