us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginat.label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginat.definition: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanOriginations1.label: Proceeds from Loan Originations
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanOriginations1.definition: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoans.label: Proceeds from Loans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoans.definition: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredi.label: Proceeds from Long-Term Lines of Credit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredi.definition: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-Maturity Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Securities, Operating Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: Cash received from maturities, prepayments and calls of trading securities and other securities, classified as operating.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepayment.definition: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesRepayments.label: Proceeds from Maturity, Repayment, and Call, Debt Security, Trading, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMaturitiesRepayments.definition: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders.definition: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromMortgageDeposits.label: Proceeds from Mortgage Deposits
us-gaap:ProceedsFromMortgageDeposits.definition: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromNotesPayable.label: Proceeds from Notes Payable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromNotesPayable.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromNuclearFuel.label: Proceeds from Nuclear Fuel
us-gaap:ProceedsFromNuclearFuel.definition: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherDebt.label: Proceeds from Other Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherDebt.definition: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherDeposits.label: Proceeds from Other Deposits
us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherDeposits.definition: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherEquity.label: Proceeds from Other Equity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherEquity.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherOperatingActivi.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherOperatingActivi.definition: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Other Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt.definition: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPartnershipContribut.label: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPartnershipContribut.definition: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsA.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from payments to deposit account and application of deposits to retire or pay down debt during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFu.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFu.definition: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInteres.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInteres.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecurit.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecurit.definition: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermL.label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermL.definition: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFina.label: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFina.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritie.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritie.definition: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSe.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-Term
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSe.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinoritySh.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinoritySh.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPollutionControlBond.label: Proceeds from Pollution Control Bond
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPollutionControlBond.definition: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPreviousAcquisition.label: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPreviousAcquisition.definition: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsO.label: Proceeds from Principal Repayment, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsO.definition: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEst.label: Proceeds from Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEst.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoanPrev.label: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoanPrev.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRefundsFromSuppliers.label: Proceeds from Refunds from Suppliers of Material
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRefundsFromSuppliers.definition: Cash received for refunds from suppliers during the current period. This element includes refunds from suppliers of materials; it excludes refunds from providers of fixed assets.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.label: Proceeds from Related Party Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.definition: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRemovalCosts.label: Proceeds from Removal Costs
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRemovalCosts.definition: Cash inflow resulting from recoveries, by any means, against the cost of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRentsReceived.label: Proceeds from Rents Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRentsReceived.definition: Cash received for rents during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansByEm.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansByEm.definition: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansToPu.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansToPu.definition: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccounts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccounts.definition: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfBankOver.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfBankOver.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommerci.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommerci.definition: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebt.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtMatu.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtMatu.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes long-term debt and short-term debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfFirstMor.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) First Mortgage Bond
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfFirstMor.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfC.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfC.definition: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTerm.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTerm.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPay.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPay.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDeb.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDeb.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLon.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLon.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfPollutio.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Pollution Control Bond
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfPollutio.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from a long-term debt instrument issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities, sewage, or solid waste disposal facilities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedP.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedP.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredD.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredD.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTer.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity.definition: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemab.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemab.definition: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPre.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPre.definition: The cash inflow from issuance of trust preferred securities, net of the cash outflow for repurchasing trust preferred securities, by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromRoyaltiesReceived.label: Proceeds from Royalties Received
us-gaap:ProceedsFromRoyaltiesReceived.definition: Cash received for royalties during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfF.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfL.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfL.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfL.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfL.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfM.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfM.definition: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfN.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfN.definition: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfO.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfR.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfR.definition: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAva.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAva.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHel.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHel.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMar.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMar.definition: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOth.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOth.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTra.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTra.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.definition: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.definition: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndColle.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSa.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSa.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfBuildings.label: Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfBuildings.definition: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodIn.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodIn.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuriti.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Securities, FV-NI
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuriti.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalHomeLoa.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalHomeLoa.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalReserve.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalReserve.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceiva.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceiva.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFlightEquipmen.label: Proceeds from Sale of Flight Equipment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFlightEquipmen.definition: Cash received from sales of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAsse.label: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAsse.definition: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFurnitureAndFi.label: Proceeds from Sale of Furniture and Fixtures
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFurnitureAndFi.definition: The cash inflow from sale of furniture and fixtures.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturity.label: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-Maturity Securities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturity.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInves.label: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInves.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAsse.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAsse.definition: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInCorp.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInCorp.definition: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInPart.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInPart.definition: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInvestmentProj.label: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInvestmentProj.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldForUse.label: Proceeds from Sale, Land, Held-for-Use
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldForUse.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldforinv.label: Proceeds from Sale, Land, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldforinv.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLeaseReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLeaseReceivabl.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeases.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeases.definition: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForIn.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForIn.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSa.definition: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivabl.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvest.label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvest.definition: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMachineryAndEq.label: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMachineryAndEq.definition: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBacked.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBacked.definition: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansH.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansH.definition: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServic.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServic.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfNotesReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfNotesReceivabl.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPrope.label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPrope.definition: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssets1.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssets1.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInv.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInv.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestmen.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestmen.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeld.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeld.definition: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiv.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiv.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherPropertyP.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherPropertyP.definition: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstat.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstat.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstat.label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Other, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstat.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherReceivabl.definition: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAsse.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAsse.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldFo.label: Proceeds from Sale, Property, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldFo.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantA.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantA.definition: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstate.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstate.definition: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeld.label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeld.definition: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInve.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInve.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfSecuritiesOper.label: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfSecuritiesOper.definition: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInves.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInves.definition: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecurit.label: Proceeds from Sale, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecurit.definition: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.definition: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToP.label: Proceeds from Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToP.definition: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterSystems.label: Proceeds from Sale of Water Systems
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterSystems.definition: The cash inflow from sale of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRea.label: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRea.definition: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvesti.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvesti.definition: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSalesOfBusinessAffil.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSalesOfBusinessAffil.definition: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuredLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuredLinesOfCredit.definition: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuredNotesPayable.label: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuredNotesPayable.definition: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritiesPurchasedU.label: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritiesPurchasedU.definition: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCon.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Consumer Loans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCon.definition: The cash inflow from the securitization of receivables for loans to consumers. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCre.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCre.definition: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoa.label: Proceeds from Securitization, Loan, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoa.definition: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoa.label: Proceeds from Securitization, Loan, Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoa.definition: The cash inflow from securitizing loans held with the intention to resell in the near future.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturin.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturin.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturin.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturin.definition: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercise.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercise.definition: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockPlans.label: Proceeds from Stock Plans
us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockPlans.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromSubordinatedShortTer.label: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:ProceedsFromSubordinatedShortTer.definition: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromTimeDepositsAccepted.label: Proceeds from Time Deposits Accepted
us-gaap:ProceedsFromTimeDepositsAccepted.definition: Cash received from customers who deposit money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

us-gaap:ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCred.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
us-gaap:ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCred.definition: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromUnsecuredNotesPayabl.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Notes Payable
us-gaap:ProceedsFromUnsecuredNotesPayabl.definition: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

us-gaap:ProceedsFromWarrantExercises.label: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
us-gaap:ProceedsFromWarrantExercises.definition: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

us-gaap:ProceedsNetInvestmentInLeasePrev.label: Proceeds, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsNetInvestmentInLeasePrev.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, previously written off.

us-gaap:ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHel.label: Proceeds from Sale or Securitization, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
us-gaap:ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHel.definition: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

us-gaap:ProceedsSalesTypeLeaseNetInvestm.label: Proceeds, Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
us-gaap:ProceedsSalesTypeLeaseNetInvestm.definition: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in sales-type lease, previously written off.

us-gaap:ProductLiabilityAccrualPeriodExp.label: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense
us-gaap:ProductLiabilityAccrualPeriodExp.definition: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrual.definition: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsF.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsF.definition: Amount of increase in liability for standard and extended product warranty acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPayments.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPayments.definition: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncr.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty liability.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistin.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistin.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualWarranties.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyAccrualWarranties.definition: Amount of increase in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued.

us-gaap:ProductWarrantyExpense.label: Product Warranty Expense
us-gaap:ProductWarrantyExpense.definition: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

us-gaap:ProductionAndDistributionCosts.label: Production and Distribution Costs
us-gaap:ProductionAndDistributionCosts.definition: Amount of expense related to the production and distribution of goods or services to customers and clients.

us-gaap:ProductionRelatedImpairmentsOrCh.label: Production Related Impairments or Charges
us-gaap:ProductionRelatedImpairmentsOrCh.definition: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

us-gaap:ProductionTaxExpense.label: Production Tax Expense
us-gaap:ProductionTaxExpense.definition: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

us-gaap:ProfessionalAndContractServicesE.label: Professional and Contracted Services Expense
us-gaap:ProfessionalAndContractServicesE.definition: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

us-gaap:ProfessionalFees.label: Professional Fees
us-gaap:ProfessionalFees.definition: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.definition: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:ProgressPaymentsNettedAgainstInv.label: Progress Payments Netted Against Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs
us-gaap:ProgressPaymentsNettedAgainstInv.definition: Amount of advances received from customers under long-term contracts which have been offset against inventories accounts at the balance sheet date.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditio.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Addition
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditio.definition: Amount of increase in property, plant, and equipment from addition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFina.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFina.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFina.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFina.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDisposa.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Disposition
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDisposa.definition: Amount of decrease in property, plant, and equipment from disposition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludi.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludi.definition: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of accumulated amortization, depreciation, depletion for physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludi.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, before Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludi.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGrossPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOwnedAc.label: Airline, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOwnedAc.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOwnedGr.label: Airline, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, before Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOwnedGr.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentTransfe.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Other Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentTransfe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment from reclassification, impairment, donation, and change classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

us-gaap:PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForO.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForO.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

us-gaap:PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForO.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, before Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForO.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLos.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLos.definition: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed.definition: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

us-gaap:ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses.label: Provision for Other Credit Losses
us-gaap:ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses.definition: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

us-gaap:ProvisionForOtherLosses.label: Provision for Other Losses
us-gaap:ProvisionForOtherLosses.definition: Amount of expense related to other loss.

us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFunds.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFunds.definition: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFunds.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFunds.definition: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndE.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndE.definition: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.
Period end amount of total gross PPE.

us-gaap:PumpTaxes.label: Pump Taxes
us-gaap:PumpTaxes.definition: Pump tax, commonly known as a Replenishment assessment. A charge on each acre-foot of groundwater extracted from the basin. Income from the pump taxes finances the replenishment of the basin and projects for water recycling and water quality improvements.

us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: Amount of accumulated depreciation pertaining to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Other Addition
us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: Amount of other additions to accumulated depreciation other than depreciation expense for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Other Deduction
us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: Amount of other deductions to accumulated depreciation, excluding sales, for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation on real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Investment in Real Estate Sold
us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciatio.definition: Amount of decrease to accumulated depreciation for real estate investments sold for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAcquisitionsThroughFor.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Acquisition Through Foreclosure
us-gaap:RealEstateAcquisitionsThroughFor.definition: Amount of real estate investments acquired through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateAssetsHeldForDevelopme.label: Real Estate Assets Held for Development and Sale
us-gaap:RealEstateAssetsHeldForDevelopme.definition: For banks, the total amount of real estate assets held for development and sale.

us-gaap:RealEstateCostOfRealEstateSold.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Cost of Investment in Real Estate Sold
us-gaap:RealEstateCostOfRealEstateSold.definition: Amount of real estate investments sold for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue.definition: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

us-gaap:RealEstateImprovements.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Improvements
us-gaap:RealEstateImprovements.definition: Amount of increase in real estate investments related to improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateInsurance.label: Real Estate Insurance
us-gaap:RealEstateInsurance.definition: A contract to provide coverage or protection in exchange for a payment or "premium". Examples of insurance protection include liability and property insurance. The entity paying the premiums for the protection will have insurance expense and possibly an asset, Prepaid Insurance (if the premiums are paid in advance).

us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.definition: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest costs that were capitalized to properties under development during the land development and construction period of a project, and which are included in inventory.

us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs, Cost of Sales
us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.definition: Amount of interest cost charged to cost of sales that had been previously capitalized to inventory.

us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs Incurred
us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.definition: The amount of interest capitalized to an operative builder's inventory during the period.

us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized interest costs in real estate inventory.

us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:RealEstateInventoryCapitalizedIn.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipC.label: Real Estate Investment Partnership Cost of Sales
us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipC.definition: Amount of cost of sales related to investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipR.label: Real Estate Investment Partnership Revenue
us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipR.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAccu.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAccu.definition: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.

us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCo.label: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCo.definition: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

us-gaap:RealEstateLiabilitiesAssociatedW.label: Real Estate Liabilities Associated with Assets Held for Development and Sale
us-gaap:RealEstateLiabilitiesAssociatedW.definition: For banks, amount of all liabilities for which a financial institution is required to include in its calculation of net investment in real estate assets held for development or sale.

us-gaap:RealEstateOtherAcquisitions.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Acquisition
us-gaap:RealEstateOtherAcquisitions.definition: Amount of increase in real estate investments from acquisitions other than through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateOtherAdditions.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Addition
us-gaap:RealEstateOtherAdditions.definition: Amount of other additions excluding acquisition or improvement to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateOtherDeductions.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Deduction
us-gaap:RealEstateOtherDeductions.definition: Amount of other deductions to real estate investments, excluding sales, for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Amounts Applied
us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: Amount of the valuation allowance for real estate owned that was applied in the period against the carrying amount of real estate owned that was sold, written down or written off.

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: Total Increase or Decrease in the real estate owned valuation allowance for period.

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Provision
us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: Amount of expense recognized in the income statement for a decrease in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.label: Real Estate Owned Valuation Allowance [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Valuation Increase
us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanc.definition: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an increase in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

us-gaap:RealEstatePeriodIncreaseDecrease.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:RealEstatePeriodIncreaseDecrease.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) before accumulated depreciation of real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:RealEstateTaxExpense.label: Real Estate Tax Expense
us-gaap:RealEstateTaxExpense.definition: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

us-gaap:RealEstateTaxesAndInsurance.label: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
us-gaap:RealEstateTaxesAndInsurance.definition: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

us-gaap:RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDer.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, after Tax
us-gaap:RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDer.definition: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.label: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
us-gaap:RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.definition: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

us-gaap:RecapitalizationCosts.label: Recapitalization Costs
us-gaap:RecapitalizationCosts.definition: Amount of recapitalization costs for professional fees associated with restructuring debt and equity mixture that do not qualify for capitalization.

us-gaap:ReclamationAndMineShutdownProvis.label: Reclamation and Mine Shutdown Provision
us-gaap:ReclamationAndMineShutdownProvis.definition: Adjustment of the mine reclamation or mine shutdown liability account that is made when estimates of future costs are changed.

us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAccumulatedO.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAccumulatedO.definition: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAociCurrentP.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAociCurrentP.definition: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

us-gaap:ReclassificationToWellFacilities.label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Reclassification Based on Determination of Proved Reserve
us-gaap:ReclassificationToWellFacilities.definition: Amount of reclassification of capitalized exploratory well cost to well, facility, and equipment based on determination of proved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPe.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
us-gaap:ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPe.definition: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

us-gaap:ReconciliationOfCarryingAmountOf.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ReconciliationOfCarryingAmountOf.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ReconciliationOfRealEstateAccumu.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ReconciliationOfRealEstateAccumu.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ReconciliationOfUnrecognizedTaxB.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ReconciliationOfUnrecognizedTaxB.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:RecordedThirdPartyEnvironmentalR.label: Recorded Third-Party Environmental Recoveries, Discount
us-gaap:RecordedThirdPartyEnvironmentalR.definition: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce the expected aggregate undiscounted amount of the asset for third-party recoveries related to environmental remediation obligations to the present value recognized on the balance sheet (if the receivable is discounted).

us-gaap:RecordedThirdPartyEnvironmentalR.label: Recorded Third-Party Environmental Recoveries, Undiscounted
us-gaap:RecordedThirdPartyEnvironmentalR.definition: Aggregate undiscounted amount of the asset for third-party recoveries related to environmental remediation obligations as of the balance sheet date.

us-gaap:RecoveryOfDirectCosts.label: Recovery of Direct Costs
us-gaap:RecoveryOfDirectCosts.definition: Return of or reimbursements received in relation to direct costs and expenses previously paid or incurred.

us-gaap:RecoveryStrandedCosts.label: Recovery Stranded Costs
us-gaap:RecoveryStrandedCosts.definition: Revenue from billings to utility customers to recover what are also referred to as stranded assets or stranded investments. These are assets that formerly regulated utilities with monopolies on local service are allowed to recover during their transition to deregulated suppliers in competitive markets. Essentially, these investments are sunk costs, made by utilities under the old regulated system, which might not be recovered in a truly competitive marketplace. However, since they were valid investments at the time, the utilities are allowed to recover these costs from customers (for example, an investment in electrical generation assets that may not be recouped if customers are now allowed to purchase electricity from another utility).

us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterest.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Elimination of Accretion, Deconsolidation of Subsidiary
us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterest.definition: Amount of increase to equity from elimination of previously recorded charge to equity for adjustment to carrying amount of noncontrolling interest from deconsolidation of subsidiary.

us-gaap:RedeemablePreferredStockDividend.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
us-gaap:RedeemablePreferredStockDividend.definition: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

us-gaap:ReductionsInOtherAssetsAmount.label: Reductions in Other Assets, Amount
us-gaap:ReductionsInOtherAssetsAmount.definition: Amount of significant reductions in the period of other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

us-gaap:RegistrationPaymentArrangementGa.label: Registration Payment Arrangement, Gains and Losses
us-gaap:RegistrationPaymentArrangementGa.definition: The decrease (gain) or increase (loss) in the carrying amount of the registration payment obligation that was recognized in earnings during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperating.definition: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenue.label: Regulated Operating Revenue
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenue.definition: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueElectri.definition: The amount of regulated power revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueExplora.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Exploration and Production
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueExplora.definition: The amount of regulated exploration and production operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueFieldSe.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Field Services
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueFieldSe.definition: The amount of regulated field services operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueFossilF.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Fossil Fuel
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueFossilF.definition: The amount of regulated fossil fuel operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueGas.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Gas
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueGas.definition: The amount of regulated gas operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueOther.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Other
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueOther.definition: The amount of regulated other operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenuePipelin.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Pipelines
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenuePipelin.definition: The amount of regulated pipeline operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueSteam.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Steam
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueSteam.definition: The amount of regulated steam operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueWater.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Water
us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenueWater.definition: The amount of regulated water operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnF.label: Regulator Expenses, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
us-gaap:RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnF.definition: Amount of fees or assessments to fund the operations of the regulator of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

us-gaap:ReinsuranceCostsAndRecoveriesNet.definition: Amount of recovery (expense) related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed and ceded.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceEffectOnClaimsAndBene.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed
us-gaap:ReinsuranceEffectOnClaimsAndBene.definition: Amount of policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceEffectOnClaimsAndBene.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Ceded
