us-gaap:ReinsuranceEffectOnClaimsAndBene.definition: Amount of reduction of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies ceded.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceLossOnUncollectibleAc.label: Reinsurance, Loss on Uncollectible Accounts in Period, Amount
us-gaap:ReinsuranceLossOnUncollectibleAc.definition: Amount of the write-down or write-off of a receivable from a reinsurer.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable, from recovery.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableAllowanceF.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableCreditLoss.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverableCreditLoss.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesAllowance.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesGross.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Gross
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesGross.definition: Amount before valuation allowance recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLos.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Allowance
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLos.definition: Amount of valuation allowance for reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLos.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Gross
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLos.definition: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnUnpaidL.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Allowance
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnUnpaidL.definition: Amount of valuation allowance for reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnUnpaidL.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Gross
us-gaap:ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnUnpaidL.definition: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

us-gaap:RentalIncomeNonoperating.label: Rental Income, Nonoperating
us-gaap:RentalIncomeNonoperating.definition: Income earned by providing the use of assets to an outside party in exchange for a payment or series of payments that is nonoperating in nature.

us-gaap:ReorganizationValue.label: Reorganization Value
us-gaap:ReorganizationValue.definition: Amount attributed to the reconstituted entity, as well as the expected net realizable value of those assets that will be disposed before reconstitution occurs.

us-gaap:RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRe.label: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
us-gaap:RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRe.definition: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSe.label: Repayments of Accounts Receivable Securitization
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSe.definition: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAdvancesForConstruct.label: Payment for Advance for Construction, Investing Activity
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAdvancesForConstruct.definition: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to developer, builder, government agency, and municipality for borrowing received in construction.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAnnuitiesAndInvestme.label: Repayments of Annuities and Investment Certificates
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAnnuitiesAndInvestme.definition: The cash outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAssumedDebt.label: Repayments of Assumed Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfAssumedDebt.definition: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfBankDebt.label: Repayments of Bank Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfBankDebt.definition: The cash outflow to settle a bank borrowing during the year.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.definition: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConstructionLoansPay.label: Repayments of Construction Loans Payable
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConstructionLoansPay.definition: The cash outflow from repayment of borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt.label: Repayments of Convertible Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt.definition: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt.label: Repayments of Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt.definition: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebtAndCapitalLeaseO.label: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebtAndCapitalLeaseO.definition: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreTh.label: Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreTh.definition: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankB.label: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankB.definition: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond.label: Repayments of First Mortgage Bond
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond.definition: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument issued, secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.definition: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.definition: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapit.label: Repayment of Long-Term Debt, Long-Term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapit.definition: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredi.label: Repayments of Long-Term Lines of Credit
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredi.definition: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongtermLoansFromVen.label: Repayments of Long-Term Loans from Vendors
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongtermLoansFromVen.definition: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfMandatoryRedeemableC.label: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfMandatoryRedeemableC.definition: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.label: Repayments of Medium-Term Note
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.definition: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.label: Repayments of Notes Payable
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.definition: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherDebt.label: Repayments of Other Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherDebt.definition: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt.label: Repayments of Other Long-Term Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt.definition: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherShortTermDebt.label: Repayments of Other Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherShortTermDebt.definition: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfPollutionControlBond.label: Repayments of Pollution Control Bond
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfPollutionControlBond.definition: The cash outflow from settlement of a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.label: Repayments of Related Party Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.definition: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.definition: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.label: Repayments of Senior Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.definition: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.definition: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturin.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturin.definition: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturin.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturin.definition: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSubordinatedDebt.label: Repayments of Subordinated Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSubordinatedDebt.definition: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSubordinatedShortTer.label: Repayments of Subordinated Short-Term Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSubordinatedShortTer.definition: The cash outflow for an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.definition: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

us-gaap:RepaymentsOfUnsecuredTaxExemptDe.label: Repayments of Unsecured Tax Exempt Debt
us-gaap:RepaymentsOfUnsecuredTaxExemptDe.definition: The cash outflow to repay long-term tax exempt debt that is not secured by collateral.

us-gaap:RepurchaseAgreementsInterestExpe.label: Repurchase Agreements, Interest Expense Amount
us-gaap:RepurchaseAgreementsInterestExpe.definition: This is the amount of interest expense incurred during the reporting period as a result of repurchase agreements.

us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentAssetAcqui.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired in Transaction Other than Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Writeoff
us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentAssetAcqui.definition: Amount of writeoff for research and development asset acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both. Includes, but is not limited to, software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.label: Research and Development Expense
us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.definition: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExc.label: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExc.definition: Amount of expense for research and development. Excludes cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed, writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both, and write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseSof.label: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseSof.definition: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

us-gaap:RestrictedStockExpense.label: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
us-gaap:RestrictedStockExpense.definition: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:RestructuringAndRelatedCostCostI.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date
us-gaap:RestructuringAndRelatedCostCostI.definition: Amount of costs incurred to date for the specified restructuring cost.

us-gaap:RestructuringCharges.label: Restructuring Charges
us-gaap:RestructuringCharges.definition: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:RestructuringCosts.label: Restructuring Costs
us-gaap:RestructuringCosts.definition: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:RestructuringIncurredCostStateme.label: Restructuring Charges, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:RestructuringIncurredCostStateme.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes restructuring charges.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserve.definition: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveAcceleratedD.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Accelerated Depreciation
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveAcceleratedD.definition: Amount of accelerated depreciation charged against earnings associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring plan.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveAccrualAdjus.label: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveAccrualAdjus.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.

us-gaap:RestructuringReservePeriodIncrea.label: Restructuring Reserve, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:RestructuringReservePeriodIncrea.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accrual for restructuring costs.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveRollForward.label: Restructuring Reserve [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveRollForward.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveSettledWitho.label: Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveSettledWitho.definition: Amount of decrease in the reserve for full or partial settlement through consideration other than cash.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveTranslationA.label: Restructuring Reserve, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveTranslationA.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the restructuring reserve.

us-gaap:RestructuringReserveTranslationA.label: Restructuring Reserve, Translation and Other Adjustment
us-gaap:RestructuringReserveTranslationA.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the restructuring reserve related to foreign currency translation (gain) loss and other increases (decreases).

us-gaap:RestructuringSettlementAndImpair.label: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
us-gaap:RestructuringSettlementAndImpair.definition: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsAccretionOfAs.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsAccretionOfAs.definition: Amount of accretion for asset retirement obligation charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationD.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Accretion
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationD.definition: Amount of depreciation, depletion, amortization, and accretion charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationD.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Valuation Provision
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationD.definition: Amount of depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation provision charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDryHoleCosts.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Dry Hole Cost
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDryHoleCosts.definition: Amount of dry hole cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOi.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Expense
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOi.definition: Amount of cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes general corporate overhead and interest cost.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExpenseOther.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Expense, Other
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExpenseOther.definition: Amount of cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities classified as other.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExplorationEx.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Exploration Cost
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExplorationEx.definition: Amount of exploration cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, geological, geophysical, and dry hole costs.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsGeneralAndAdm.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsGeneralAndAdm.definition: Amount of general and administrative costs charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsImpairmentOfO.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Impairment
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsImpairmentOfO.definition: Amount of impairment for oil and gas properties charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsIncomeTaxExpe.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsIncomeTaxExpe.definition: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsProductionOrL.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Production Cost
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsProductionOrL.definition: Amount of production (lifting) cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, depreciation of support equipment and facility, cost of labor, material, supply, and fuel consumed and service utilized to operate oil and gas well, its equipment and facility, cost of repair and maintenance, property tax and insurance for proved property, well, and equipment and facility, and severance tax.

us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsTransportatio.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Transportation Cost
us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsTransportatio.definition: Amount of transportation cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

us-gaap:RevenueFromCollaborativeArrangem.label: Revenue from Collaborative Arrangement, Excluding Revenue from Contract with Customer
us-gaap:RevenueFromCollaborativeArrangem.definition: Amount of revenue from collaborative arrangement. Excludes revenue from contract with customer under Topic 606.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.definition: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerI.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerI.definition: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.

us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.definition: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Excluding Interest Income
us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.definition: Amount, excluding interest income, of revenue not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.definition: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

us-gaap:Revenues.label: Revenues
us-gaap:Revenues.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:RevenuesExcludingInterestAndDivi.label: Revenues, Excluding Interest and Dividends
us-gaap:RevenuesExcludingInterestAndDivi.definition: Revenues from operations, excluding interest and dividend income. Includes revenues from the following sources: investment banking (underwriting and financial advisory), principal transactions (sales and trading, and investment gains and losses), commissions, asset management, and investment advisory and other services.

us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.label: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchang.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchang.definition: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchang.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchang.definition: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense.label: Royalty Expense
us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense.definition: Amount of expense related to royalty payments under a contractual arrangement such as payment for mineral and drilling rights and use of technology or intellectual property.

us-gaap:RoyaltyIncomeNonoperating.label: Royalty Income, Nonoperating
us-gaap:RoyaltyIncomeNonoperating.definition: Ancillary revenue earned during the period from the consideration paid to the entity for the use of its rights and property by another party. Examples include licensing the use of copyrighted materials and leasing the extraction of natural resources.

us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateAccumula.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Depreciation Expense
us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateAccumula.definition: Amount of depreciation expense of real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateWritedow.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount
us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateWritedow.definition: Amount of write-down or reserve recognized in the income statement on real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

us-gaap:SalariesAndWages.label: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
us-gaap:SalariesAndWages.definition: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

us-gaap:SalariesWagesAndOfficersCompensa.label: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
us-gaap:SalariesWagesAndOfficersCompensa.definition: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

us-gaap:SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainL.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net
us-gaap:SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainL.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.

us-gaap:SaleLeasebackTransactionAccumula.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Accumulated Depreciation
us-gaap:SaleLeasebackTransactionAccumula.definition: The accumulated depreciation and amortization related to the asset(s) sold in connection with the property sold to another party and leased back to the seller.

us-gaap:SaleLeasebackTransactionHistoric.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Historical Cost
us-gaap:SaleLeasebackTransactionHistoric.definition: The historical cost of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

us-gaap:SaleOfStockConsiderationReceived.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received on Transaction
us-gaap:SaleOfStockConsiderationReceived.definition: Cash received on stock transaction after deduction of issuance costs.

us-gaap:SaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.label: Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
us-gaap:SaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.definition: Amount of sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.

us-gaap:SalesCommissionsAndFees.label: Sales Commissions and Fees
us-gaap:SalesCommissionsAndFees.definition: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

us-gaap:SalesTypeAndDirectFinancingLease.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Interest Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeAndDirectFinancingLease.definition: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseImpairmentLoss.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseImpairmentLoss.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInitialDirectCostE.label: Sales-type Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, Commencement
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInitialDirectCostE.definition: Amount of sales-type lease initial direct cost recognized as expense at commencement date.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncome.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncome.definition: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncomeLeas.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Lease Receivable
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncomeLeas.definition: Amount of interest income from lease receivable of sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncomeUngu.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncomeUngu.definition: Amount of interest income from unguaranteed residual asset of sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseLeaseIncome.label: Sales-type Lease, Lease Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseLeaseIncome.definition: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income from net investment on sales-type lease, and profit (loss) recognized at commencement.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.
Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, from recovery.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type lease, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, from change in methodology.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of interest income on net investment in sales-type lease, from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: Amount of interest income on net investment in sales-type lease, on nonaccrual status.

us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseVariableLeaseIncom.label: Sales-type Lease, Variable Lease Income
us-gaap:SalesTypeLeaseVariableLeaseIncom.definition: Amount of sales-type lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

us-gaap:SalestypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SalestypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLea.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowed.label: Securities Borrowed
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowed.definition: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.definition: Amount of allowance for credit loss on security borrowed.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.label: Securities Borrowed, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on securities borrowed.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.label: Securities Borrowed, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on security borrowed, from recovery.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.label: Securities Borrowed, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.label: Securities Borrowed, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCr.definition: Amount of writeoff of security borrowed, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedCreditLossExpe.label: Securities Borrowed, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedCreditLossExpe.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on securities borrowed.

us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedIncrease.label: Securities Borrowed, Increase
us-gaap:SecuritiesBorrowedIncrease.definition: Amount of increase in security borrowed from entering into new transaction.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: Amount of writeoff of security purchased under agreement to resell, charged against allowance for credit loss.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.
Amount of allowance for credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell.
Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on securities purchased under agreement to resell.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell, from recovery.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell.

us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Increase
us-gaap:SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreemen.definition: Amount of increase from purchase of security purchased under agreement to resell.

us-gaap:SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLong.label: Segment Reporting, Long-Lived Asset, Expenditure for Addition
us-gaap:SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLong.definition: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived asset included in determination of segment asset by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

us-gaap:SellingAndMarketingExpense.label: Selling and Marketing Expense
us-gaap:SellingAndMarketingExpense.definition: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

us-gaap:SellingExpense.label: Selling Expense
us-gaap:SellingExpense.definition: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.

us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeE.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeE.definition: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityBenefitP.label: Separate Account, Liability, Benefit Payment
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityBenefitP.definition: Amount of cash outflow to separate account policyholder from benefit payment.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityCashSurr.label: Separate Account, Liability, Cash Surrender Value, Amount
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityCashSurr.definition: Amount of separate account liability payable to policyholder upon surrender of contract before maturity.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityCustomer.label: Separate Account, Liability, Customer [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityCustomer.definition: Indicates customer for separate account liability.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityDeposit.label: Separate Account, Liability, Deposit
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityDeposit.definition: Amount of cash inflow to separate account liability for cash received for deposit.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityGeograph.label: Separate Account, Liability, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityGeograph.definition: Indicates geographical component for separate account liability.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityIncrease.label: Separate Account, Liability, Increase (Decrease) from Invested Performance
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityIncrease.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in separate account liability from performance of investment.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityIncrease.label: Separate Account, Liability, Increase (Decrease) from Other Change
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityIncrease.definition: Amount increase (decrease) in separate account liability from change, classified as other.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPeriodIn.label: Separate Account, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPeriodIn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability for separate account.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPolicyCh.label: Separate Account, Liability, Policy Charge
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPolicyCh.definition: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from policy charge.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPremium.label: Separate Account, Liability, Premium
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPremium.definition: Amount of cash inflow to separate account liability from premium collected from policyholder.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPremiumA.label: Separate Account, Liability, Premium and Deposit
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPremiumA.definition: Amount of cash inflow to separate account liability from premium and deposit from cash received.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityPremiumA.label: Separate Account, Liability, Premium and Deposit [Abstract]

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityProductA.label: Separate Account, Liability, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityProductA.definition: Indicates product and service for separate account liability.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityRollForw.label: Separate Account, Liability [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityRollForw.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySegmentE.label: Separate Account, Liability, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySegmentE.definition: Indicates segment that includes separate account liability.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySurrende.label: Separate Account, Liability, Surrender
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySurrende.definition: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from contract redemption.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySurrende.label: Separate Account, Liability, Surrender and Withdrawal
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySurrende.definition: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from contract redemption and withdrawal of funds.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilitySurrende.label: Separate Account, Liability, Surrender and Withdrawal [Abstract]

us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityWithdraw.label: Separate Account, Liability, Withdrawal
us-gaap:SeparateAccountLiabilityWithdraw.definition: Amount of decrease in liability for separate account from withdrawal of funds.

us-gaap:SeparateAccountsLiability.definition: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedCostOth.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other than Temporary Impairments
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedCostOth.definition: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) applied to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValue.definition: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueAd.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Additions
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueAd.definition: Amount of additions from purchases, assumption or transfer to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueAm.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Amortization
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueAm.definition: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueBa.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Balance [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueBa.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueDi.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Disposals
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueDi.definition: Amount conveyed to unrelated parties of contract to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOt.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Amount
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOt.definition: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOt.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Description
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOt.definition: Description of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValuePe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueVa.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Increase (Decrease) for Valuation Allowance Adjustment
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueVa.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the amortized amount from a decrease (increase) in the valuation allowance applied to the servicing asset for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAdditio.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Additions
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAdditio.definition: The value of new servicing assets, subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through purchases or from transfers of financial assets.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmount.definition: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmountR.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmountR.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangeI.label: Servicing Asset, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Valuation Input, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangeI.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value from change in input used to calculate fair value of contract to service financial asset under which benefit of servicing is expected to more than adequately compensate servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChanges.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChanges.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs used to calculate the fair value of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChanges.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChanges.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs, assumptions, or model used to calculate the fair value of the contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueChanges.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions [Abstract]

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueDisposa.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Disposals
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueDisposa.definition: Decrease in servicing assets subsequently measured at fair value resulting from conveyance of servicing rights to unrelated parties.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.label: Servicing Asset, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Other, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value classified as other for contract to service financial asset under which benefit of servicing is expected to more than adequately compensate servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherCh.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValuePeriodI.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValuePeriodI.definition: The increase (decrease) in the fair value of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedCos.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Amortization
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedCos.definition: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedCos.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Other Increase (Decrease) in Obligation
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedCos.definition: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Additions
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.definition: Amount of additions from purchases, assumption or transfer to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Disposals
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.definition: Amount conveyed to unrelated parties of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtAmortizedVal.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAdd.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Additions
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAdd.definition: The value of new servicing liabilities, that are subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through assumptions of servicing obligations and servicing obligations that result from transfers of financial assets.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAmo.definition: Fair value of a liability representing servicing arrangements under which the estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAmo.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Amount [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAmo.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueCha.label: Servicing Liability, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Valuation Input, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueCha.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value from change in input used to calculate fair value of contract to service financial asset under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueCha.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueCha.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs, assumptions, or model used to calculate the fair value of the contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDis.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Disposals
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDis.definition: Decreases in fair value of servicing liabilities resulting from conveyance of servicing rights to unrelated parties.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.label: Servicing Liability, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Other, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.definition: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value classified as other for contract to service financial asset under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOth.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValuePer.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ServicingLiabilityAtFairValuePer.definition: The net increase (decrease) in the fair value of servicing liabilities subsequently measured at fair value.

us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1.label: Severance Costs
us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1.definition: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.definition: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award forfeited under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).
Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share [Abstract]

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.
Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award vested under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Expirations
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements for which rights to exercise lapsed.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were cancelled as a result of occurrence of a terminating event.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were either cancelled or expired.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Granted
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Net number of non-option equity instruments granted to participants.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Other increase (decrease) in number of shares reserved for issuance under non-option equity instrument agreements that is not separately disclosed.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other, Description
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Description of reason for increase (decrease), classified as other, in number of awards under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.
Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Increase (decrease) in the number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average price of options that were either forfeited or expired.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Other Increases (Decreases) in Period
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The addition or reduction in the number of reserved shares that could potentially be issued under the option plan attributable to reasons other than grants, exercises, forfeitures, and expirations during the reporting period.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Other Increases (Decreases) in Period, Description
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Sets forth the nature of any other increase or decrease in the number of shares reserved for issuance under the option plan.
Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: The increase or decrease in number of shares reserved for issuance under stock option agreements awarded under the plan that validly exist and are outstanding, including vested options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease), Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Change in the weighted average exercise price of options outstanding.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.
Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Other Share Increase (Decrease) in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Weighted average price at which grantees could acquire or could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to any other type of change in shares reserved for issuance.
