us-gaap:ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax.label: Share Repurchase Program, Excise Tax
us-gaap:ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax.definition: Amount of excise tax on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Number of Shares
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Number of Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangemen.definition: Number of increase (decrease) of non-vested options.

us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangemen.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Number of Shares

us-gaap:SharesOutstanding.definition: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

us-gaap:ShortTermLeasePayments.label: Short-Term Lease Payments
us-gaap:ShortTermLeasePayments.definition: Amount of cash outflow for short-term lease payment excluded from lease liability.

us-gaap:SponsorFees.label: Sponsor Fees
us-gaap:SponsorFees.definition: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.

us-gaap:StandardAndExtendedProductWarran.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:StandardAndExtendedProductWarran.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the standard and extended product warranty accrual.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrual.definition: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualAd.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualAd.definition: Amount of increase in liability for standard product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for extended warranty acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualFo.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualFo.definition: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPa.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPa.definition: Amount of decrease in the standard product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard product warranty. Excludes extended product warranties.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPe.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPr.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPr.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes extended product warranties.

us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualWa.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
us-gaap:StandardProductWarrantyAccrualWa.definition: Amount of increase in the standard product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes extended product warranties.

us-gaap:StockDividendsShares.label: Stock Dividends, Shares
us-gaap:StockDividendsShares.definition: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.definition: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.definition: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.definition: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSha.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharebase.label: Shares Granted or Issued, Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcq.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcq.definition: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCon.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCon.definition: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCon.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCon.definition: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDiv.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDiv.definition: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.definition: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.definition: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmp.definition: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIss.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIss.definition: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNew.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNew.definition: Number of new stock issued during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOth.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOth.definition: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPer.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPer.definition: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPur.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Purchase of Assets
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPur.definition: Number of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.definition: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.definition: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.definition: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRes.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRev.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRev.definition: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.definition: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.definition: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.definition: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSha.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSto.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSto.definition: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSto.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesSto.definition: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcqu.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcqu.definition: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.definition: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.definition: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments [Abstract]
Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConv.definition: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDivi.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDivi.definition: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.definition: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.definition: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmpl.definition: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssu.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssu.definition: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewI.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewI.definition: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueOthe.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueOthe.definition: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValuePurc.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValuePurc.definition: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.definition: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.definition: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.definition: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRest.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.definition: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.definition: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.definition: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShar.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStoc.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStoc.definition: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStoc.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStoc.definition: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueTrea.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueTrea.definition: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:StockOptionDownRoundFeatureDecre.label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount
us-gaap:StockOptionDownRoundFeatureDecre.definition: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:StockOptionDownRoundFeatureIncre.label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:StockOptionDownRoundFeatureIncre.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:StockOptionPlanExpense.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
us-gaap:StockOptionPlanExpense.definition: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPerio.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
us-gaap:StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPerio.definition: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

us-gaap:StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPerio.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
us-gaap:StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPerio.definition: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuring.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuring.definition: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuring.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuring.definition: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShar.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShar.definition: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValu.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValu.definition: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquity.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPorti.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTra.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTra.definition: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityOther.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityOther.definition: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityOtherShares.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityOtherShares.definition: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityPeriodIncrease.label: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityPeriodIncrease.definition: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

us-gaap:StormDamageProvision.label: Storm Damage Provision
us-gaap:StormDamageProvision.definition: A noncash adjustment to the provision established for storm damage by an oil, gas, or utility company.

us-gaap:SubadvisoryFeesForMutualFunds.label: Subadvisory Fees for Mutual Funds
us-gaap:SubadvisoryFeesForMutualFunds.definition: Subadvisory fees that the funds adviser pays for out of the management fee, which it receives from the fund.

us-gaap:SubleaseIncome.label: Sublease Income
us-gaap:SubleaseIncome.definition: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

us-gaap:SubordinatedDebt.definition: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesAdditions.label: Subordinated Liabilities, Additions
us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesAdditions.definition: New liabilities assumed during the reporting period that are subordinated to claims of general creditors.

us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesExtinguis.label: Subordinated Liabilities, Extinguished
us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesExtinguis.definition: Liabilities that are subordinated to claims of general creditors and were paid or extinguished during the reporting period.

us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesPeriodInc.label: Subordinated Liabilities, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:SubordinatedLiabilitiesPeriodInc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in subordinated debt.

us-gaap:SupplementaryInsuranceInformatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Net Investment Income
us-gaap:SupplementaryInsuranceInformatio.definition: Amount of net investment income earned, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

us-gaap:SupplementaryInsuranceInformatio.label: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Premium Revenue
us-gaap:SupplementaryInsuranceInformatio.definition: Amount of premium revenue earned, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.definition: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program.

us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Settlement
us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.definition: Amount of decrease in obligation for supplier finance program from settlement.

us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Addition
us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.definition: Amount of increase in obligation for supplier finance program.
Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for supplier finance program.

us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.definition: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes obligation for supplier finance program.

us-gaap:SuppliesAndPostageExpense.label: Supplies and Postage Expense
us-gaap:SuppliesAndPostageExpense.definition: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

us-gaap:SuppliesExpense.label: Supplies Expense
us-gaap:SuppliesExpense.definition: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

us-gaap:TangibleAssetImpairmentCharges.label: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges
us-gaap:TangibleAssetImpairmentCharges.definition: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

us-gaap:TaxAdjustmentsSettlementsAndUnus.label: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
us-gaap:TaxAdjustmentsSettlementsAndUnus.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

us-gaap:TaxesAndLicenses.label: Taxes and Licenses
us-gaap:TaxesAndLicenses.definition: Amount of tax expense, excluding income, excise, production and property taxes, and licenses and fees not related to production.

us-gaap:TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTax.definition: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

us-gaap:TaxesOther.label: Taxes, Other
us-gaap:TaxesOther.definition: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionOfDivide.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionOfDivide.definition: Value of accretion of temporary equity during the period due to unpaid dividends.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemp.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemp.definition: Value of accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value during the period.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemp.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value, Adjustment
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemp.definition: Amount of decrease to net income for accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountInc.definition: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityDividendsAdjustme.label: Temporary Equity, Dividends, Adjustment
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityDividendsAdjustme.definition: Accretion of temporary equity during the period due to cash, stock, and in-kind dividends. This item is an adjustment to net income necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders and is to be distinguished from Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends (Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends).

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityEliminationAsPart.label: Temporary Equity, Elimination as Part of Reorganization
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityEliminationAsPart.definition: Redemption of temporary equity as the result of a triggering event associated with the temporary equity.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityForeignCurrencyTr.label: Temporary Equity, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustments
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityForeignCurrencyTr.definition: Adjustments to temporary equity resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityInterestInSubsidi.label: Temporary Equity, Interest in Subsidiary Earnings
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityInterestInSubsidi.definition: Subsidiary earnings portion attributable to temporary equity.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityIssuePeriodIncrea.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityIssuePeriodIncrea.definition: Change in the value of each type or class of stock classified as temporary equity during the period. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityNetIncome.label: Temporary Equity, Net Income
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityNetIncome.definition: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityOtherChanges.label: Temporary Equity, Other Changes
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityOtherChanges.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityStockIssuedDuring.label: Temporary Equity, Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityStockIssuedDuring.definition: Value of new stock classified as temporary equity issued during the period.

us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsAllowance.label: Time-Sharing Transactions, Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts, Additions for Current Period Sales
us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsAllowance.definition: Amount of increase in the allowance for uncollectible accounts, for time sharing transactions, from current period sales.

us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsAllowance.label: Time-Sharing Transactions, Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsAllowance.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsChangesIn.label: Time-Sharing Transactions, Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts, Increase (Decrease) for Estimate Associated with Prior Period Sales
us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsChangesIn.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the allowance for uncollectible accounts, for time sharing transactions, from changes in estimates associated with prior period sales.

us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsDirectWri.label: Time-Sharing Transactions, Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts, Deduction, Direct Writeoff Charged Against Allowance
us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsDirectWri.definition: Amount of decrease in the allowance for uncollectible accounts, for time sharing transactions, from direct write-offs charged against the allowance.

us-gaap:TimeSharingTransactionsPeriodInc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the allowance for uncollectible accounts attributable to time sharing transactions.

us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleNetNo.definition: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleNetRe.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance, Reconciliation to Cash Flow [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleNetRe.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Addition to Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to trade receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Deduction from Held-for-Sale
us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of deduction to trade receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleRecon.definition: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in trade receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

us-gaap:TradingActivityGain.label: Trading Activity, Gain
us-gaap:TradingActivityGain.definition: The net gain on trading activities (including both derivative and nonderivative instruments) recognized in the statement of financial performance.

us-gaap:TradingActivityLoss.label: Trading Activity, Loss
us-gaap:TradingActivityLoss.definition: The loss on trading activities (including both derivative and nonderivative instruments) recognized in the statement of financial performance.

us-gaap:TradingGainsLosses.label: Trading Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:TradingGainsLosses.definition: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

us-gaap:TradingSecuritiesDebt.label: Debt Securities, Trading
us-gaap:TradingSecuritiesDebt.definition: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

us-gaap:TransferToFromPolicyholderAccoun.label: Transfer to (from) Policyholder Account Balance (to) from Separate Account
us-gaap:TransferToFromPolicyholderAccoun.definition: Amount of transfer to (from) liability for policyholder account balance (to) from liability for separate account.

us-gaap:TransferToInvestments.label: Transfer to Investments
us-gaap:TransferToInvestments.definition: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

us-gaap:TransferToOtherRealEstate.label: Real Estate Owned, Transfer to Real Estate Owned
us-gaap:TransferToOtherRealEstate.definition: Value transferred from mortgage loans to real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Increase (Decrease), Gross of Tax
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.definition: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) in the cumulative translation adjustment from gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

Amount, after tax, of cumulative translation adjustment attributable to gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the cumulative translation adjustment from gain (loss), after tax, on foreign currency derivatives, that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentForNetInves.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.definition: Amount of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings, after tax, related to translation from the functional currency to reporting currency, as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Increase (Decrease), Gross of Tax
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.definition: Amount of cumulative translation gain (loss), before tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.
Amount of cumulative translation gain (loss), after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment, after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Tax Expense (Benefit)
us-gaap:TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalT.definition: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

us-gaap:TravelAndEntertainmentExpense.label: Travel and Entertainment Expense
us-gaap:TravelAndEntertainmentExpense.definition: Expenses incurred for travel and entertainment during the period.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockCarryingBasis.label: Treasury Stock, Carrying Basis
us-gaap:TreasuryStockCarryingBasis.definition: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue.definition: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockPreferredValue.label: Treasury Stock, Preferred, Value
us-gaap:TreasuryStockPreferredValue.definition: Amount allocated to previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockReissuedAtLowerThan.label: Treasury Stock Reissued at Lower than Repurchase Price
us-gaap:TreasuryStockReissuedAtLowerThan.definition: In cases when treasury stock is reissued at a price lower than the cost to repurchase, the excess difference between the selling price and cost to repurchase is charged against retained earnings (assuming that all APIC arising from treasury stock transactions has first been exhausted).

us-gaap:TreasuryStockRetiredCostMethodAm.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
us-gaap:TreasuryStockRetiredCostMethodAm.definition: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockRetiredParValueMeth.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount
us-gaap:TreasuryStockRetiredParValueMeth.definition: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the par value method.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockSharesRetired.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
us-gaap:TreasuryStockSharesRetired.definition: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockTransactionsExcludi.label: Treasury Stock Transactions, Excluding Value of Shares Reissued [Abstract]

us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue.label: Treasury Stock, Value
us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue.definition: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockValueAcquiredCostMe.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
us-gaap:TreasuryStockValueAcquiredCostMe.definition: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockValueAcquiredParVal.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
us-gaap:TreasuryStockValueAcquiredParVal.definition: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

us-gaap:TrusteeFees.label: Trustee Fees
us-gaap:TrusteeFees.definition: Fees charged annually for the professional services of a trustee, usually quoted as a percentage of the funds being managed. The fee for appointing an offshore Trustee is included in the trust price.

us-gaap:UnderwritingIncomeLoss.label: Underwriting Income (Loss)
us-gaap:UnderwritingIncomeLoss.definition: The difference between the price paid by the public and the contract price less the related expenses. A broker-dealer may underwrite a security offering by contracting to buy the issue either at a fixed price or a price based on selling the offering on a best-effort basis.

us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocat.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic
us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocat.definition: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndD.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, after Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndD.definition: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDeri.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, after Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDeri.definition: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnCommodityCon.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Commodity Contracts
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnCommodityCon.definition: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives.definition: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesA.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesA.definition: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurre.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurre.definition: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnHybridInstru.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hybrid Instrument, Net
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnHybridInstru.definition: Amount of the unrealized gain (loss) in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value on hybrid instruments measured at fair value.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInterestRate.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInterestRate.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the increase or decrease in fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which was recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge was determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCas.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCas.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) arising from the change in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskFai.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskFai.definition: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyD.label: Unrealized Gain on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyD.definition: Amount of unrealized gain related to the increase in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedGainOnPriceRiskCashFlo.label: Unrealized Gain on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedGainOnPriceRiskCashFlo.definition: Amount of unrealized gain from the increase in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyD.label: Unrealized Loss on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyD.definition: Amount of unrealized loss recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income pertaining to the decrease in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments to the extent that a cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrealizedLossOnPriceRiskCashFlo.label: Unrealized Loss on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
us-gaap:UnrealizedLossOnPriceRiskCashFlo.definition: Amount of unrealized loss related to the decrease in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Acquisition
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreases.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTax.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTax.definition: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTax.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTax.definition: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.definition: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.definition: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.definition: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.definition: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreases.definition: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsInterestO.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Expense
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsInterestO.definition: Amount of interest expense for an underpayment of income taxes.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsPeriodInc.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsPeriodInc.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in unrecognized tax benefits attributable to uncertain tax positions taken in tax returns.

us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsReduction.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsReduction.definition: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

us-gaap:UnregulatedOperatingRevenue.label: Unregulated Operating Revenue
us-gaap:UnregulatedOperatingRevenue.definition: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:UnsolicitedTenderOfferCosts.label: Unsolicited Tender Offer Costs
us-gaap:UnsolicitedTenderOfferCosts.definition: Costs incurred in connection with an unsolicited tender offer (one where the Entity being sought has not requested the offer). These would include costs relating to evaluation and dissemination of information regarding an unsolicited tender offer. A tender offer is a broad solicitation by an Entity or a third party to purchase a substantial percentage of another entity's shares or units for a limited period of time. The offer is at a fixed price, usually at a premium over the current market price, and is contingent on shareholders' tendering a fixed number of their shares or units.

us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemGainGross.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Gain, Gross
us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemGainGross.definition: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemInsurance.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Insurance Proceeds
us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemInsurance.definition: Amount of insurance proceeds for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemLossGross.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Loss, Gross
us-gaap:UnusualOrInfrequentItemLossGross.definition: Amount, before deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpense.definition: Amount of operating expense of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseDepreci.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Depreciation and Amortization
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseDepreci.definition: Amount of operating expense for depreciation and amortization of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseFuelUse.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Fuel Used
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseFuelUse.definition: Amount of operating expense for fuel used by regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseGasAndP.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Gas and Petroleum Purchased
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseGasAndP.definition: Amount of operating expense for purchased gas and petroleum of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseImpairm.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Impairments
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseImpairm.definition: Amount of operating expense for impairments of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.definition: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance and repairs of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.definition: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMainten.definition: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOperati.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Operations
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOperati.definition: Amount of operating expense for routine operations of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOther.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Other
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOther.definition: Amount of other operating expense of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseProduct.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Products and Services
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseProduct.definition: Amount of operating expense for products and services of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchas.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchas.definition: Amount of operating expense for purchased power of regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchas.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power under Long-Term Contracts
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchas.definition: Amount of operating expense for purchased power procured under arrangements extending beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, by regulated operation.

us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Taxes
us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes.definition: Amount of operating expense for taxes other than income taxes of regulated operation.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Aggregate Write-Downs
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from write-downs charged against the allowance.

Reflects the estimated amount of impairment as of the balance sheet date of recognized servicing assets that are being amortized in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Disposals
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on disposal of the related asset.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: The net increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for servicing assets subsequently measured using the amortization method.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions for Expenses
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Amount of increase in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from charges to expense.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions (Deductions) for Expenses (Recoveries)
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from expenses (recoveries) recognized.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions (Deductions) for Expenses (Recoveries) [Abstract]
Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Recoveries
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from recoveries recognized.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets [Roll Forward]
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales
us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.definition: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sale of the related asset.
Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sales and disposals.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentO.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales and Disposals [Abstract]

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesAd.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Increase (Decrease) Adjustment
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesAd.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from adjustment.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesBa.definition: Amount of valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesCh.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Cost and Expense
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesCh.definition: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to cost and expense.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesCh.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Other Account
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesCh.definition: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to accounts other than cost and expense.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesDe.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Deduction
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesDe.definition: Amount of decrease in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesPe.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesPe.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesRe.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Addition, Recovery
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesRe.definition: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from recovery of amount previously written off or reestablishment of reserve previously utilized.

us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesRe.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Business Acquired
us-gaap:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesRe.definition: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from business combination.

us-gaap:ValueOfBusinessAcquiredVOBA.definition: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityInitialCon.label: Variable Interest Entity, Initial Consolidation, Gain (Loss)
us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityInitialCon.definition: The gain (loss) recognized on initial consolidation of a variable interest entity (VIE) when the VIE is not a business (as defined).

us-gaap:VariableLeaseIncome.label: Variable Lease, Income
us-gaap:VariableLeaseIncome.definition: Amount of variable lease payments from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

us-gaap:VariableLeasePayment.label: Variable Lease, Payment
us-gaap:VariableLeasePayment.definition: Amount of cash outflow for variable lease payment excluded from lease liability.

us-gaap:VentureCapitalGainsLossesNet.label: Venture Capital Gain (Loss), Net
us-gaap:VentureCapitalGainsLossesNet.definition: Amount of gain (loss) on venture capital activities. Includes venture capital revenue, fair value adjustments, interest and dividends, investment gain (loss) and fee or other income from venture capital activities.

us-gaap:WarrantDownRoundFeatureDecreaseI.label: Warrant, Down Round Feature, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount
us-gaap:WarrantDownRoundFeatureDecreaseI.definition: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

us-gaap:WarrantDownRoundFeatureIncreaseD.label: Warrant, Down Round Feature, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
us-gaap:WarrantDownRoundFeatureIncreaseD.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding.label: Warrants and Rights Outstanding
us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding.definition: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

us-gaap:WaterProductionCosts.label: Water Production Costs
us-gaap:WaterProductionCosts.definition: Cost incurred related to water production and may include cost of treatment plants, pumps, pipes and reservoir, purchased water, power and pump taxes as well as the cost of reducing water leakage.

us-gaap:WithdrawalFromContractHoldersFun.label: Withdrawal from Contract Holders Funds
us-gaap:WithdrawalFromContractHoldersFun.definition: The cash outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

us-gaap:WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCo.label: Deferred Debt Issuance Cost, Writeoff
us-gaap:WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCo.definition: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.
